entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام قَالَ: «الْعَمُّ أَبٌ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ دُونَهُ أَبٌ، وَالْخَالَةُ أُمٌّ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ دُونَهَا أُمٌّ»
entries.isnad_en: Yunus b. Yazid reported to me from Ibn Shihab, who said:
entries.matn_en: “It has reached us—and God knows best—that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: ‘A paternal uncle is like a father when there is no father closer in the line of descent, and a maternal aunt is like a mother when there is no mother closer in the line of descent.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 156
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي حَفْصُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي مَرْوَانَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ كَعْبًا، حَلَفَ لَهُ بِالَّذِي فَرَقَ الْبَحْرَ لِمُوسَى أَنَّ فِيَ التَّوْرَاةِ: «يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ» اتَّقِ رَبَّكَ، وَبِرَّ وَالِدَيْكَ، وَصِلْ رَحِمَكَ يُمَدَّ لَكَ فِي عُمُرِكَ، وَيُيَسَّرْ لَكَ يُسْرُكَ، وَيُصْرَفْ عَنْكَ عُسْرُكَ "
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Hafs b. Maysarah, from Musa b. Uqbah, from Ata b. Abi Marwan, from his father,
entries.matn_en: that Ka'b swore by the One who split the sea for Moses that in the Torah it says: 'O son of Adam, fear your Lord, be dutiful to your parents, and maintain your ties of kinship. Your lifespan will be extended, your affairs will be made easy, and your difficulties will be averted.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 158
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي حَفْصُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام قَالَ: "
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ الرَّحِمَ شَجْنَةٌ مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ، فَقَالَ لَهَا: مَنْ وَصَلَكِ وَصَلْتُهُ، وَمَنْ قَطَعَكِ قَطَعْتُهُ "
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Hafs b. Maysarah, from Musa b. Uqbah, from Abdullah b. Dinar, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: Kinship is a branch from the Merciful. He said to it: Whoever maintains you, I will maintain him, and whoever severs you, I will sever him.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 160
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وأَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ الثَّوْرِيِّ، عَنْ فِطْرِ بْنِ خَلِيفَةَ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام: «
entries.matn_ar: لَيْسَ الْوَاصِلُ بِالْمُكَافِئِ، وَلَكِنَّ الْوَاصِلَ مَنْ إِذَا قُطِعَتْ رَحِمُهُ وَصَلَهَا»
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Muhammad b. Amr, from Sufyan al-Thawri, from Fitr b. Khalifah, from Mujahid, from Abdullah b. Amr b. al-As, who said The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: '
entries.matn_en: The one who maintains ties is not the one who reciprocates, but the one who maintains ties when they are severed.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 162
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ سَوَادَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا، أَتَى إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَالَ: " يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ لِي مَالًا يَشْغَلُنِي، قَالَ: فَأَخْبَرَنِي بِعَمَلٍ يُقَرِّبُنِي إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ؟، فَقَالَ: «هَلْ وَالِدَتُكَ حَيَّةٌ؟» قَالَ: لَا. قَالَ: «لَوْ كَانَتْ وَالِدَتُكَ حَيَّةً أَخْبَرْتُكَ، وَلَكِنِ ابْذِلِ الطَّعَامَ، وَأَلِنِ الْكَلَامَ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahi'ah reported to me from Bakr b. Sawadah
entries.matn_en: that a man came to the Prophet, ﷺ, and said: “Prophet of God, I have wealth that keeps me occupied. Tell me of a deed that will bring me nearer to Paradise.” The Prophet asked: “Is your mother alive?” He replied: “No.” The Prophet said: “Had your mother been alive, I would have told you [what to do]. But give food generously and speak gently.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 163
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ سَوَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَالِمٍ الْجَيْشَانِيِّ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام قَالَ: «إِنَّ امْرَأَةً مِنْ عَكٍّ ظَعَنُوا فِي يَوْمٍ شَدِيدِ الْحَرِّ وَمَعَهَا ابْنُهَا، وَأُمٌّ لَهَا، فَانْطَلَقْتُ إِلَى ابْنِهَا فَأَعْطَتْهُ رَجُلًا مِنْ قَوْمِهَا، وَجَعَلَتْ أُمَّهَا عَلَى فَخِذَيْهَا بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ الْأَرْضِ فَغُفِرَ لَهَا»
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Ibn Lahi'ah, from Bakr b. Sawadah, from Abu Salim al-Jayshani,
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said 'A woman from Akk set out on a very hot day with her son and her mother. She went to her son and gave him to a man from her people, and she placed her mother on her thighs between her and the ground. She was forgiven.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 164
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ غَزِيَّةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ كَعْبٍ: "
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ فِي جَهَنَّمَ أَرْبَعَةَ جُسُورٍ: فَأَمَّا أَوَّلُهَا فَجِسْرٌ يُحْبَسُ عَلَيْهَا كُلُّ قَاطِعِ رَحِمٍ، وَأَمَّا الثَّانِي فَكُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهِ دَيْنٌ حَتَّى يُؤَدِّيَ دَيْنَهُ، وَأَمَّا الثَّالِثُ فَأَصْحَابُ الْغُلُولِ، وَأَمَّا الرَّابِعُ فَعَلَيْهِ الْجَبَّارُ وَالرَّحْمَةُ، فَالرَّحْمَةُ تَقُولُ: أَيْ رَبِّ سَلِّمْ سَلِّمْ "
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Ibn Lahi'ah, from Umarah b. Ghaziyyah, from Abdullah b. Dinar, from Ata b. Yasar, from Ka'b: '
entries.matn_en: In Hell, there are four bridges: The first is a bridge where every severer of kinship is detained. The second is for everyone who has a debt until he repays it. The third is for those who misappropriate war booty. The fourth is where the Almighty and Mercy are. Mercy says: O Lord, save, save.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 165
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَحْرٍ، عَنْ لَيْثِ بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: مِنْ عُقُوقِ الْوَلَدِ لِوَالِدِهِ أَنْ يَدْعُوَهُ بِاسْمِهِ، وَأَنْ يَتَقَدَّمَهُ فِي الْمَشْيِ»
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Yahya b. Ayyub, from Ubaydullah b. Zahr, from Layth b. Abi Sulaym, from Shahr b. Hawshab, from Abu al-Darda, who said '
entries.matn_en: Among the acts of disobedience of a child to his parent is calling him by his name and walking ahead of him.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 167
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا، قَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَيُّ الْوَالِدَيْنِ أَعْظَمُ حَقًّا؟ . قَالَ: «الَّتِي حَمَلَتْ بَيْنَ الْجَنْبَيْنِ، وَأَرْضَعَتْ بِالثَّدْيَينِ، وَحَضَنَتْ عَلَى الْفَخِذَيْنِ، وَفَدَتْهُ بِالْوَالِدَيْنِ»
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub, from Ata b. Dinar,
entries.matn_en: that a man said 'O Messenger of God, which of the parents has the greatest right?' He said: 'The one who carried you between her sides, nursed you with her breasts, cradled you on her thighs, and sacrificed her parents for you.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 168
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي الْحَارِثُ بْنُ نَبْهَانَ، عَنْ لَيْثِ بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، رَأَى رَجُلًا مَعَهُ أَبُوهُ فَسَأَلَ الْفَتَى: مَنْ هَذَا؟ فَقَالَ: هَذَا أَبِي، قَالَ: «فَلَا تَمْشِ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ، وَلَا تَجْلِسْ قَبْلَهُ، وَلَا تَدْعُهُ بِاسْمِهِ، فَإِنَّهُ مِنَ الْعُقُوقِ»
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from al-Harith b. Nabhan, from Layth b. Abi Sulaym,
entries.matn_en: that Abu Hurayrah saw a man with his father and asked the young man: 'Who is this?' He said 'This is my father.' He said: 'Do not walk ahead of him, do not sit before him, and do not call him by his name, for that is disobedience.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 169
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَشِمْرُ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام قَالَ: «اسْتَوْصُوا بِعَبَّاسٍ خَيْرًا؛ فَإِنَّهُ عَمِّي وَصِنْوُ أَبِي»
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from al-Qasim b. Abdullah and Shimr b. Numayr, from Husayn b. Abdullah, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali b. Abi Talib,
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said 'Treat Abbas well, for he is my uncle and the twin of my father.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 170
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَشْهَلُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانُوا يَقُولُونَ: «أَكْرِمْ وَلَدَكَ وَأَحْسِنْ أَدَبَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Ashhal b. Hatim, from Abdullah b. Awn, from Muhammad b. Sirin, who said '
entries.matn_en: They used to say: Honor your child and teach him good manners.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 172
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ عِمْرَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْهُدَاجِ التُّجِيبِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قُلْتُ لِسَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ: " كُلَّمَا ذَكَرَ اللَّهُ فِي الْقُرْآنِ مِنْ بِرِّ الْوَالِدَيْنِ عَرَفْتُهُ إِلَّا قَوْلَهُ: {وَقُلْ لَهُمَا قَوْلًا كَرِيمًا} [الإسراء: 23] مَا هَذَا الْقَوْلُ الْكَرِيمُ؟، فَقَالَ ابْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ: «قَوْلُ الْعَبْدِ الْمُذْنِبِ لِلسَّيِّدِ الْفَظِّ»
entries.isnad_en: And he narrated to me from Harmalah b. Imran, from Abu al-Hudaj al-Tujibi, who said
entries.matn_en: I said to Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib: 'Every time God mentions in the Quran the duty of being good to parents, I understand it except for His saying: {And speak to them a generous word} [Al-Isra: 23]. What is this generous word?' Ibn al-Musayyib said: 'The word of a sinful servant to a harsh master.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 173
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي حَيْوَةُ بْنُ شُرَيْحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْهَادِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا، مِنَ الْأَعْرَابِ لَقِيَهُ بِطَرِيقِ مَكَّةَ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، وَحَمَلَهُ عَلَى حِمَارٍ كَانَ يَرْكَبُهُ، وَأَعْطَاهُ عِمَامَةً كَانَتْ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ، فَقَالَ ابْنُ دِينَارٍ: فَقُلْنَا لَهُ: أَصْلَحَكَ اللَّهُ، إِنَّهُمُ الْأَعْرَابُ، وَإِنَّهُمْ يَرْضَوْنَ بِالْيَسِيرِ، فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: إِنَّ أَبَا هَذَا كَانَ وُدًّا لِعُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، وَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام يَقُولُ: «إِنَّ الْبِرَّ صِلَةُ الْوَلَدِ أَهْلَ وُدِّ أَبِيهِ»
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Haywah b. Shurayh, from Ibn al-Had, from Abdullah b. Dinar, from Abdullah b. Umar,
entries.matn_en: that a Bedouin met him on the road to Mecca. Abdullah b. Umar greeted him, let him ride the donkey he was riding, and gave him the turban he was wearing on his head. Ibn Dinar said We said to him: 'May God rectify you, they are Bedouins, and they are content with little.' Abdullah said: 'This man's father was a close friend of Umar b. al-Khattab, and I heard the Messenger of God, ﷺ, say: 'Goodness is the child's maintaining the ties of his father's friends.''

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 175
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ: "
entries.matn_ar: تَعَجَّلَ إِلَى رَبِّهِ مُوسَى فَرَأَى عَبْدًا فَغَبَطَهُ بِمَنْزِلَتِهِ مِنَ الْعَرْشِ، فَقَالَ: " يَا رَبِّ، مَنْ عَبْدُكَ هَذَا؟ فَقَالَ: إِذًا سَنُخْبِرُكَ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ بِثَلَاثٍ: " كَانَ لَا يَحْسِدُ نَاسًا عَلَى مَا آتَاهُمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ، وَكَانَ لَا يَمْشِي بَيْنَ النَّاسِ بِالنَّمِيمَةِ، وَكَانَ لَا يُعَقُّ وَالِدَيْهِ، فَقَالَ مُوسَى: وَهَلْ يُعَقُّ الْعَبْدُ وَالِدَيْهِ؟ قَالَ: يَسْتَسِبُّ لَهُمَا "
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd Allah b. Yazid reported to me from 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Abd Allah b. 'Utbah, from Abu Ishaq, from 'Amr b. Maymun, from 'Abd Allah b. Mas'ud, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Moses hastened to his Lord and saw a servant. He wished for a station like his near the Throne. He asked: ‘My Lord, who is this servant of Yours?’ He replied: ‘I will tell you three of his deeds: he does not envy people for what God has granted them from His bounty; he does not go about spreading malicious gossip; and he does not behave toward his parents in a way that causes them to be cursed.’ Moses asked: ‘Can a person cause his parents to be cursed?’ He replied: ‘He makes himself liable to their being insulted [by insulting another’s parents].’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 177
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي مَنْ، سَمِعَ الْأَوْزَاعِيَّ، يَقُولُ: بَلَغَنِي «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ» مَنْ عَقَّ وَالِدَيْهِ فِي حَيَاتِهِمَا، ثُمَّ قَضَى دَيْنًا إِنْ كَانَ عَلَيْهِمَا، وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمَا، وَلَمْ يَسْتَسِبَّ لَهُمَا كُتِبَ بَارًّا، وَمَنْ بَرَّ وَالِدَيْهِ فِي حَيَاتِهِمَا، وَلَمْ يَقْضِ دَيْنًا كَانَ عَلَيْهِمَا، وَلَمْ يَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمَا، وَاسْتَسَبَّ لَهُمَا كُتِبَ بَارًّا "
entries.isnad_en: Someone who heard al-Awza'i reported to me that he said:
entries.matn_en: “It reached me that whoever mistreated his parents while they were alive, then pays any debt they left, seeks forgiveness for them, and does not cause them to be cursed, will nevertheless be recorded as dutiful. And whoever treated his parents well while they were alive, but does not pay their debt or seek forgiveness for them, and causes them to be cursed, will be recorded as dutiful.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 177
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي الصَّعْبَةِ، عَنْ شَيْخٍ، حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: قَرَأْتُ مِنَ التَّوْرَاةِ أَنَّ» مِنْ بِرِّ الْوَالِدِ صِلَةَ الرَّجُلِ صَدِيقَ أَبِيهِ، يَقُولُ: بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ "
entries.isnad_en: And he narrated to me from Abdullah b. Sa'd b. Abi al-Sa'ba, from an elder who narrated to him: '
entries.matn_en: I read in the Torah that among the duties to one's parent is maintaining the ties with the father's friend after death.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 178
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ زَبَّانَ بْنِ فَائِدٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ: «مَنْ بَرَّ وَالِدَيْهِ طُوبَى لَهُ، زَادَ اللَّهُ فِي عُمُرِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: And he narrated to me from Ibn Ayyub, from Zabban b. Fa'id, from Sahl b. Mu'adh, from his father,
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God said 'Whoever is dutiful to his parents, glad tidings for him. God will increase his lifespan.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 180
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ ابْنُ وَهْبٍ: أَخْبَرَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: بَيْنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ يَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ إِذْ رَأَى رَجُلًا يَطُوفُ يَحْمِلُ أُمَّهُ وَيَقُولُ: " إِنِّي مَطِيٌّ لَا أَعْثُرُ إِذِ انْتَفَرَ الرِّجَالُ لَا أَنْفِرُ لِي شَهْرًا فَبِأَيِّ شَخَصٍ مِنْهُمْ بَعْدَ أُمِّي. . فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ: «وَلَا طَلْقَةً مِنْ طَلَائِقِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: Mu'awiyah b. Salih reported to me from al-'Ala' b. al-Harith, who said:
entries.matn_en: “As 'Umar b. al-Khattab was circumambulating the House, he saw a man circling while carrying his mother and reciting: ‘I am a mount that does not stumble; when men scatter, I do not flee. For a month I do not run away. After my mother, which person could I put before her?’ 'Umar said to him: ‘You could not repay even one of her labor pains.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 181
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ شُرَيْحٍ: "
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ امْرَأَةً أَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ عليه السلام فَقَالَتْ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ أُمِّي بَلَغَتِ في السِّنَّ عِنْدِي حَتَّى وَلِيتُ مِنْهَا الَّذِي كَانَتْ وَلِيَتْهُ مِنِّي، وَحَتَّى لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهَا عَيْشٌ إِلَّا دَرِى، وَكُنْتُ أُنَظِّفُهَا مَا يُنَظَّفُ مِنْهُ الصَّبِيُّ، فَهَلْ بَلَغْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِذًا مَا كَانَ؟ قَالَ: «لَا، إِنَّكَ وَلِيتِ مِنْهَا الَّذِي ذَكَرْتِ وَأَنْتِ تُحِبِّينَ الرَّاحَةَ مِنْهَا، وَوَلِيَتْ ذَلِكَ مِنْكِ وَهِيَ تُحِبُّ بَقَاءَكِ» قَالَ أَبُو شُرَيْحٍ: وَسَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ قَالَ لِبَعْضِ مَنْ يَقُولُ فِي نَحْوِ ذَلِكَ: وَلَا طَلْقَةً مِنْ طَلَائِقِهَا "
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Abdur-Rahman b. Shurayh: '
entries.matn_en: A woman came to the Prophet, ﷺ, and said 'O Messenger of God, my mother has reached such an age with me that I have taken care of her as she took care of me. She has no life except through me, and I clean her as one cleans a child. Have I fulfilled what was required, O Messenger of God?' He said: 'No, you have taken care of her as you mentioned while wishing for rest from her, and she took care of you while wishing for your survival.' Abu Shurayh said: I heard Ibn Umar b. al-Khattab say to some who said something similar: 'Not even a single favor from her.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 182
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي شَبِيبُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: "
entries.matn_ar: مَرَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أُبَيٍّ ابْنِ سَلُولَ وَهُوَ فِي ظِلِّ أَجَمَةٍ، فَقَالَ: قَدْ غَبَّرَ عَلَيْنَا ابْنُ أَبِي كَبْشَةَ، فَقَالَ ابْنُهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: وَالَّذِي هُوَ أَكْرَمَكَ وَأَنْزَلَ عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ، لَوْ شِئْتَ لَآتِيَنَّكَ بِرَأْسِهِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام: «لَا، وَلَكِنْ بِرَّ أَبَاكَ»
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Shabib b. Sa'id, from Muhammad b. Amr b. Alqamah, from Abu Salamah b. Abdur-Rahman, from Abu Hurayrah, who said '
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God, ﷺ, passed by Abdullah b. Ubayy b. Salul while he was in the shade of a thicket. He said: 'The son of Abu Kabshah has wearied us.' His son, Abdullah b. Abdullah, said: 'By the One who honored you and revealed the Book to you, if you wish, I will bring you his head.' The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: 'No, but be dutiful to your father.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 183
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سَلْمَانَ الْحَجْرِيُّ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْهَادِ، عَنْ ثَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ أَبِي مَالِكٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: دَعَا عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ الْأَحْبَارَ يَوْمًا ودَعَا أَبَا مَالِكٍ مَعَهُمْ، فَقَالَ لَهُمْ عُمَرُ: تَحَدَّثُوا، فَقَالَ أَبُو مَالِكٍ: هَلْ مِنْ عَمِلٍ تَعْلَمُونَهُ مَنْ عَمِلَ بِهِ زِيدَ فِي عُمُرِهِ؟، قَالُوا: لَا، فَدَعَا أَبُو مَالِكٍ بِسِفْرٍ فَفَتَحَهُ، ثُمَّ وَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَى أَحْرُفٍ مِنْهُ فَقَالَ: أَتَعْرِفُونَ مَا فَوْقَ يَدِي؟، قَالُوا: نَعَمْ. قَالَ: أَتَعْرِفُونَ مَا تَحْتَ يَدِي؟ قَالُوا: نَعَمْ، فَرَفَعَ يَدَهُ قَالَ: اقْرَأُوا، فَإِذَا فِيهِ: «مَنْ بَرَّ وَالِدَهُ زِيدَ فِي عُمُرِهِ» قَالَ: تَعْرِفُونَ هَذَا؟ قَالُوا: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: «نَشْهَدُ أَنَّ هَذَا مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ، وَاللَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا هَذَا قَطُّ قَبْلَ الْيَوْمِ»
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Abdur-Rahman b. Salman al-Hajri, from Ibn al-Had, from Tha'labah b. Abi Malik, who said
entries.matn_en: Umar b. al-Khattab called the rabbis one day and called Abu Malik with them. Umar said to them: 'Speak.' Abu Malik said: 'Is there any deed you know of that, if a person does it, their lifespan will be increased?' They said: 'No.' Abu Malik called for a book, opened it, placed his hand on some of its letters, and said: 'Do you recognize what is above my hand?' They said: 'Yes.' He said: 'Do you recognize what is below my hand?' They said: 'Yes.' He lifted his hand and said: 'Read.' It said: 'Whoever is dutiful to his parent, his lifespan will be increased.' He said: 'Do you recognize this?' They said: 'Yes.' He said: 'We testify that this is from God, and by God, we did not know this before today.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 184
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ ابْنُ الْهَادِ: وَبَلَغَنِي أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ عليه السلام قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: بُعْدًا لِرَجُلٍ أَدْرَكَ أَبَوَيْهِ، أَوْ أَحَدَهُمَا، ثُمَّ لَمْ يَبِرَّهُمَا فَيُدْخِلَاهُ الْجَنَّةَ»
entries.matn_en: Ibn al-Had said: It reached me that the Prophet, ﷺ, said: “May a man be disgraced who lives to see both his parents, or even one of them, yet fails to treat them dutifully and thereby enter Paradise through them.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 186
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ كَعْبِ الْأَحْبَارِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنِ الْعُقُوقِ، فَقَالَ: «إِذَا أَمَرَكَ أَبَوَاكَ فَلَمْ تُطِعْهُمَا فَقَدْ عَقَقْتَهُمَا، وَإِذَا دَعَوْا عَلَيْكَ فَقَدْ عَقَقْتَهُمَا الْعُقُوقَ كُلَّهُ»
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Ya'qub b. Abdur-Rahman, from Abu Hazim, from Ata b. Yasar, from Ka'b al-Ahbar,
entries.matn_en: that he was asked about disobedience. He said 'When your parents command you and you do not obey them, you have disobeyed them. And when they curse you, you have fully disobeyed them.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 187
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنِ الثَّوْرِيِّ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ الْحَلَبِيِّ، قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ عَطَاءَ بْنَ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، عَنِ "
entries.matn_ar: اللَّيْلَةِ الْمَطِيرَةِ الْمُظْلِمَةِ، أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَخْرُجَ، فَأُصَلِّيَ فِي الْجَمَاعَةِ، فَتَقُولُ وَالِدَتِي: لَا تَخْرُجْ، صَلِّ فِي بَيْتِكَ. قَالَ: أَطِعْهَا "
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Abdur-Rahman b. Mahdi, from al-Thawri, from Ya'qub al-Halabi, who said I asked Ata b. Abi Rabah about '
entries.matn_en: a rainy, dark night when I want to go out to pray in congregation, but my mother tells me not to go out and to pray at home.' He said: 'Obey her.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 189
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنِ الثَّوْرِيِّ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، فِي هَذِهِ الْآيَةِ: " {وَاخْفِضْ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ الذُّلِّ مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ} [الإسراء: 24] " قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا تَمْتَنِعْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ أَحَبَّاهُ»
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Ibn Mahdi, from al-Thawri, from Hisham b. Urwah, from his father, regarding the verse: {And lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy} [Al-Isra: 24], who said '
entries.matn_en: Do not refuse anything they love.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 190
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الْعَوَّامِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ: " يَدْعُونِي أَبِي وَقَدْ أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ، قَالَ: أَطِعْ أَبَاكَ "
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Sufyan b. Uyaynah, from al-Awwam b. Hawshab, from Mujahid,
entries.matn_en: that a man asked him: 'My father calls me while the prayer has been established.' He said 'Obey your father.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 191
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وحَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنِ الثَّوْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي رَبِيعٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ: "
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ: " يَدْعُونِي أَبِي وَقَدْ أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ، قَالَ: أَجِبْهُ "
entries.isnad_en: And he narrated to me from Ibn Mahdi, from al-Thawri, from Abu Rabi', from Mujahid: '
entries.matn_en: A man asked him: 'My father calls me while the prayer has been established.' He said 'Answer him.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 191
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِي عَنِ الْحَسَنِ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنْ بِرِّ الْوَالِدَيْنِ قَالَ: «أَنْ تَبْذُلَ لَهُمَا مَا مَلَكْتَ وَتُطِيعَهُمَا فِيمَا أَمَرَاكَ مَا لَمْ تَكُنْ مَعْصِيَةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: It reached me that al-Hasan
entries.matn_en: was asked about being dutiful to parents. He said 'Give them what you possess and obey them in what they command you, as long as it is not disobedience to God.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 192
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنِ الثَّوْرِيِّ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: مَا بَرَّ وَالِدَهُ مَنْ شَدَّ النَّظَرَ إِلَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Ibn Mahdi, from al-Thawri, from Mu'awiyah b. Ishaq, from Urwah b. al-Zubayr, who said '
entries.matn_en: Whoever glares at his parent has not been dutiful to him.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 193
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُوقَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ حَفْصٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ عليه السلام فَقَالَ: " يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّي أَذْنَبْتُ ذَنْبًا عَظِيمًا، فَقَالَ: «هَلْ لَكَ مِنْ وَالِدَةٍ؟» قَالَ: لَا. قَالَ: «هَلْ لَكَ مِنْ خَالَةٍ؟» قَالَ: نَعَمْ قَالَ: «فَبِرَّهَا»
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Ibn Mahdi, from Sufyan, from Muhammad b. Suqah, from Abu Bakr b. Hafs, who said
entries.matn_en: A man came to the Prophet, ﷺ, and said: 'O Messenger of God, I have committed a great sin.' He said: 'Do you have a mother?' He said: 'No.' He said: 'Do you have a maternal aunt?' He said: 'Yes.' He said: 'Then be dutiful to her.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 195
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ زَاذَانَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قُلْتُ لِلْحَسَنِ: يَا أَبَا سَعِيدٍ إِلَى مَا يَنْتَهِي عُقُوقُ الْوَالِدَيْنِ؟ قَالَ: «تُحَرِّمُهُمَا وَتَهْجُرُهُمَا» قَالَ شَيْخٌ: لَا. فَقَالَ لَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ وَسَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ: يَا أَبَا سَعِيدٍ، دُعَاءُ الْوَالِدِ لِوَلَدِهِ، قَالَ: نَجَاةٌ. قَالَ: دُعَاؤُهُ عَلَيْهِ اسْتِئْصَالُهُ
entries.isnad_en: And he narrated to me from Ibn Mahdi, from Umarah b. Zadhan, who said
entries.matn_en: I said to al-Hasan: 'O Abu Sa'id, to what extent does disobedience to parents go?' He said: 'You abandon them and desert them.' An elder said: 'No.' Abdullah b. Sa'id said: I heard al-Hasan, and a man asked him: 'O Abu Sa'id, what about a parent's supplication for their child?' He said: 'It is salvation.' He said: 'And their supplication against him?' He said: 'It is destruction.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 196
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ مُوَرِّقٍ الْعِجْلِيِّ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: هَلْ تَعْلَمُونَ نَفَقَةً أَفْضَلَ مِنْ نَفَقَةٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ؟» . قَالُوا: اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ. قَالَ: «نَعَمْ، نَفَقَةٌ عَلَى الْوَالِدَيْنِ؛ فَإِنَّ دُعَاءَهُمَا بِالْخَيْرِ يُنْبِتُ الْأَصْلَ وَيُنْبِتُ الْفَرْعَ، وَإِنَّ دُعَاءَهُمَا بِالشَّرِّ يُيْبِسُ الْأَصْلَ»
entries.isnad_en: And he narrated to me from Ibn Mahdi, from Muhammad b. Sulaym, from Muwarriq al-Ijli, from the Messenger of God, ﷺ, who said '
entries.matn_en: Do you know of any expenditure better than spending in the way of God?' They said: 'God and His Messenger know best.' He said: 'Yes, spending on one's parents, for their supplication for good nurtures the root and the branch, and their supplication for evil dries up the root.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 197
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي مَسْلَمَةُ بْنُ عُلَيٍّ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، يَرْفَعُهُ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: ثُلُثَا الْبِرِّ لِلْأُمِّ» قَالَ:
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: Maslamah b. 'Ulayy reported to me from Hisham b. Hassan, from al-Hasan,
entries.matn_en: attributing it to the Prophet: “Two-thirds of dutifulness belongs to the mother.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 199
entries.isnad_ar: وَحَدَّثَنِي مَسْلَمَةُ، عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: بِنَحْوِ ذَلِكَ
entries.isnad_en: Maslamah reported to me from al-Awza'i, from Yahya b. Abi Kathir,
entries.matn_en: with a similar report.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 200
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي هِلَالٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: بَلَغَنِي «أَنَّ الْوَلَدَ، لَيَبَرُّ وَالِدَهُ وَقَدْ مَاتَ بِالدُّعَاءِ لَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahi'ah reported to me from Khalid b. Yazid, from Ibn Abi Hilal, who said:
entries.matn_en: “It has reached me that a child can show dutifulness to a parent even after the parent’s death by praying for him.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 201
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ الْعُلَمَاءَ كَانُوا يَقُولُونَ: «حَقُّ الْأُمِّ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ حَقِّ الْأَبِ، وَلِكُلٍّ حَقٌّ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahi'ah reported to me from Yazid b. Abi Habib
entries.matn_en: that the scholars used to say: “A mother’s right takes precedence over a father’s, though each has a right.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 201
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَامِرٍ الأسُّلَمِيُّ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، كَانَ يَقُولُ: «
entries.matn_ar: مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ مُسْلِمٍ يَكُونُ عِنْدَهُ أَبَوَاهُ فَيَبِرُّهُمَا إِلَّا فَتَحَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بَابَيْنِ مِنْ أَبْوَابِ الْجَنَّةِ، فَإِذَا هَلَكَ أَحَدُهُمَا أُغِلَقَ أَحَدُ الْبَابَيْنِ وَإِذَا هَلَكَا جَمِيعًا غُلِّقَا جَمِيعًا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd Allah b. 'Amir al-Aslami reported to me
entries.matn_en: that Abu Hurayrah used to say: “Any Muslim who has both parents alive and treats them dutifully will have two gates of Paradise opened for him. If one parent dies, one gate closes; if both die, both gates close.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 202
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِلَالٍ، قَالَ: إِنَّ كَعْبًا قَالَ: "
entries.matn_ar: وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَيُعَجِّلُ حِينَ الْعَبْدِ إِذَا كَانَ الْعَبْدُ عَاقًّا لِوَالِدَيْهِ لِيُعَجِّلَ لَهُ الْعَذَابَ، وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لِيَزِيدُ فِي عُمُرِ الْعَبْدِ إِذَا كَانَ بَارًّا بِوَالِدَيْهِ لِيَزْدَادَ بِرًّا وَخَيْرًا. وَقَالَ كَعْبٌ: أَجِدُ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ أَنَّهُ إِذَا دَعَاهُ فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ فَقَدْ عَقَّهُ، وَإِذَا أَلْجَأَهُ إِلَى أَنْ يَدْعُوَ عَلَيْهِ وَيَبْكِيَ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنْهُ فِيمَا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَهُ فَقَدْ عَقَّهُ كُلَّ الْعُقُوقِ، وَإِذَا ائْتَمَنَهُ فَخَانَهُ فَقَدْ عَقَّهُ، وَإِذَا سَأَلَهُ مِمَّا يَقْدِرُ عَلَيْهِ فَمَنَعَهُ فَقَدْ عَقَّهُ "
entries.isnad_en: 'Amr b. al-Harith reported to me from Sa'id ibn Abi Hilal, who said that Ka'b said:
entries.matn_en: “By the One in whose hand is my soul, God hastens punishment for a servant who is undutiful to his parents; and God extends the life of a servant who is dutiful to them so that he may grow in righteousness and good. Ka'b also said: ‘I find in God’s Book that if a parent calls to him and he does not answer, he has been undutiful. If he drives a parent to pray against him and complain to God about him, he has committed the fullest disobedience. If a parent entrusts him with something and he betrays that trust, he has been undutiful; and if a parent asks him for something he can afford and he refuses, he has been undutiful.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 203
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ الزَّبَّانِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعْتُ عَطَاءَ بْنَ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ وَاسْتَفْتَاهُ رَجُلٌ، فَقَالَ: " إِنَّ أُمِّي أَمَرْتَنِي بِطَلَاقِ امْرَأَتِي، فَزَعَمَتْ أَنَّهُ لَا يُرْضِيهَا إِلَّا ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ: «اتَّقِ اللَّهَ فِي أُمِّكَ، وَلَا تُفَارِقِ امْرَأَتَكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahi'ah reported to me from Mu'awiyah b. al-Zabban, who said:
entries.matn_en: “I heard 'Ata b. Abi Rabah when a man sought his legal opinion: ‘My mother ordered me to divorce my wife, claiming that nothing else would satisfy her.’ 'Ata replied: ‘Fear God regarding your mother, but do not leave your wife.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 204
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِلَالٍ، أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ "
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ أَوَّلَ، شَيْءٍ نَزَلَ مِنَ اللَّهِ عَلَى مُوسَى: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ، هَذَا كِتَابُ اللَّهِ فِي الْأَلْوَاحِ بِيَدِهِ لِعَبْدِهِ مُوسَى، عَبْدِي لَا تُشْرِكْ بِي شَيْئًا، وَلَا تَحْلِفْ بِاسْمِي كَاذِبًا فَإِنِّي لَا أُزَكِّي وَلَا أَرْحَمُ مَنْ يَحْلِفُ بِاسْمِي كَاذِبًا. قَالَ: يَا رَبِّ أَوْصِنِي قَالَ: أُوصِيكَ بِأُمِّكَ، قَالَ: يَا رَبِّ أَوْصِنِي. قَالَ: أُوصِيكَ بِأُمِّكَ، قَالَ: يَا رَبِّ أَوْصِنِي، قَالَ: أُوصِيكَ بِأُمِّكَ، قَالَ: يَا رَبِّ أَوْصِنِي، قَالَ : أُوصِيكَ بِأَبِيكَ، قَالَ: يَا رَبِّ أَوْصِنِي قَالَ: أُوصِيكَ بِبَنِي جِنْسِكَ كُلِّهِمْ، قَالَ: وَكَيْفَ أَسْتَوْصِي بِبَنِي جِنْسِي كُلِّهِمْ؟ قَالَ: تُحِبُّ لَهُمْ مَا تُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِكَ، وَتَكْرَهُ لَهُمْ مَا تَكْرَهُ لِنَفْسِكَ "
entries.isnad_en: 'Amr b. al-Harith reported to me from Sa'id ibn Abi Hilal, who said:
entries.matn_en: “It reached him that the first thing God revealed to Moses was: ‘In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. This is God’s Book on the Tablets, in His hand, for His servant Moses: My servant, do not associate anything with Me, and do not swear falsely by My name, for I neither purify nor show mercy to one who swears falsely by My name.’ Moses said: ‘My Lord, counsel me.’ He replied: ‘I counsel you concerning your mother.’ Moses asked again, and He repeated the counsel about his mother twice more. Moses asked again; He said: ‘I counsel you concerning your father.’ Moses asked again; He said: ‘I counsel you concerning all your fellow human beings.’ Moses asked: ‘How can I care for all my fellow human beings?’ He replied: ‘Wish for them what you wish for yourself, and dislike for them what you dislike for yourself.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 205
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَتْنِي عَمْرَةُ ابْنَةُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام قَالَ: "
entries.matn_ar: بَيْنَمَا أَنَا نَائِمٌ رَأَيْتُنِي فِي الْجَنَّةِ، فَسَمِعْتُ صَوْتَ قَارِئٍ يَقْرَأُ، فَقُلْتُ: مَنْ هَذَا؟ فَقَالَ: هَذَا حَارِثَةُ بْنُ النُّعْمَانِ، كَذَلِكَ الْبِرُّ، كَذَلِكَ الْبِرُّ، كَذَلِكَ الْبِرُّ، وَكَانَ حَارِثَةُ أَبَرَّ هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةِ بِأُمِّهِ "
entries.isnad_en: Yunus b. Yazid reported to me from Ibn Shihab, who said: 'Amrah bint 'Abd al-Rahman told me that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said:
entries.matn_en: “While I was asleep, I saw myself in Paradise and heard someone reciting. I asked, ‘Who is that?’ It was said: ‘That is Harithah b. al-Nu'man.’ Such is dutifulness; such is dutifulness; such is dutifulness. Harithah was the most dutiful of this community to his mother.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 207
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ الثَّوْرِيُّ، وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ مِنَ الْكَبَائِرِ أَنْ يَسُبَّ الرَّجُلُ وَالِدَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan al-Thawri and Ibrahim b. Sa'd reported to us from Sa'd b. Ibrahim, from Humayd b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Awf, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr b. al-'As, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said:
entries.matn_en: “Among the gravest sins is for a man to revile his parents.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 209
entries.isnad_ar: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، قَالَ: "
entries.matn_ar: كُنْتُ أَسْمَعُ أَنَّ الْبِرَّ، شَيْءٌ هَيِّنٌ: التُّحْفَةُ وَالْكَلَامُ اللِّيِّنُ " قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنِي بَكْرُ بْنُ مُضَرَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، بِذَلِكَ،
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar reported to me from 'Abd al-Rahman b. al-Qasim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “I used to hear that dutifulness is something simple: a gift and gentle speech.” He added: Bakr b. Mudar reported to me the same from 'Amr b. al-Harith.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 209
entries.isnad_ar: وَقَدْ قَالَ حَسَّانُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ فِي ذَلِكَ: [البحر الوافر]
entries.matn_ar: لَعَمْرُ أَبِيكَ مَا رَجُلٌ هَجَانِي … بِبَرِّ الْوَالِدَيْنِ وَلَا رَحِيمِ
entries.matn_en: And Hassan b. Thabit said on this subject: “By your father’s life, no man who reviled me … [could claim] dutifulness to parents or kinship.” [The Arabic poem is incomplete in the source.]

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 210
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي مَخْرَمَةُ بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ أَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِرَاقِ قَتَلَ ابْنَةَ عَمَّةٍ لَهُ يَسْتَفْتِيهِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ: أَلَكَ أُمٌّ؟ قَالَ: لَا. قَالَ: أَلَكَ أُخْتٌ؟ قَالَ: لَا، قَالَ: " إِنَّ أَقْرَبَ الْأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ، أَوْ أَحَبُّ الْأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ بِرُّ الْوَالِدَةِ، ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ الْأُخْتَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ: تُبْ إِلَى اللَّهِ "
entries.isnad_en: Makhramah b. Bukayr reported to me from his father, from Ibn 'Abbas,
entries.matn_en: that a man from Iraq came to him seeking a legal ruling. He had killed a daughter of his paternal aunt. Ibn 'Abbas asked: “Do you have a mother?” He said: “No.” Ibn 'Abbas asked: “Do you have a sister?” He said: “No.” Ibn 'Abbas said: “Among the deeds dearest to God—or nearest to God—is dutifulness to one’s mother.” He then mentioned the sister and said to the man: “Repent to God.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 212
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، بَلَغَنِي عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: رَحِمَ اللَّهُ وَالِدًا أَعَانَ وَلَدَهُ عَلَى بِرِّهِ» ، قَالُوا: كَيْفَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: «يَقْبَلُ إِحْسَانَهُ، وَيَتَجَاوَزُ عَنْ إِسَاءَتِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said It reached me from Ata b. Abi Rabah that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: '
entries.matn_en: May God have mercy on a parent who helps his child to be dutiful to him.' They said: 'How, O Messenger of God?' He said: 'He accepts his good deeds, overlooks his mistakes.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 212
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ لِرَجُلٍ وَهُوَ يَعِظُهُ فِي بِرِّ أَبِيهِ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا تَمْشِ أَمَامَ أَبِيكَ، وَلَا تَجْلِسْ قَبْلَهُ، وَلَا تَدَعُوهُ بِاسْمِهِ، وَلَا تَسْتَسِبَّ لَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Abi al-Zinad reported to me from Hisham b. 'Urwah, from someone who told him, from Abu Hurayrah, who said
entries.matn_en: to a man while advising him to be dutiful to his father: “Do not walk ahead of your father, do not sit before him, do not call him by his name, and do not make yourself a cause of his being insulted.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 214
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الثِّقَةِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا، دَخَلَ عَلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ وَهُوَ يَمْشِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْ أَبِيهِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ: «ارْجِعْ عَنْ ذَلِكَ، لَا تَمْشِ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ سَيِّدِكَ»
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Ibn Abi al-Zinad, from a trustworthy person,
entries.matn_en: that a man entered upon Umar b. Abd al-Aziz while walking ahead of his father. Umar said to him: 'Go back, do not walk ahead of your master.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 215
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي بَكَّارُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ: "
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ مِنَ النَّاسِ ثَلَاثَةً شَرٌّ: رَجُلٌ يَسْعَى فِي فَسَادٍ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ حَتَّى يَفْسَدُوا، وَرَجُلٌ يَتَكَبَّرُ عَلَى وَالِدَيْهِ فَتَكَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِمَا وَتَحَقَّرَهُمَا، وَرَجُلٌ سَعَى فِي فَسَادِ رَجُلٍ وَامْرَأَتِهِ حَتَّى فَرَّقَ بَيْنَهُمَا ثُمَّ خَلَفَ عَلَيْهَا بَعْدَهُ "
entries.isnad_en: Bakkar b. 'Abd Allah reported to me from Musa b. 'Ubaydah, from Ayyub b. Khalid al-Ansari, from Ibn 'Abbas, from 'Umar b. al-Khattab:
entries.matn_en: “Among the worst people are three: a man who stirs up corruption among people until they become corrupt; a man who behaves arrogantly toward his parents and despises them; and a man who works to corrupt a man’s relationship with his wife until he separates them, then marries her after him.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 216
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مُجَمِّعٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عِيَاضٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، يَقُولُ: «
entries.matn_ar: مِنَ الْكَبَائِرِ أَنْ يَسْتَسِبَّ، الرَّجُلُ لِوَالِدَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Qasim b. 'Abd Allah reported to me from Ibrahim b. Isma'il b. Mujamma' al-Ansari, from Muhammad b. al-Harith b. Sufyan, from Ibn 'Iyad, who heard 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr b. al-'As say:
entries.matn_en: “Among the major sins is for a man to make himself a cause of his parents being insulted.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 218
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا حَازِمٍ، حَدَّثَهُ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا جَاءَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام فَقَالَ: " يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، عَمِلْتُ كَذَا وَكَذَا، لِأَعْمَالٍ قَبِيحَةٍ ذَكَرَهَا، فَهَلْ مِنْ تَوْبَةٍ، أَوْ مَا تَأْمُرُنِي؟ قَالَ: «أَبَوَاكَ حَيَّانِ؟» قَالَ: أَحَدُهُمَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: «اجْعَلْهَا أُمَّكَ» ، قَالَ: هِيَ أُمِّي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: «فَاذْهَبْ فَبِرَّهَا»
entries.isnad_en: And Usamah b. Zayd narrated to me that Abu Hazim narrated to him
entries.matn_en: that a man came to the Messenger of God, ﷺ, and said 'O Messenger of God, I have done such and such—evil deeds he mentioned. Is there any repentance, or what do you command me?' He said: 'Are your parents alive?' He said: 'One of them, O Messenger of God.' He said: 'Make it your mother.' He said: 'She is my mother, O Messenger of God.' He said: 'Go and be dutiful to her.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 219
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُ مَالِكَ بْنَ أَنَسٍ،
entries.matn_ar: وَسُئِلَ، عَنِ الَّذِي لَمْ يُدْرِكْ أَبَوَيْهِ أَوْ أَحَدَهُمَا، أَنَّهُ لَا بَأْسَ أَنْ يَقُولَ: " اللَّهُمَّ {ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا} [الإسراء: 24] " قَالَ مَالِكٌ: «وَقَدْ يَكُونُ الرَّجُلُ مَعَ أَبِيهِ لَا يُرَبِّيهِ وَيَغِيبُ عَنْهُ لِلزَّمَانِ الطَّوِيلِ»
entries.matn_en: I heard Malik b. Anas when he was asked about someone who did not live to see his parents, or one of them. He said: “There is no harm in saying: ‘My Lord, have mercy upon them as they raised me when I was small’ [Qur'an 17:24].” Malik added: “A man may live with his father without caring for him, and may be away from him for a long time.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 219
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُ سُفْيَانَ بْنَ عُيَيْنَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي حَفْصَةَ ، عَنْ مُنْذِرٍ الثَّوْرِيِّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ ابْنِ الْحَنَفِيَّةِ، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُمَشِّطُ أُمَّهُ وَيُدَرِّيهَا»
entries.isnad_en: I heard Sufyan b. 'Uyaynah narrate from Salim b. Abi Hafsah, from Mundhir al-Thawri, from Muhammad b. al-Hanafiyyah,
entries.matn_en: that he used to comb and groom his mother’s hair with a midra (a long comb or hair pick).

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 220
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُ سُفْيَانَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قَابُوسَ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ: «
entries.matn_ar: الرَّاحِمُونَ يَرْحَمُهُمُ اللَّهُ، ارْحَمُوا أَهْلَ الْأَرْضِ يَرْحَمْكُمْ أَهْلُ السَّمَاءِ، الرَّحِمُ شُجْنَةٌ مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ، مَنْ قَطَعَهَا قَطَعَهُ اللَّهُ، وَمَنْ وَصَلَهَا وَصَلَهُ اللَّهُ»
entries.isnad_en: And I heard Sufyan narrate from Amr b. Dinar, from Abu Qabus, from Abdullah b. Amr b. al-As, from the Messenger of God, ﷺ, that he used to say: '
entries.matn_en: The merciful will be shown mercy by God. Show mercy to the people of the earth, and the people of the heavens will show mercy to you. Kinship is a branch from the Merciful. Whoever severs it, God will sever him, and whoever maintains it, God will maintain him.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 223
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُ سُفْيَانَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ ابْنَةِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: "
entries.matn_ar: دَخَلْتُ الْجَنَّةَ فَسَمِعْتُ فِيهَا قِرَاءَةً، قُلْتُ: مَنْ هَذَا؟ " فَقَالُوا: حَارِثَةُ بْنُ النُّعْمَانِ كَذَلِكُمُ الْبِرُّ، كَذَلِكُمُ الْبِرُّ "
entries.isnad_en: And I heard Sufyan narrate from Ibn Shihab, from Amrah bint Abdur-Rahman, from Aisha, the wife of the Prophet, from the Messenger of God, ﷺ, who said '
entries.matn_en: I entered Paradise and heard recitation in it. I said: Who is this? They said: Harithah b. al-Nu'man. Such is goodness, such is goodness.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 224
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلَالٍ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ أَبِي مُزَرِّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْحُبَابِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام قَالَ: "
entries.matn_ar: خَلَقَ اللَّهُ الْخَلْقَ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ مِنْهُ قَامَتِ الرَّحِمُ، فَقَالَ: مَهْ، قَالَتْ: هَذَا مَقَامُ الْعَائِذِ بِكَ مِنَ الْقَطِيعَةِ، فَقَالَ: نَعَمْ، أَلَا تَرْضَيْنَ أَنْ أَصِلَ مَنْ وَصَلَكِ، وَأَقْطَعَ مَنْ قَطَعَكِ؟ قَالَتْ: بَلَى. قَالَ: فَذَلِكَ لَكِ " ثُمَّ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ: فَاقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ " {فَهَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ إِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ أَنْ تُفْسِدُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوا أَرْحَامَكُمْ} [محمد: 22] "
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Sulayman b. Bilal, from Mu'awiyah b. Abi Muzarrid, from Abu al-Hubab Sa'id ibn Yasar, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: God created the creation, and when He finished, kinship stood up and said: This is the position of the one seeking refuge with You from being severed. He said: Yes, are you not pleased that I maintain whoever maintains you and sever whoever severs you? She said: Yes. He said: That is for you.' Then Abu Hurayrah said: 'Recite if you wish: {Would you then, if you were given the authority, do mischief in the land, and sever your ties of kinship?} [Muhammad: 22].'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 226
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلَالٍ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ أَبِي مُزَرِّدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ رُومَانَ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ عليه السلام أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: الرَّحِمُ شُجْنَةٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ، مَنْ وَصَلَهَا وَصَلَهُ اللَّهُ، وَمَنْ قَطَعَهَا قَطَعَهُ اللَّهُ»
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Sulayman b. Bilal, from Mu'awiyah b. Abi Muzarrid, from Yazid b. Ruman, from Urwah b. al-Zubayr, from Aisha, the wife of the Prophet, ﷺ, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: Kinship is a branch from God. Whoever maintains it, God will maintain him, and whoever severs it, God will sever him.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 228
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلَالٍ، عَنِ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ هَانِئٍ، مَوْلَى عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ ذَبَحَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ، لَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ تَوَلَّى غَيْرَ مَوَالِيهِ، لَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ غَيَّرَ حُدُودَ اللَّهِ، لَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ عَقَّ وَالِدَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Sulayman b. Bilal, from al-Ala b. Abdur-Rahman, from his father, from Hani, the freed slave of Ali b. Abi Talib, from the Messenger of God, ﷺ, who said '
entries.matn_en: God has cursed whoever slaughters for other than God, whoever takes as allies other than his masters, whoever changes the boundaries of God, and whoever disobeys his parents.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 230
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ عُقَيْلِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام قَالَ لِعُرْوَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ الثَّقَفِيِّ حِينَ بَعَثَتْهُ إِلَيْهِ قُرَيْشٌ بِالْحُدَيْبِيَةِ: " يَا عُرْوَةُ، أَلِلْقَوْمِ رَحِمٌ لَيْسَتْ لِي؟ قَالَ: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَنْهَى عَنْ عُقُوقِ الْأُمَّهَاتِ، وَوَأْدِ الْبَنَاتِ، وَمَنْعٍ وَهَاتِ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْغَنِيَّ الْخَفِيَّ الْخَيِّرَ التَّقِيَّ، وَيُبْغِضُ الْفَاحِشَ الْبَذِيءَ السَّؤُولَ الْمِلْحَافَ "
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Ibn Lahi'ah, from Jabir b. Ismail, from Uqayl b. Khalid, from Ibn Shihab,
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said to Urwah b. Mas'ud al-Thaqafi when the Quraysh sent him during the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah: 'O Urwah, do these people have kinship with you that I do not have?' He said: 'God forbids disobedience to mothers, the burying alive of daughters, and withholding and demanding. God loves the wealthy, the hidden, the good, the pious, and He detests the obscene, the vulgar, the persistent beggar.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 232
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِلَالٍ، قَالَ: "
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ يَدْخُلُ عَلَى أُمِّهِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ فَيَقُولُ: جَزَاكِ اللَّهُ يَا أُمِّ خَيْرًا كَمَا رَبَّيْتِنِي صَغِيرًا. قَالَ: وَتَقُولُ هِيَ: جَزَاكَ اللَّهَ يَا بُنَيَّ خَيْرًا كَمَا بَرَرْتَنِي كَبِيرًا "
entries.isnad_en: And he narrated to me from Ibn Lahi'ah, from Khalid b. Yazid, from Sa'id ibn Abi Hilal, who said '
entries.matn_en: Abu Hurayrah used to visit his mother every day and say: May God reward you with good, O mother, as you raised me when I was small. She would say: May God reward you with good, my son, as you were dutiful to me when I was old.'

sections.title_en: Brotherhood for the Sake of Allah

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 234
entries.isnad_ar: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُوقَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: مَا أَحْدَثَ عَبْدٌ أَخًا يُؤَاخِيهِ فِي اللَّهِ إِلَّا رَفَعَهُ اللَّهُ بِهِ دَرَجَةً» . فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُنَافِقِينَ فِي نَفْسِهِ: وَمَا دَرَجَةٌ رَفَعَهَا رَجُلٌ أَوْ وَضَعَهَا؟، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام: «لَيْسَتْ بِدَرَجَةِ عَتَبَةِ بَيْتِ أُمِّكَ، وَلَكِنَّهَا دَرَجَةٌ كَمَا بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ» قَالَ:
entries.isnad_en: And he narrated to me from Abdur-Rahman b. Zayd b. Aslam, from Muhammad b. Suqah, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: No servant forms a brotherhood for the sake of God except that God raises him a degree because of it.' A man from the hypocrites said to himself: What is a degree that a man is raised or lowered? The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: 'It is not the step of your mother's house, but it is a degree as between the heaven and the earth.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 235
entries.isnad_ar: وَأَخْبَرَنِيهِ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ عليه السلام
entries.matn_ar: مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Zayd reported it to me from his father, from the Prophet, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: with a report to the same effect.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 235
entries.isnad_ar: وَسَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ، مِنْهُمْ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ "
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ مُسْلِمٌ إِذَا قَدِمَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ قَبَّلَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ وَيَقُولُ: شَيْخٌ يُقَبِّلُ شَيْخًا "
entries.isnad_en: I heard 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar narrate from a man among
entries.matn_en: them, from 'Asim b. 'Ubayd God, who said: “When Muslim returned from a journey, 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar would kiss him and say: ‘An elder is kissing an elder.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 236
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُهُ أَيْضًا، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام أَكَبَّ عَلَى عُثْمَانَ بْنِ مَظْعُونٍ فَقَبَّلَهُ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهِ، وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَرَوْنَ الدُّمُوعَ تَسِيلُ مِنْ عَيْنِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى وَجْهِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ مَظْعُونٍ»
entries.isnad_en: I also heard him
entries.matn_en: narrate from 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, from 'Asim b. 'Ubayd God, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, leaned over 'Uthman b. Maz'un and kissed him after his death. They saw tears flowing from the Messenger’s eyes over 'Uthman b. Maz'un’s face.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 236
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ: حِينَ مَاتَ ابْنُ مَظْعُونٍ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ عليه السلام: «
entries.matn_ar: هَذَا فَرَطُ هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةِ»
entries.matn_en: 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar said: “When Ibn Maz'un died, the Prophet, ﷺ, said: ‘He is the forerunner of this community.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 236
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: "
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقَ دَخَلَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام حِينَ تُوُفِّيَ وَهُوَ مُسَجًّى بِثَوْبٍ، فَكَشَفَ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ، ثُمَّ قَبَّلَ بَيْنَ عَيْنَيْهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «لَا يَجْمَعُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ بُؤْسًا أَبَدًا»
entries.matn_en: 'Abd Allah said: “When Abu Bakr al-Siddiq entered upon the Messenger of God, ﷺ, after he had died and was covered with a cloth, he uncovered his face, kissed him between the eyes, and said: ‘May God never bring you hardship again.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 238
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، يُحَدِّثُ قَالَ: بَلَغَنِي "
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام كَانَ يُصَافِحُ
entries.isnad_en: I heard 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar narrate:
entries.matn_en: “It reached me that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, used to shake hands …” [The Arabic source breaks off here.]

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 238
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو شُرَيْحٍ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، مِنَ الْمَعَافِرِ قَالَ : «
entries.matn_ar: الْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌ يَقْضِي بَعْضُهُمْ حَاجَاتِ بَعْضٍ، فَيَقْضِي بَعْضُهُمْ حَاجَاتِ بَعْضٍ، قَضَى اللَّهُ حَاجَاتِهِمْ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Shurayh reported to me from a man of the Ma'afir, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Believers are brothers; some fulfill one another’s needs, and God fulfills their needs.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 239
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَبْدَةَ بْنِ أَبِي لُبَابَةَ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: "
entries.matn_ar: إِذَا تَرَاءَا الْمُتَحَابَّانِ فِي اللَّهِ فَمَشَى أَحَدُهُمَا إِلَى صَاحِبِهِ فَأَخَذَ بِيَدِهِ، ثُمَّ ضَحِكَ إِلَيْهِ تَحَاتَّتْ خَطَايَاهُمَا كَمَا تَحَاتُّ وَرَقُ الشَّجَرِ. قَالَ: قُلْتُ: إِنَّ هَذَا لَيَسِيرٌ. قَالَ: لَا تَقُلْ ذَلِكَ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ: {لَوْ أَنْفَقْتَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مَا أَلَّفْتَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ، وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ أَلَّفَ بَيْنَهُمْ، إِنَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ} [الأنفال: 63] "
entries.isnad_en: Al-Awza'i reported to me from 'Abdah b. Abi Lubabah, from Mujahid, who said:
entries.matn_en: “When two people who love one another for God’s sake meet, and one walks to the other, takes his hand, and smiles at him, their sins fall away like leaves falling from a tree.” I said: “That seems easy.” He replied: “Do not say that: God says, ‘Had you spent all that is on earth, you could not have united their hearts; but God united them. He is Almighty, All-Wise’ [Qur'an 8:63].”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 240
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «
entries.matn_ar: يَزُورُ الْأَعْلَوْنَ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ الْأَسْفَلِينَ، وَلَا يَزُورُ الْأَسْفَلُونَ الْأَعْلَيِينَ إِلَّا مَنْ كَانَ يَزُورُ فِي اللَّهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا، فَذَلِكَ يَزُورُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ حَيْثُ يَشَاءُ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Awza'i reported to me from Yahya b. Abi Kathir, who said that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said:
entries.matn_en: “The people of the higher ranks in Paradise visit those below them. Those below do not visit those above them, except for one who used to visit others for God’s sake in this world; that person may visit wherever he wishes in Paradise.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 241
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ شُرَحْبِيلَ بْنِ شَرِيكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيِّ، عَنْ الصُّنَابِحِيّ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ دَعْوَةَ الْأَخِ فِي اللَّهِ تُسْتَجَابُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahi'ah reported to me from Shurahbil b. Sharik, from Abu 'Abd al-Rahman al-Hubuli, from al-Sunabihi, from Abu Bakr al-Siddiq, who said:
entries.matn_en: “A brother’s supplication for God’s sake is answered.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 242
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي مَسْلَمَةُ بْنُ عُلَيٍّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ، يَرْفَعُهُ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يَزُورُ أَخَاهُ فِي اللَّهِ إِلَّا أَكْرَمَ رَبَّهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Maslamah b. 'Ulayy reported to me from Yahya b. al-Harith, from al-Qasim b. 'Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Umamah,
entries.matn_en: attributing it to the Prophet, ﷺ: “Whenever a servant visits his brother for God’s sake, he honors his Lord.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 245
entries.isnad_ar: وَأَخْبَرَنِي مَنْ، سَمِعَ يَزِيدَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَلْحَلَةَ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَدْخُلُ مَسْجِدَ حِمْصَ فَيَرَى أَهْلَ مَجْلِسٍ كُهُولًا، وَغُلَامًا أَكْحَلَ الْعَيْنَيْنِ، بَرَّاقَ الثَّنَايَا، يَتَنَازَعُونَ الْتِمَاسَ الْفِقْهِ بِغَيْرِ مِرًى، فَإِذَا أَشْكَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ شَيْءٌ نَظَرُوا إِلَى الْغُلَامِ، فَمَا قَالَ: انْتَهَوْا إِلَيْهِ، فَأَعْجَبَنِي ذَلِكَ مِنْ شَأْنِهِمْ وَأَلِفْتُهُمْ، وَسَأَلْتُ عَنِ الْغُلَامِ فَإِذَا هُوَ مُعَاذُ بْنُ جَبَلٍ، فَارْتَفَعَ أَصْحَابُهُ فَقَعَدْتُ إِلَيْهِ، فَقُلْتُ: مُعَاذَ بْنَ جَبَلٍ، إِنِّي لَأُحِبُّكَ لِلَّهِ، قَالَ: لَئِنْ كُنْتَ صَادِقًا لَقَدْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام يَقُولُ: «إِنَّ الْمُتَحَابِّينَ فِي اللَّهِ، أَوْ جَلَالِ اللَّهِ عَلَى مَنَابِرَ مِنْ نُورٍ فِي ظِلِّ الْعَرْشِ عَلَى يَمِينِ الرَّحْمَنِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Someone who had heard Yazid b. Muhammad reported to me from Muhammad b. 'Amr b. Halhalah, from Shahr b. Hawshab, who said:
entries.matn_en: “I used to enter the mosque of Hims and see a group of middle-aged men and a youth with dark, kohl-lined eyes and gleaming front teeth. They would discuss jurisprudence without disputing. Whenever something puzzled them, they looked to the youth; whatever he said, they accepted. I admired their conduct and grew attached to them. I asked about the youth and learned that he was Mu'adh b. Jabal. When his companions left, I sat with him and said: ‘Mu'adh b. Jabal, I love you for God’s sake.’ He replied: ‘If you are sincere, I have heard the Messenger of God, ﷺ, say: “Those who love one another for God’s sake—or for His majesty—will be on pulpits of light in the shade of the Throne, to the right of the All-Merciful, on the Day of Resurrection.”’” [The source text breaks off after this report.]

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 248
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي فَقِيهٍ: «
entries.matn_ar: عَنْهُمْ سَوَاءٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: Ibn Lahi'ah reported to me from Ibn Abi Faqih:
entries.matn_en: “The same applies to them.” [The Arabic is an incomplete fragment.]

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 248
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ قَوْذَرٍ، عَنْ كَعْبٍ، قَالَ: "
entries.matn_ar: رُبَّ قَائِمٍ مَشْكُورٍ لَهُ، وَرُبَّ نَائِمٍ مَغْفُورٍ لَهُ، وَذَلِكَ أَنَّ الرَّجُلَيْنِ يَتَحَابَّانِ فِي اللَّهِ فَقَامَ أَحَدُهُمَا يُصَلِّي فَرَدَّ اللَّهُ صَلَاتَهُ، وَدَعَاهُ فَلَمْ يَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ دُعَائِهِ شَيْئًا، فَذَكَرَ أَخَاهُ فِي دُعَائِهِ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ، فَقَالَ: يَا رَبِّ أَخِي فُلَانٌ اغْفِرْ لَهُ، فَغَفَرَ لَهُ وَهُوَ نَائِمٌ. قَالَ كَعْبٌ: إِنَّ الْمُتَحَابِّينَ فِي اللَّهِ عَلَى عَمَدٍ مِنْ يَاقُوتٍ أَحْمَرَ، عَلَى رَأْسِ الْعَمُودِ أَلْفُ بَيْتٍ، مُشْرِفِينَ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، مَكْتُوبٌ فِي جِبَاهِهِمْ: هَؤُلَاءِ الْمُتَحَابُّونَ فِي اللَّهِ، إِذَا اطَّلَعَ أَحَدُهُمْ مَلَأَ حُسْنَهُ أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ كَمَا تَمْلَأُ الشَّمْسُ أَهْلَ الْأَرْضِ، تَقُولُ أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ: هَذَا رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُتَحَابِّينَ فِي اللَّهِ اطَّلَعَ، يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَى وَجْهِهِ مِثْلَ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ "
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd Allah b. 'Ayyash reported to me from Yazid b. Qawthar, from Ka'b, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Many a person who stands [in prayer] is thanked, and many a sleeper is forgiven. Two men love one another for God’s sake. One rises to pray, and God accepts his prayer, but grants him none of what he asks. During the night he remembers his brother in his supplication and says, ‘My Lord, forgive my brother so-and-so,’ and God forgives his brother while he sleeps.” Ka'b said: “Those who love one another for God’s sake will be on columns of red ruby, with a thousand dwellings at the top of each column, overlooking the people of Paradise. Written on their foreheads will be: ‘These are those who love one another for God’s sake.’ When one appears, his beauty will fill the people of Paradise as the sun fills the people of the earth. They will say, ‘One of those who love for God’s sake has appeared,’ and look at his face as they look at the full moon.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 250
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي قُرَيْشُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ الْبُنَانِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنَّا إِذَا أَتَيْنَا أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ «فَإِذَا رَآنَا دَعَا بِدُهْنِ طِيبٍ، فَمَسَحَ بِهِ يَدَيْهِ لِمُصَافَحَةِ إِخْوَانِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Quraysh b. Hayyan reported to me from Thabit al-Bunani, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Whenever we came to Anas b. Malik and he saw us, he would call for scented oil and rub it on his hands so he could shake hands with his brothers.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 251
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ الْقُرَظِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: مَنْزِلَةُ الْمُؤْمِنِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْإِيمَانِ كَمَنْزِلَةِ الرَّأْسِ مِنَ الْجَسَدِ، يَأْلَمُ الْمُؤْمِنُ لِمَا أَصَابَ أَهْلَ الْإِيمَانِ كَمَا يَأْلَمُ الْجَسَدُ لِمَا أَصَابَ الرَّأْسَ»
entries.isnad_en: Ya'qub b. 'Abd al-Rahman reported to me from Abu Hazim, from Muhammad b. Ka'b al-Qurazi, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said:
entries.matn_en: “A believer’s place among the faithful is like the head’s place in the body. A believer feels pain at what befalls the faithful just as the body feels pain at what befalls the head.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 253
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ حَبِيبٍ، قَالَ الْحَسَنَ: «
entries.matn_ar: مَنْ شَيَّعَ أَخًا لَهُ فِي اللَّهِ بَعَثَ اللَّهُ لَهُ مَلَائِكَةً مِنْ تَحْتِ عَرْشِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يُشَيِّعُونَهُ إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ»
entries.isnad_en: And he narrated to me from Yahya b. Ayyub, from Sa'd b. Habib, that al-Hasan said '
entries.matn_en: Whoever escorts his brother for the sake of God, God will send angels from beneath His Throne on the Day of Resurrection to escort him to Paradise.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 255
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَبَلَغَنِي عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام قَالَ: «مَنْ عَادَ مَرِيضًا أَوْ زَارَ أَخًا لَهُ بَعَثَ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ مُنَادِيًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ أَنْ طِبْتَ وَطَابَ مَمْشَاكَ، قَدْ تَبَوَّأْتَ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ مَنْزِلًا»
entries.isnad_en: And it reached me from Abu Hurayrah
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said 'Whoever visits a sick person or visits his brother for the sake of God, God will send a caller from the heavens saying: You are good, and your walking is good. You have taken a dwelling in Paradise.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 256
entries.isnad_ar: وَقَالَ أَبُو قِلَابَةَ: "
entries.matn_ar: إِذَا خَرَجَ الْعَبْدُ لِيَلْقَى أَخَاهُ يُحْدِثُ بِهِ عَهْدًا، بَعَثَ اللَّهُ مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي مِنَ السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا أَنْ طِبْتَ وَطَابَ مَمْشَاكَ، لَكَ الْجَنَّةُ. يَقُولُ اللَّهُ: بِرَوْحِي هَذَا، وَعَلَيَّ قِرَاؤُهُ "
entries.matn_en: Abu Qilabah said: “When a servant goes out to meet his brother and renew their acquaintance, God sends a caller from the lowest heaven to proclaim: ‘You are good, your journey is good, and Paradise is yours.’ God says: ‘By My mercy, this is for Me, and I will provide his hospitality.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 257
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَبَلَغَنِي عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ: يُقَالُ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا يُبَلِّغُ الرَّجُلُ النَّصِيحَةَ كُلَّ النَّصِيحَةِ لِأَحَدٍ حَتَّى يَأْمُرَهُ بِمَا عَجَزَ عَنْهُ»
entries.isnad_en: And it reached me from al-Hasan, who said 'It is said:
entries.matn_en: A man does not fully advise someone until he commands him to do what he cannot.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 258
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي مَسْلَمَةُ بْنُ عُلَيٍّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ، يَرْفَعُهُ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: إِذَا دَخَلَ عَلَى أَحَدِكُمْ أَخُوهُ فَلْيُقَرِّبْ لَهُ مَا وَجَدَ، وَلَوْ شَرْبَةً مِنْ مَاءٍ»
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Maslamah b. Ali, from Sa'id ibn Bashir, raising it to the Prophet, ﷺ, who said '
entries.matn_en: When one of you has his brother visit, let him offer him what he has, even if it is just a drink of water.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 259
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنِ الثَّوْرِيِّ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ الْفَيَّاضِ الْخُزَاعِيِّ، عَنْ تَمِيمِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَدِمَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ مِنْ سَفَرٍ فَقَبَّلَ يَدَهُ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ بْنُ الْجَرَّاحِ، ثُمَّ خَلَوَا يَتَنَاجَيَانِ حَتَّى بَكَيَا جَمِيعًا "
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Abdur-Rahman b. Mahdi, from al-Thawri, from Ziyad b. al-Fayyad al-Khuza'i, from Tamim b. Salamah, who said '
entries.matn_en: Umar b. al-Khattab returned from a journey, and Abu Ubaydah b. al-Jarrah kissed his hand. Then they secluded themselves and conversed until they both wept.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 260
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ الْخَلِيلِ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ أَحَدُكُمْ مَا فِي قَوْلِهِ لِأَخِيهِ جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا لَاسْتَكْثَرَ مِنْهَا»
entries.isnad_en: And he narrated to me from Ibn Mahdi, from al-Hasan b. al-Khalil, that Umar b. al-Khattab said '
entries.matn_en: If one of you knew what is in saying to his brother, 'May God reward you with good,' he would say it often.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 261
entries.isnad_ar: وَأَخْبَرَنِي مَسْلَمَةُ بْنُ عُلَيٍّ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ وَاقِدٍ، وَهِشَامِ بْنِ الْغَازِي، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: امْشِ مِيلًا عُدْ مَرِيضًا، امْشِ مِيلَيْنِ أَصْلِحْ بَيْنَ اثْنَيْنِ، امْشِ ثَلَاثَةً زُرْ فِي اللَّهِ»
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Maslamah b. Ali, from Zayd b. Waqid and Hisham b. al-Ghazi, from Makhul, who said '
entries.matn_en: Walk a mile to visit a sick person, walk two miles to reconcile between two people, and walk three miles to visit for the sake of God.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 262
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ الْخُرَاسَانِيِّ،
entries.matn_ar: مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Yunus b. Yazid reported it to me from 'Ata' al-Khurasani
entries.matn_en: with a similar report.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 263
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي مَنْ، سَمِعَ سَعِيدَ بْنَ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، يَقُولُ: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: أَلَا أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِرِجَالِكُمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ؟» ، قَالُوا: بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ: «النَّبِيِّينَ، وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ، وَرَجُلٍ زَارَ أَخَاهُ فِي اللَّهِ» . قَالَ: «أَلَا أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِنِسَائِكُمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ؟» ، قَالُوا: بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ: " الْوَدُودُ، وَالْوَلُودُ، الْعَؤُودُ الَّتِي إِذَا أَسَاءَتْ أَوْ أُسِيءَ إِلَيْهَا وَضَعَتْ يَدَهَا فِي يَدِهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَتِ: اعْمَلْ وَافْعَلْ مَا بَدَا لَكَ "
entries.isnad_en: Someone who heard Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub reported to me that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said:
entries.matn_en: “Shall I tell you which of your men are among the people of Paradise?” They said: “Yes, Messenger of God.” He replied: “The prophets, the truthful, and a man who visits his brother for God’s sake.” He then asked: “Shall I tell you which of your women are among the people of Paradise?” They said: “Yes, Messenger of God.” He replied: “The affectionate, childbearing woman who returns to her husband: if she does wrong or is wronged, she takes his hand and says, ‘I will not sleep until you are pleased.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 264
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، عَنِ الثَّوْرِيِّ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَمَّا قَدِمَ جَعْفَرٌ مِنَ الْحَبَشَةِ اسْتَقْبَلَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَبَّلَ بَيْنَ عَيْنَيْهِ وَصَمَتَ»
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. 'Amr reported to me from al-Thawri, from a man, from al-Sha'bi, who said:
entries.matn_en: “When Ja'far returned from Abyssinia, the Messenger of God, ﷺ, welcomed him, kissed him between the eyes, and fell silent.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 266
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي حَيْوَةُ بْنُ شُرَيْحٍ، عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَمَّنْ يَثِقُ بِهِ: "
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ الرَّجُلَ، إِذَا زَارَ أَخًا لَهُ فِي اللَّهِ لَمْ يَبْقَ فِي السَّمَاءِ مَلَكٌ إِلَّا حَيَّاهُ بِتَحِيَّةٍ مُسْتَأْنَفَةٍ، لَا يُحَيِّهِ مِثْلَهُ مَلَكٌ غَيْرُهُ، كُلُّ مَلَكٍ مِنْهُمْ يُحَيِّيهِ تَحِيَّةً عَلَى حِدَتِهَا، وَلَا تَبْقَ شَجَرَةٌ بِجَمِيعِ شَجَرِ الْجَنَّةِ إِلَّا تُؤْذِنُ صَاحِبَتَهَا: فُلَانُ بْنُ فُلَانٍ زَارَ فُلَانًا فِي اللَّهِ "
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Haywah b. Shurayh, from Bakr b. Amr, from someone he trusted: '
entries.matn_en: When a man visits his brother for the sake of God, no angel remains in the heavens except that he greets him with a new greeting, unlike any greeting from another angel. Each angel greets him with a unique greeting. No tree among all the trees of Paradise remains except that it informs its companion: So-and-so, the son of so-and-so, has visited so-and-so for the sake of God.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 268
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ دَرَّاجٍ، عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ هِلَالٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ رُوحَيِ الْمُؤْمِنَيْنِ لَيَلْتَقِيَانِ عَلَى مَسِيرَةِ يَوْمٍ وَمَا رَأَى أَحَدُهُمَا صَاحِبَهُ قَطُّ»
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Ibn Lahi'ah, from Diraj, from Isa b. Hilal, from Abdullah b. Amr b. al-As, from the Messenger of God, ﷺ, who said '
entries.matn_en: The souls of two believers meet even if they are a day's journey apart and have never seen each other.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 269
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ سَمْعَانَ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رِجَالًا، مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ يُحَدِّثُونَ عَنْ سَلَفِنَا، مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام: «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ الرَّجُلَ مِنْهُمْ كَانَتِ اللَّيْلَةُ تَطُولُ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ فَيَنْظُرَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيهِ، وَأَنَّهُمْ فِي أَسْفَارِهِمْ كَانَتِ الشَّجَرَةُ تُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ الرَّجُلَيْنِ، فَيَلْتَفُّونَ مِنْ وَرَائِهَا فَيُشَابِكُ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا مِنْ شِدَّةِ تَشَوُّقِهِ إِلَى أَخِيهِ، وَسَلَامَةِ صَدْرِهِ لَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Ibn Sam'an, who said: I heard men of knowledge narrate from our predecessors, the companions of the Messenger of God, ﷺ: '
entries.matn_en: For one of them, the night would become long until morning so he could look at his brother's face. On their journeys, a tree would separate two men, and they would go around it, intertwining with each other out of intense longing for their brother and the purity of their hearts towards him.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 270
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ سَمْعَانَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام: «هَاتِ يَدَكَ يَا حُذَيْفَةُ» . فَأَعْطَيْتُهُ يَدِي وَأَنَا جُنُبٌ، فَأَدْخَلَ أَصَابِعَهُ فِي أَصَابِعِي فَشَابَكَنِي، وَشَدَّ قَبْضَتَهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «إِنَّ الْمُؤْمِنَ إِذَا لَقِيَ الْمُؤْمِنَ فَصَنَعَا هَذَا تَنَاثَرَتِ الْخَطَايَا مِنْهُمَا» قَالَ ابْنُ سَمْعَانَ: وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ عليه السلام إِذَا لَقِيَ الرَّجُلُ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ أَخَذَ بِيَدِهِ فَشَابَكَهُ ثُمَّ شَدَّ قَبْضَتَهُ
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Ibn Sam'an, from Ibrahim b. Ubayd b. Rifa'ah, from Abdur-Rahman b. Abi Layla, from Hudhayfah b. al-Yaman, who said
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said to me: 'Give me your hand, Hudhayfah.' I gave him my hand while I was in a state of major impurity. He placed his fingers between mine and interlaced them, tightening his grip. Then he said: 'When a believer meets another believer and does this, their sins fall away.' Ibn Sam'an said: The Prophet, ﷺ, when he met a man from his companions, would take his hand, interlace his fingers, and tighten his grip.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 272
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي هِشَامُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ غَالِبِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا يَزَالُ اللَّهُ فِي حَاجَةِ الْعَبْدِ مَا كَانَ فِي حَاجَةِ أَخِيهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Hisham b. Sa'd reported to me from Ghalib b. 'Ubayd God, from Abu Ishaq al-Hamdani, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said:
entries.matn_en: “God continues to help a servant as long as the servant is helping his brother.”

sections.title_en: Brotherhood for the Sake of Allah

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 276
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ ابْنُ وَهْبٍ: أَخْبَرَنِي الْحَارِثُ بْنُ نَبْهَانَ، عَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ أَبِي عَيَّاشٍ أَنَّ سَلْمَانَ دَخَلَ عَلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ فَأَلْقَى لَهُ وِسَادَةً، فَجَلَسَ عَلَيْهَا، فَقَالَ: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، قَالَ عُمَرُ: بَعْضُ أَعَاجِيبِكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ يَقُولُ: «
entries.matn_ar: إِذَا أَلْقَى أَحَدُكُمُ الْمُسْلِمُ لِأَخِيهِ شَيْئًا يُكْرِمُهُ بِهِ فَجَلَسَ عَلَيْهِ. . . غُفِرَ لَهُمَا»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said al-Harith b. Nabhan informed me from Aban b. Abi Ayyash that Salman entered upon Umar b. al-Khattab, who placed a cushion for him. He sat on it and said: 'Allahu Akbar.' Umar said: 'One of your wonders, O Abu Abdullah.' He said: 'I heard the Messenger of God say:
entries.matn_en: When one of you, a Muslim, places something for his brother to honor him and he sits on it... they are both forgiven.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 277
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَشْهَلُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام: «
entries.matn_ar: إِذَا الْتَقَى الْمُسْلِمَانِ فَتَصَافَحَا وَحَمِدَا اللَّهَ وَاسْتَغْفَرَاهُ غُفِرَ لَهُمَا»
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Ashhal b. Hatim, from a man who narrated to him from al-Hakam, from al-Bara b. Azib, who said The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: '
entries.matn_en: When two Muslims meet, shake hands, praise God, and seek His forgiveness, they are forgiven.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 279
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَشْهَلُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ: كَانُوا يَقُولُونَ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا تُكْرِمْ صَدِيقَكَ بِمَا يَشُقُّ عَلَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: And he informed me from Ashhal b. Hatim, from Abdullah b. Awn, from Muhammad b. Sirin, who said 'They used to say:
