entries.matn_ar: سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَوْصِنِي، قَالَ: «أَمْلِكْ عَلَيْكَ لِسَانَكَ» ، فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، واللَّهِ لَقَدْ عَلِمَ قَوْمِي أَنِّي لَمِنْ أَكَفِّهِمْ لِلِسَانِي فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ حِينَ كُنْتُ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ ، وَفِي الْإِسْلَامِ مُنْذُ أَسْلَمْتُ، ثُمَّ عَالَجْتُ ذَلِكَ بَعْدُ، فَمَا وَجَدْتُ مِنَ الْعِبَادَةِ شَيْئًا أَثْقَلَ عَلَيَّ مِنْ كَفِّي لِسَانِي
entries.isnad_en: Al-'Attaf b. Khalid reported to me that Al-Harith b. Hisham Al-Makhzumi
entries.matn_en: asked the Messenger of God, ﷺ, saying: 'O Messenger of God, advise me.' He said 'Control your tongue.' He said: 'O Messenger of God, by God, my people know that I was one of the most restrained with my tongue in the pre-Islamic era, and since I embraced Islam, I have struggled with it, but I have not found any act of worship more difficult for me than restraining my tongue.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 495
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو هَانِئٍ، عَنْ شُفَيٍّ الْأَصْبَحِيِّ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ: «
entries.matn_ar: مَنْ كَثُرَ كَلَامُهُ كَثُرَتْ خَطَايَاهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hani' reported to me from Shufayy Al-Asbahi that he used to say: '
entries.matn_en: Whoever talks a lot, his sins increase.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 496
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ، عَنِ الضَّحَّاكِ بْنِ شُرَحْبِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ: «
entries.matn_ar: مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ أَنَّ كَلَامَهُ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ، وَأَنَّ خُلُقَهَ مِنْ دِينِهِ هَلَكَ وَهُوَ لَا يَشْعُرُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abdullah b. Al-Musayyib reported to me from Al-Dahhak b. Shurahbil, from Abu Hurayrah, that he used to say: '
entries.matn_en: Whoever does not consider his speech as part of his deeds and his character as part of his religion will perish without realizing it.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 497
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ، عَنِ الضَّحَّاكِ، أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ أَنَّهُ مَكْتُوبٌ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ الْجَسَدَ يَسْجُدُ لِلِّسَانِ مَرَّتَيْنِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ مُتَعَوِّذًا بِهِ أَنْ يُوقِعَهُ فِي بَلَاءٍ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abdullah b. Al-Musayyib reported to me from Al-Dahhak that it reached him that it is written in the Torah: '
entries.matn_en: The body prostrates to the tongue twice every day, seeking refuge with it from leading it into calamity.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 498
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي طَلْحَةُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَطَاءَ بْنَ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام: «
entries.matn_ar: يَا عَائِشَةُ ، لَوْ كَانَ الْفُحْشُ رَجُلًا لَكَانَ رَجُلَ سُوءٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Talha b. 'Amr reported to me that he heard 'Ata' b. Abi Rabah say: The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: O 'Aishah, if obscenity were a man, he would be a wicked man.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 499
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي عِيَاضُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْفِهْرِيُّ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَطْغَى فِي كَلَامِهِ كَمَا يَطْغَى فِي مَالِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Iyad b. 'Abdullah Al-Fihri reported that he said '
entries.matn_en: A man becomes tyrannical in his speech just as he becomes tyrannical with his wealth.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 499
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُ سُفْيَانَ بْنَ عُيَيْنَةَ يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ الْمُؤْمِنَ التَّقِيَّ مُلْحِمٌ»
entries.isnad_en: I heard Sufyan b. 'Uyaynah narrate from 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz that he said:
entries.matn_en: “The God-fearing believer is scrupulous in doubtful matters.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 500
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ لِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، قِيلَ لِابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ: "
entries.matn_ar: رَجُلٌ كَثِيرُ الصَّلَاةِ كَثِيرُ الصِّيَامِ كَثِيرُ الْعَمَلِ يُقَارِفُ الذُّنُوبَ، وَرَجُلُ قَلِيلُ الصَّلَاةِ قَلِيلُ الصِّيَامِ قَلِيلُ الْعَمَلِ، لَا يُقَارِفُ شَيْئًا مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ؟ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: «لَا أَعْدِلُ بِالسَّلَامَةِ شَيْئًا»
entries.isnad_en: Malik b. Anas told me
entries.matn_en: that Ibn 'Abbas was asked: “There is a man who prays much, fasts much, and does many deeds, but commits sins; and another who prays little, fasts little, and does few deeds, but commits no sins. Which is better?” Ibn 'Abbas said: “I would not trade safety [from sin] for anything.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 501
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَسْوَدِ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الْقَاسِمَ، يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ رَجُلًا، يَسْأَلُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ: "
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ فِينَا رَجُلَيْنِ ، أَمَّا أَحَدُهُمَا فَكَثِيرُ الصَّلَاةِ كَثِيرُ الصِّيَامِ يَنَالُ مِنَ النَّاسِ، وَأَمَّا الْآخَرُ فَقَلِيلُ الصَّلَاةِ قَلِيلُ الصِّيَامِ يَسْلَمُ النَّاسُ مِنْهُ فَنَبِّئْنَا أَيُّهُمَا أَفْضَلُ عِنْدَكَ، قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: «أَنَا لَا أَعْدِلُ بِالسَّلَامَةِ شَيْئًا»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahii'ah reported to me from Abu Al-Aswad that he heard Al-Qasim say: I heard a man ask Ibn 'Abbas: '
entries.matn_en: Among us are two men; one of them prays a lot, fasts a lot, but harms people, and the other prays little, fasts little, but people are safe from him. Tell us which of them is better in your opinion.' Ibn 'Abbas said 'I do not equate anything with safety.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 502
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ: وَحَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ كَيْسَانَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ إِذَا ذُكِرَ رَجُلٌ عِنْدَهُ بِفَضْلٍ أَوْ صَلَاحٍ قَالَ: «كَيْفَ هُوَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ عِنْدَهُ إِخْوَانُهُ» ، فَإِنْ قَالُوا إِنَّهُ لَيَتَنَقَّصُهُمْ، وَيَنَالُ مِنْهُمْ، قَالَ عُمَرُ: «لَيْسَ هُوَ كَمَا تَقُولُونَ» ، وَإِنْ قَالُوا إِنَّهُ لَيَذْكُرُ مِنْهُمْ جَمِيلًا وَخَيْرًا، وَيُحْسِنُ الثَّنَاءَ عَلَيْهِمْ قَالَ: «هُوَ كَمَا تَقُولُونَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahi'ah said: Sulayman b. Kaysan told me
entries.matn_en: that when someone was praised before 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz for virtue or righteousness, he would ask, “How is he when his brothers are mentioned in his presence?” If they said, “He disparages them and speaks against them,” 'Umar would say, “He is not as you describe.” If they said, “He speaks well of them, mentions their good qualities, and praises them,” he would say, “He is as you describe, God willing.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 502
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَوْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ الْأَشَجِّ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ سَعْدَ بْنَ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، وَسَعِيدَ بْنَ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ نُفَيْلٍ، لَزِمَا بُيُوتَهُمَا بِالْعَقِيقِ ، فَلَمْ يَكُونَا يَأْتِيَانِ الْمَدِينَةَ لَجُمُعَةٍ وَلَا لِغَيْرِهَا حَتَّى مَاتَا
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahii'ah reported to me from 'Ubaydullah b. Abi Ja'far, from Bukayr b. 'Abdullah or Ya'qub b. Al-Ashajj,
entries.matn_en: that Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas and Sa'id ibn Zayd b. 'Amr b. Nufayl stayed in their houses in Al-'Aqiq and did not come to Medina for Friday prayers or otherwise until they died.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 503
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، "
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يَذْكُرَ كَثِيرًا مِمَّا يَذْكُرُ النَّاسُ مِنَ الْخَنَا، مِنْ نَحْوِ قَوْلِ الرَّجُلِ اِسْتَ الشَّيْءِ، وَمَا أَشْبَهَ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى إِنَّهُ كَانَ يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يَقُولَ الْإِبِطَ ، وَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ: الْأَرْفَاغَ "
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahii'ah reported to me that 'Umar b. 'Abd Al-'Aziz
entries.matn_en: used to dislike mentioning much of what people say of obscenities, such as a man saying 'he took the thing' and the like, to the extent that he disliked saying 'armpit' and instead said 'the groin.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 504
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيَّ، يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، قَالَ: "
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَقُولُ الْكَلِمَةَ وَمَا يُلْقِي لَهَا بَالًا، فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ: أَسْخَطَنِي عَبْدِي، وَيُكْتَبُ بِهَا مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ، وَإِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَقُولُ الْكَلِمَةَ، وَمَا يُلْقِي لَهَا بَالًا، فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ: أَرْضَانِي عَبْدِي، فَيُكْتَبُ بِهَا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ "
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahii'ah reported to me from Ibn Abi Ja'far that he heard Abu 'Abd Al-Rahman Al-Hubuli narrate from 'Abdullah b. 'Amr b. Al-'As, who said '
entries.matn_en: A man may say a word without paying attention to it, and God says: My servant has angered Me, and it is recorded against him as one of the people of the Fire. And a man may say a word without paying attention to it, and God says: My servant has pleased Me, and it is recorded for him as one of the people of Paradise.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 505
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنِ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ، أَنَّ أُسَيْدَ بْنَ الْحُضَيْرِ، كَانَ يَقُولُ: «
entries.matn_ar: مَا تَكَلَّمْتُ بِكَلِمَةٍ مُذْ أَسْلَمْتُ حَتَّى أَزُمَّهَا، وَأَخْطُمَهَا وَأَعْلَمَ مَا تَصِيرُ إِلَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahii'ah reported to me from Al-'Ala' b. Kathir that Usayd b. Al-Hudayr used to say: '
entries.matn_en: Since I embraced Islam, I have not spoken a word without restraining it, bridling it, and knowing where it would lead.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 506
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ سَمْعَانَ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رِجَالًا، مِنْ عُلَمَائِنَا يَقُولُونَ: "
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقُ مِنْ أَصْمَتِ النَّاسِ، فَإِذَا نَطَقَ قَالَ: كَانَ مِنَ الْأَمْرِ كَذَا وَكَذَا ، فَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ ، وَكَانَ كَذَا وَكَذَا ، فَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، فَقَلَّمَا حَدَّثَ حَدِيثًا إِلَّا خَتْمَهُ بِلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ "
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Sam'an reported to me that he heard some of our scholars say: '
entries.matn_en: Abu Bakr Al-Siddiq was one of the most silent of people. When he spoke, he would say: Such and such happened, so there is no deity but God, and such and such happened, so there is no deity but God. He rarely narrated a hadith without concluding it with 'There is no deity but God.''

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 507
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ سَمْعَانَ، قَالَ: " بَلَغَنَا
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ لُقْمَانَ الْحَكِيمَ، مَرَّ عَلَى نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ دَاوُدَ ، عليه السلام ، وَهُوَ يَصْنَعُ دِرْعًا، فَوَقَفَ عَلَيْهِ يَتَعَجَّبُ بِمَا يَصْنَعُ وَلَا يَدْرِي مَا هِيَ فَصَمَتَ عَنْ مَسْأَلَتِهِ عَنْ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى فَرَغَ مِنْهَا، فَلَبِسَهَا، فَعَرَفَ لُقْمَانُ مَا هِيَ عَنْ غَيْرِ مَسْأَلَةٍ، فَقَالَ لُقْمَانُ: الصَّمْتُ حِكْمَةٌ، وَقَلِيلٌ فَاعِلُهُ "
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Sam'an reported to me: 'It reached us that
entries.matn_en: Luqman the Wise passed by the Prophet of God, Dawud, ﷺ, while he was making armor. He stood watching him in amazement, not knowing what it was, and remained silent without asking about it until Dawud finished. Then Dawud wore it, and Luqman recognized what it was without asking. Luqman said Silence is wisdom, and few practice it.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 507
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا بَكْرُ بْنُ مُضَرَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ شُرَيْحٍ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَوْ أَنَّ عَبْدًا اخْتَارَ لِنَفْسِهِ مَا اخْتَارَ شَيْئًا أَفْضَلَ مِنَ الصَّمْتِ»
entries.isnad_en: Bakr b. Mudar reported to us from 'Abd Al-Rahman b. Shurayh, who said '
entries.matn_en: If a servant were to choose for himself, he would not choose anything better than silence.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 508
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي بَكْرُ بْنُ مُضَرَ، عَنْ أَبِي الصَّبَّاحِ الْأَيْلِيِّ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنْ أَهْلِ أَيْلَةَ يُقَالُ لَهُ أَبُو فَرْوَةَ، خَرَجَ غَازِيًا مَعَ أَصْحَابٍ لَهُ فَلَمَّا رَجَعُوا قَالُوا: مَا سَمِعْنَاهُ قَالَ كَلِمَةً وَاحِدَةً يَقُولُ: كَانَ يَنْبَغِي لَوْ قَالَ غَيْرَهَا، فَلَمَّا تُوُفِّيَ حَضَرَ ابْنُهُ غُسْلَهُ، فَذَكَرَ ابْنُهُ أَنَّ الرِّيحَ ذَرَّتِ الْخِرْقَةَ الَّتِي عَلَى فَرْجِهِ فَأَهْوَى بِيَدِهِ حَتَّى وَضَعَهَا عَلَى فَرْجِهِ وَهُوَ مَيِّتٌ، فَظَنَّ مَنْ سَمِعَ ابْنَهُ يَتَحَدَّثُ أَنَّ ذَلِكَ شَيْءٌ مَدَحَ بِهِ أَبَاهُ، فَسَأَلُوا الَّذِي غَسَّلَهُ عَمَّا قَالَ ابْنُهُ، فَقَالَ: «صَدَقَ، لَقَدْ كَانَ ذَلِكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Bakr b. Mudar reported to me from Abu al-Sabbah al-Ayli
entries.matn_en: that a man from Aylah called Abu Farwah went on a military expedition with companions. When they returned, they said, “We never heard him say a single word that called for someone to say, ‘He should have said something else.’” When he died, his son attended his washing. The son said that the wind had blown away the cloth covering his private parts, so Abu Farwah reached out and replaced it over them even though he was dead. Those who heard his son thought he was praising his father, so they asked the man who had washed him. He said, “His son spoke truly; that is what happened.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 509
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي بَكْرُ بْنُ مُضَرَ، أَنَّ سَعْدَ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ التُّجِيبِيَّ كَانَ يَقُولُ: "
entries.matn_ar: إِنْ أَتَاكَ الشَّيْطَانُ مِنْ قِبَلِ الصَّمْتِ، فَقَالَ: إِنَّ النَّاسَ يَعُدُّونَ ذَلِكَ مِنْكَ عَيًّا فَإِنَّهُ مِنْ قِبَلِ السَّلَامَةِ، وَقُلْ: صَامِتٌ سَالِمٌ خَيْرٌ مِنْ نَاطِقٍ آثِمٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Bakr b. Mudar reported to me that Sa'd b. Mas'ud Al-Tujibi used to say: '
entries.matn_en: If Satan comes to you from the direction of silence and says: People consider this from you as a speech impediment, then know it is from the direction of safety, and say: A silent and safe person is better than a speaking sinner.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 509
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ لِي زِيَادٌ مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَيَّاشٍ، وَجَلَسْتُ إِلَيْهِ وَكَانَ عَابِدًا وَأَنَا يَوْمَئِذٍ حَدِيثُ السِّنِّ، فَكَانَ يَرَانَا نَجْلِسُ مَعَ رَبِيعَةَ، فَقَالَ لِي: «خُذْ بِالَّذِي يَحِقُّ عَلَيْكَ بِالْحَذَرِ، فَإِنْ كَانَ الْأَمْرُ عَلَى غَيْرِ مَا يَقُولُونَ، فَقَدْ أَخَذْتَ بِالْوُثْقَى، وَإِنْ كَانَ الْأَمْرُ عَلَى مَا يَقُولُونَ لَمْ يَضُرَّكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik b. Anas reported to us:
entries.matn_en: Ziyad, the client of Ibn 'Ayyash, said to me—when I sat with him, he was a devout worshipper and I was still young—“I see you sitting with Rabi'ah. Hold to the cautious course that is incumbent upon you: if the matter is not as people say, you will have taken the surest course; and if it is as they say, it will not harm you.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 510
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ الرَّبِيعَ بْنَ خُثَيْمٍ، وَكَانَ مِنْ صَحَابَةِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، وَكَانَ مُجْتَهِدًا، أَنَّ ابْنَةً لَهُ صَغِيرَةً تَسْأَلُهُ أَنْ يَأْذَنَ لَهَا تَلْعَبُ فَقَالَ: " اذْهَبِي فَقُولِي خَيْرًا، فَعَادَتْ ذَلِكَ ثَانِيَةً، فَقَالَ لَهَا مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ بَعْضُ مَنْ عِنْدَهُ: مَا كَانَ عَلَيْكَ لَوْ أَذِنْتَ لَهَا تَلْعَبُ ، صَبِيَّةٌ صَغِيرَةٌ، فَقَالَ: أَكْرَهُ أَنْ أَجِدَهُ فِي كِتَابِي "
entries.isnad_en: Malik b. Anas reported to me
entries.matn_en: that Al-Rabi' b. Khuthaym, who was one of the companions of Ibn Mas'ud and a devoted worshipper, had a young daughter who asked him for permission to play. He said 'Go and say something good.' She returned a second time, and he said the same to her. Someone present said to him: 'What harm would it have done if you had allowed her to play? She is just a little girl.' He said: 'I dislike to find it in my record.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 511
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُ مَالِكَ بْنَ أَنَسٍ يُحَدِّثُ، قَالَ: قَالَ عَمْرُو بْنُ الْعَاصِ وَكَانَ مِنْ دُهَاةِ النَّاسِ: «
entries.matn_ar: إِنِّي لَأَصْبِرُ عَلَى الْكَلِمَةِ لَهِيَ أَشَدُّ عَلَيَّ مِنَ الْقَبْضِ عَلَى الْجَمْرِ، وَمَا يَحْمِلُنِي عَلَى الصَّبْرِ عَلَيْهَا إِلَّا أَنْ أَتَخَوَّفَ مِنْ أُخْرَى شَرٍّ مِنْهَا»
entries.isnad_en: I heard Malik b. Anas narrate
entries.matn_en: that 'Amr b. al-'As, one of the most astute people, said: “I hold myself back from saying a word that is harder for me to restrain than gripping a live coal. What makes me restrain myself is fear that I may otherwise say something worse.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 511
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام::
entries.matn_ar: أَخْبِرْنِي بِكَلِمَاتٍ أَعِيشُ بِهِنَّ وَلَا تُكْثِرْ فَأَنْسَى، قَالَ: «لَا تَغْضَبْ» ، فَسَأَلَهُ مِرَارًا ، كُلُّ ذَلِكَ يَقُولُ لَهُ: «لَا تَغْضَبْ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik b. Anas reported to me from Ibn Shihab, from Humayd b. 'Abd Al-Rahman b. 'Awf, that a man said to the Messenger of God, ﷺ: '
entries.matn_en: Tell me some words by which I can live, and do not make them too many so I forget.' He said: 'Do not get angry.' The man asked him repeatedly, and each time the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: 'Do not get angry.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 513
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ الْأَحْنَفِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَمٍّ لَهُ مِنْ بَنِي تَمِيمٍ، عَنْ جَارِيَةَ بْنِ قُدَامَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قُلْ لِي قَوْلًا يَنْفَعُنِي وَأَقْلِلْ لِعَلِّي أَعْقِلُهُ، قَالَ: «لَا تَغْضَبْ» ، فَعَادَ لَهُ مِرَارًا ، كُلُّ ذَلِكَ يَرْجِعُ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام: «لَا تَغْضَبْ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Amr b. Al-Harith reported to me from Hisham b. 'Urwah, from his father, from Al-Ahnaf b. Qays, from his cousin from Banu Tamim, from Jariyah b. Qudamah, who said '
entries.matn_en: O Messenger of God, tell me something that will benefit me and make it brief so I may understand it.' He said: 'Do not get angry.' He repeated this several times, and each time the Messenger of God, ﷺ, replied: 'Do not get angry.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 514
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، مَرَّ عَلَى نَاسٍ وَهُمْ يَتَجَاذَبُونَ مِهْرَاسًا، فَقَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: أَتَحْسَبُونَ الشِّدَّةَ رَفْعَ الْحِجَارَةِ، إِنَّمَا الشِّدَّةُ أَنْ يَمْتَلِئَ الرَّجُلُ غَضَبًا ثُمَّ يَحْبِسَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Amr b. Al-Harith reported to me from Bukayr b. 'Abdullah, from 'Amir b. Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, passed by some people who were pulling a watering trough. He said '
entries.matn_en: Do you think strength is in lifting stones? True strength is for a man to be filled with anger and then restrain it.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 515
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ دَرَّاجٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام، فَقُلْتُ: " يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا يُبْعِدُنِي مِنْ غَضَبِ اللَّهِ؟، قَالَ: «لَا تَغْضَبْ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Amr b. Al-Harith reported to me from Diraj, from 'Abd Al-Rahman b. Jubayr, from 'Abdullah b. 'Amr, who said
entries.matn_en: I asked the Messenger of God, ﷺ: 'O Messenger of God, what keeps me away from the anger of God?' He said: 'Do not get angry.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 516
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي مُسْلِمُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام:
entries.matn_ar: أَخْبِرْنِي بِعَمَلٍ يُدْخِلُنِي الْجَنَّةَ، قَالَ: «لَا تَغْضَبْ» ، قَالَ: وَاللَّهِ مَا زَادَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ
entries.isnad_en: Muslim b. Khalid reported to me from Isma'il b. Umayyah
entries.matn_en: that a man said to the Messenger of God, ﷺ: “Tell me a deed that will admit me to Paradise.” He said: “Do not get angry.” The narrator said: “By God, he added nothing to that.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 517
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، قَالَ: بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَانَ يَقُولُ: «
entries.matn_ar: أَدْرَكْتُ النَّاسَ وَهُمْ لَا يَعْجَبُونَ بِالْقَوْلِ» ، قَالَ مَالِكٌ: يُرِيدُ بِذَلِكَ الْعَمَلَ ، إِنَّمَا يَنْظُرُ إِلَى عَمَلِهِ وَلَا يَنْظُرُ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ
entries.isnad_en: Malik reported to us: It reached me that Al-Qasim b. Muhammad used to say: '
entries.matn_en: I have seen people who were not impressed by mere words.' Malik said He meant by that actions; they looked at a person's deeds and not his words.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 517
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُ مَالِكًا، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَمِّهِ أَبِي سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: مَا رَأَيْتُ مِثْلَ رَجُلٍ لَاحَنَ النَّاسَ فَلَمْ يَأْخُذْ بِجَوَامِعِ الْكَلَامِ»
entries.isnad_en: I heard Malik narrate from his uncle Abu Suhayl, from 'Umar b. 'Abd Al-'Aziz, that he said '
entries.matn_en: I have never seen the like of a man who engages in verbal disputes but does not grasp the essence of speech.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 518
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ: بَلَغَنِي عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ: «
entries.matn_ar: إِيَّايَ وَمُكَائِلَةَ الْكَلَامِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd Al-'Aziz b. Muhammad reported to me that it reached him from Mujahid that 'Umar b. Al-Khattab said '
entries.matn_en: Beware of excessive speech.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 518
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَجْلَانَ، يَقُولُ: "
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّمَا الْكَلَامُ أَرْبَعَةٌ: أَنْ تَذْكُرَ اللَّهَ وَتَقْرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ، أَوْ تَسْأَلَ عَنْ عَلْمٍ فَتُخْبَرَ بِهِ، أَوْ تَتَكَلَّمَ فِيمَا يَعْنِيكَ مِنْ أَمْرِ دُنْيَاكَ "
entries.isnad_en: Al-Layth b. Sa'd reported to me from Muhammad b. 'Ajlan, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Speech is only of these kinds: remembering God and reciting the Qur'an; asking about knowledge and being informed; or speaking about what concerns you in your worldly affairs.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 519
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَجْلَانَ، أَنَّ لُقْمَانَ، قَالَ لِابْنِهِ: «
entries.matn_ar: يَا بُنَيَّ كُنْ سَرِيعًا تَفْهَمُ، بَطِيًّا تَكَلَّمُ، وَقَبْلَ أَنْ تَتَكَلَّمَ فَتَفْهَمَ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Qasim b. 'Abdullah reported to me from Muhammad b. 'Ajlan that Luqman said to his son: '
entries.matn_en: O my son, be quick to understand, slow to speak, and think before you speak.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 519
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، وَغَيْرِهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ يَأْوِي إِلَى مَضْجَعِهِ عَلَى فِرَاشِهِ إِلَّا بَكَتْ أَعْضَاؤُهُ كُلُّهَا إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنْ مَا يَجْنِي عَلَيْهَا اللِّسَانُ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Qasim b. 'Abdullah reported to me from Zayd b. Aslam, from 'Ata' b. Yasar and others, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: No one lies down on his bed at night except that all his limbs weep to God because of what his tongue has committed against them.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 520
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي زَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ دَخَلَ عَلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ وَهُوَ قَابِضٌ عَلَى لِسَانِهِ بِطَرَفِ ثَوْبِهِ يُحَرِّكُهُ فِي فِيهِ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: «سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ يَا خَلِيفَةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، مَا تَصْنَعُ بِلِسَانِكَ؟» ، فَقَالَ: «وَهَلْ أَوْرَدَنِي الْمَوَارِدَ إِلَّا هَذَا»
entries.isnad_en: Zayd b. Aslam reported to me from his father, from 'Umar b. Al-Khattab,
entries.matn_en: that he entered upon Abu Bakr Al-Siddiq while he was holding his tongue with the edge of his garment and moving it in his mouth. 'Umar said 'Glory be to God, O successor of the Messenger of God, what are you doing with your tongue?' He said: 'This is what has brought me to my doom.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 521
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ سَعْدُ بْنُ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ وَاجِدًا عَلَى ابْنِهِ عَمْرٍو فَأَتَاهُ بِأُنَاسٍ يَسْتَشْفِعُ بِهِمْ إِلَيْهِ فَتَكَلَّمُوا فَأَبْلَغُوا، ثُمَّ تَكَلَّمَ عَمْرُو بْنُ سَعْدٍ وَكَأَنَّمَا لَمْ يَتَكَلَّمْ مَعَهُ أَحَدٌ، فَقَالَ سَعْدٌ: يَا بُنَيَّ هَذَا الَّذِي يُبَغِّضُكَ إِلَيَّ، سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام: «يَكُونُ قَوْمٌ آخِرَ الزَّمَانِ يَأْكُلُونَ الدُّنْيَا بِأَلْسِنَتِهِمْ كَمَا تَلْحَسُ الْبَقَرَةُ الْأَرْضَ بِأَلْسِنَتِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Usamah b. Zayd reported to me from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from a man of the Ansar, who said:
entries.matn_en: Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas was angry with his son 'Amr. 'Amr brought some people to intercede for him; they spoke and made their case effectively. Then 'Amr b. Sa'd spoke as though no one else had spoken. Sa'd said, “My son, this is what makes me dislike you. I heard the Messenger of God, ﷺ, say: ‘At the end of time there will be people who devour worldly gain with their tongues, as a cow licks the earth with its tongue.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 523
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ ابْنُ وَهْبٍ: حَدَّثَنِي مَنْ، سَمِعَ يَحْيَى بْنَ أَيُّوبَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَمْرَو بْنَ الْعَاصِ، قَالَ: «قَدْ قَالَ اللَّهُ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ أَنْ يَعْتَزِلُوا» فَقَالَ ابْنُهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو: قَدْ جَاءَ تَأْوِيلُ هَذِهِ بِآيَةٍ " {وَالَّذِينَ يُمَسِّكُونَ بِالْكِتَابِ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلَاةَ إِنَّا لَا نُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُصْلِحِينَ} [الأعراف: 170] "
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said It was reported to me by someone who heard Yahya b. Ayyub
entries.matn_en: that 'Amr b. Al-'As said: 'God has commanded those of understanding to seclude themselves.' His son 'Abdullah b. 'Amr said: The interpretation of this is in the verse: 'And those who hold fast to the Book and establish prayer—indeed, We will not allow to be lost the reward of the reformers.' (Al-A'raf: 170)

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 523
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُ مَالِكًا، يُحَدِّثُ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: أَنْ كَانَ الرَّجُلُ لَيَكُونُ لَهُ الْمُصَلَّى مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ يُصَلِّي فِيهِ ، فَإِذَا وُصِفَ بِهِ انْتَقَلْ مِنْهُ كَرَاهِيَةَ أَنْ يُنْسَبَ إِلَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: I heard Malik narrate that it was said '
entries.matn_en: A man would have a prayer spot in the mosque where he prayed. If he was described with something, he would move away from it, disliking to be associated with it.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 524
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكٌ، قَالَ: بَلَغَنِي عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: أَدْرَكْتُ النَّاسَ وَرَقًا لَا شَوْكَ فِيهِ، فَهُمُ الْيَوْمَ شَوْكٌ لَا وَرَقَ فِيهِ، إِنْ نَقَدْتَهُمْ وَإِنْ تَرَكْتَهُمْ لَمْ يُبْرِئُوكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik reported to me that it reached him from Abu Al-Darda' that he said '
entries.matn_en: I found the people like tender leaves without thorns, but today they are thorns without leaves. Whether you criticize them or leave them, they will not absolve you.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 524
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنِ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ، عليه السلام:
entries.matn_ar: مَا الْغِيبَةُ؟ قَالَ: «ذِكْرُكَ أَخَاكَ بِمَا يَكْرَهُ» ، فَقَالَ: أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ كَانَ فِي أَخِي مَا أَقُولُ، قَالَ: «إِنْ كَانَ فِيهِ مَا تَقُولُ فَقَدِ اغْتَبْتَهُ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهِ مَا تَقُولُ فَقَدْ بَهَتَّهُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd Al-'Aziz b. Muhammad reported to me from Al-'Ala' b. 'Abd Al-Rahman, from his father, from Abu Hurayrah, that he said to the Messenger of God, ﷺ: '
entries.matn_en: What is backbiting?' He said: 'Mentioning your brother with what he dislikes.' He asked: 'What if what I say is true about my brother?' He said: 'If what you say is true, you have backbitten him, and if it is not true, you have slandered him.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 526
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي مُسْلِمُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ الْيَأْسَ غِنًى، وَإِنَّ الطَّمَعَ فَقْرٌ حَاضِرٌ، وَإِنَّ الْعُزْلَةَ رَاحَةٌ مِنْ خُلَّاطِ السُّوءِ»
entries.isnad_en: Muslim b. Khalid reported to me from Isma'il b. Umayyah that 'Umar b. al-Khattab said:
entries.matn_en: “Freedom from covetous desire is wealth; greed is immediate poverty; and solitude is relief from bad company.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 526
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، قَالَ: كَانَ أَبِي ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَوَدِدْتُ إِذَا مِتُّ كُنْتُ نَسْيًا مَنْسِيًّا»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Abi Al-Zinad reported to me from Hisham b. 'Urwah that his father narrated from 'Aishah that she said '
entries.matn_en: I wish that when I die, I would be forgotten and unremembered.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 527
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ مَوْلَى زَائِدَةَ وَغَيْرُهُ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ ، عليه السلام ، قَالَتْ حِينَ حَضَرَتْهَا الْوَفَاةُ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَيْتَنِي لَمْ أُخْلَقْ وَلَيْتَنِي كُنْتُ شَجَرَةً أُسَبِّحُ وَأَقْضِي مَا عَلَيَّ»
entries.isnad_en: Usamah b. Zayd reported to me that Ishaq, the freed slave of Za'idah, and others narrated that 'Aishah, the wife of the Prophet, ﷺ, said when death approached her: '
entries.matn_en: I wish I had not been created, or I wish I were a tree that glorifies and fulfills its duty.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 528
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ كَعْبٍ الْقُرَظِيَّ يُحَدِّثُ، "
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ امْرَأَةً قَالَتْ عِنْدَ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ عليه السلام ، فِي نِسْوَةِ وَذُكُورِ الْجَنَّةِ، فَقَالَتْ: نَحْنُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ بَايَعْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، ثُمَّ لَمْ نُحْدِثْ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ أَوْ نَحْوَ هَذَا، فَانْقَلَبَتْ فَرَأَتْ فِي الْمَنَامِ أَنَّهُ قِيلَ لَهَا: «أَنْتِ الْمُتَأَلِّيَةُ عَلَى اللَّهِ؟ كَيْفَ بِكِ وَأَنْتِ تَقُولِينَ فِيمَا لَا يَعْنِيكِ وَتبْخَلِينَ بِمَا لَا يُغْنِيكِ وَتَمْنَعِينَ مَاعُونَ بَيْتِكِ»
entries.isnad_en: Usamah b. Zayd reported to me that he heard Muhammad b. Ka'b al-Qurazi narrate
entries.matn_en: that a woman said in the presence of 'A'ishah, the Prophet’s wife, regarding the men and women of Paradise: “We are among the people of Paradise; we pledged allegiance to the Messenger of God and did nothing thereafter [or words to that effect].” She returned home and saw in a dream that she was told: “Are you the woman presuming to speak for God? What will become of you when you speak about what does not concern you, are miserly with what brings you no benefit, and withhold the ordinary household things others may need?”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 529
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي الْحَارِثُ بْنُ نَبْهَانَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ الْأَعْمَشِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قُلْتُ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ النَّخَعِيِّ، " مَا نَرَاكَ نَبْدَأُكَ بِشَيْءٍ تَكْرَهُهُ، فَقَالَ: " إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَنَا فِيمَا يُكْرَهُ خَيْرٌ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَنَا فِيمَا يُسِرُّ خَيْرٌ ، قَالَ: فَذَهَبْتُ لِأَعْتَذِرَ إِلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ: مَهْ، إِنَّ الِاعْتِذَارَ مُخَالَطَةُ الْكَذِبِ "
entries.isnad_en: Al-Harith b. Nabhan reported to me from Sulayman Al-A'mash
entries.matn_en: that I said to Ibrahim Al-Nakha'i: 'We do not see you initiating anything you dislike.' He said: 'If there is no good for us in what we dislike, there is no good for us in what pleases us.' I went to apologize to him, and he said: 'Stop, for apology involves mixing with falsehood.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 530
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي الْحَارِثُ بْنُ نَبْهَانَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ رِيَاحِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، ظَلَمَنِي مَظْلِمَةً ، قَالَ: فَذَكَرْتُهُ يَوْمًا عِنْدَ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ فَنِلْتُ مِنْهُ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: «مَهْ ، فَإِنَّهُ بَلَغَنِي» أَنَّ الرَّجُلَ يَظْلِمُ الرَّجُلَ بِالْمَظْلِمَةِ فَلَا يَزَالُ الْمَظْلُومُ حَتَّى يَكُونَ عَلَيْهِ الْفَضْلُ "
entries.isnad_en: Al-Harith b. Nabhan reported to me from Hisham b. Abi 'Abd Allah, from Riyah b. 'Ubaydah, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Al-Hajjaj b. Yusuf had wronged me. One day I mentioned him in the presence of 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz and spoke against him. 'Umar said, ‘Enough. It has reached me that when one person wrongs another, the wronged person may keep pursuing the matter until the balance of merit turns against him [the final clause is elliptical].’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 531
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي الْحَارِثُ بْنُ نَبْهَانَ، عَنْ أَبَانَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: مَنِ اغْتِيبَ عِنْدَهُ أَخُوهُ الْمُسْلِمُ وَهُوَ يَسْتَطِيعُ نَصْرَهُ فَنَصَرَهُ، نَصَرَهُ اللَّهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، فَإِنِ اسْتَطَاعَ نَصْرَهُ فَلَمْ يَنْصُرْهُ أَدْرَكَهُ اللَّهُ بِهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Harith b. Nabhan reported to me from Aban, from Anas, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said:
entries.matn_en: “If a Muslim brother is backbitten in someone’s presence and that person is able to defend him and does so, God will support him in this world and the Hereafter. But if he is able to defend him and does not, God will call him to account for it in this world and the Hereafter.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 532
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي حَفْصُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ عِيسَى، قَالَ: " كَانَ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَقُولُ: «
entries.matn_ar: ابْنَ آدَمَ الضَّعِيفَ عَلِّمْ نَفْسَكَ الصَّمْتَ كَمَا تُعَلِّمُهَا الْكَلَامَ، وَكُنْ مَكِينًا حَتَّى تَسْمَعَ، وَلَا تَكُنْ مِضْحَاكًا فِي غَيْرِ عُجْبٍ، وَلَا هَشًّا فِي غَيْرِ أَرَبٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Hafs b. Maysarah reported to me from Habib b. 'Isa who said 'Ibn Maryam used to say:
entries.matn_en: O weak son of Adam, teach yourself silence as you teach it speech. Be composed until you hear, and do not be excessively cheerful without pride, nor overly friendly without purpose.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 532
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَلَسْتَ أَكْرَمَنَا أَبًا وَأُمًّا وَنَفْسًا وَعَشِيرَةً؟، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام: «كَمْ دُونَ لِسَانِكَ مِنْ طَبَقٍ؟» ، فَقَالَ: أَرْبَعَةٌ، شَفَتَايَ وَأَسْنَانِي، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ، صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَا كَانَ فِي وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا مَا يَرُدُّ عَنَّا غَيْبَ لِسَانِكَ» ، ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام: «مَا أُعْطِيَ عَبْدٌ فِي الدُّنْيَا شَرٌّ مِنْ طَلَاقَةِ لِسَانٍ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Hamid b. Ja'far reported to me that a man said:
entries.matn_en: “Messenger of God, are you not the noblest of us in parentage, family, and person?” The Messenger of God, ﷺ, asked him, “How many barriers lie between your tongue and the outside?” He said, “Four: my lips and my teeth.” The Messenger said, “None of them can shield us from your tongue’s backbiting.” Then he said: “Nothing given to a person in this world is worse than an unrestrained tongue.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 533
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، أَنَّ عَمْرَو بْنَ الْعَاصِ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: رُبَّ مُتَكَلِّمٍ بِكَلَامٍ لَوْ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُجَابُ بِهِ مَا تَكَلَّمَ بِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahii'ah reported to me from Yazid b. Abi Habib that 'Amr b. Al-'As said '
entries.matn_en: Many a speaker says something, and if he knew how it would be answered, he would not have spoken.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 534
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: الْهَمَّازُونَ، وَاللَّمَّازُونَ، وَالْمَشَّاءُونَ بِالنَّمِيمَةِ، وَالْمُحِبُّونَ لِلْبَرَاءِ الْعَيْبَ، يَحْشُرُهُمُ اللَّهُ فِي وُجُوهِ الْكِلَابِ»
entries.isnad_en: Mu'awiyah b. Salih reported to me from Al-'Ala' b. Al-Harith that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: The slanderers, the fault-finders, those who walk with gossip, and those who love to declare others free of faults will be gathered by God in the faces of dogs.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 535
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ مِقْسَمٍ، عَنْ نُعَيْمِ بْنِ الْمُجَمِّرِ، وَسَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام سُئِلَ عَنِ الْغِيبَةِ، فَقَالَ: «أَنْ تَذْكُرَ أَخَاكَ بِأَسْوَأِ شَيْءٍ وَتَدَعَ أَحْسَنَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yahya b. Salim reported to me from 'Uthman b. Miqsam, from Nu'aym b. Al-Mujammir and Sa'id Al-Maqburi, from Abu Hurayrah,
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, was asked about backbiting. He said 'Mentioning your brother with the worst thing and leaving out the best.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 537
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، وَغَيْرُ وَاحِدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ ، عليه السلام: «
entries.matn_ar: إِذَا تَكَلَّمَ بِكَلَامٍ نَزْرًا ، وَأَنْتُمْ تَنْثُرُونَ الْكَلَامَ نَثْرًا»
entries.isnad_en: Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub and others reported to me from Yazid b. Abi Habib, from 'Aishah, the wife of the Prophet, ﷺ: '
entries.matn_en: When she spoke, it was with few words, while you scatter speech profusely.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 537
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي قَبِيلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: شِرَارُ خَلْقِ اللَّهِ الَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَانٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahii'ah reported to me from Abu Qabil, from 'Abdullah b. 'Amr b. Al-'As, that he said '
entries.matn_en: The worst of God’s creation are those who are cautious without authority.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 538
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي ثَبَاتُ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ، عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ: " يُقَالُ:
entries.matn_ar: مَنِ اسْتَاكَ الرَّفَثَ فِي الدُّنْيَا سَالَ فِيهِ قَيْحًا وَدَمًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ "
entries.isnad_en: Thabit b. Maymun reported to me from Shu'ayb b. Abi Sa'id who said 'It is said:
entries.matn_en: Whoever indulges in obscenity in this world will flow with pus and blood on the Day of Resurrection.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 538
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي مَسْلَمَةُ بْنُ عُلَيٍّ، أَنَّ أَبَا الدَّرْدَاءِ كَانَ يَقُولُ: «
entries.matn_ar: كَافِئْ بِالْحَسَنَةِ مِثْلَهَا، وَلَا تُكَافِئْ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ السَّيِّئَةَ ، كَفَاكَ بِالْمُسِيءِ عَمَلُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Maslamah b. 'Ali reported to me that Abu Al-Darda' used to say: '
entries.matn_en: Repay a good deed with its like, and do not repay an evil deed with evil. The evil-doer's own deed is enough for him.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 539
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي زَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يَتْرُكَ الْمِرَاءَ وَإِنْ كَانَ مُحِقًّا ، وَيَتْرُكَ الْكَذِبَ وَإِنْ كَانَ لَاعِبًا»
entries.isnad_en: Zayd b. Aslam reported to me from his father that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: None of you truly believes until he abandons argumentation even if he is in the right, and abandons lying even if in jest.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 540
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، قَالَ: "
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ قِيلَ وَقَالَ مِنَ الْأَحَادِيثِ، وَلَا كَثْرَةَ السُّؤَالِ مِنَ النَّاسِ، وَلَا يُحِبُّ الْمُخْتَالَ، وَلَا الْجَافِيَ، وَلَا الْمَنَّانَ الَّذِي يَمُنُّ بِالْقَلِيلِ ، قَالَ: وَلَا أُحِبُّ الذَّوَّاقَ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ، وَلَا الذَّوَّاقَةَ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ "
entries.isnad_en: Yazid b. 'Iyad reported to us from 'Abd al-Rahman al-A'raj, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said:
entries.matn_en: “God does not love hearsay and ‘so-and-so said’ reports, people’s excessive questioning, the arrogant, the coarse, or one who reproaches others for a small favor. He said: ‘I do not like men who go from woman to woman, or women who go from man to man.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 542
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو يَحْيَى فُلَيْحُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ هِلَالِ بْنِ أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَمْ يَكُنْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، سَبَّابًا، وَلَا فَحَّاشًا، وَلَا لَعَّانًا ، وَكَانَ يَقُولُ عِنْدَ الْمَعْتَبَةِ مَا لَهُ تَرِبَتْ جَبِينُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Yahya Fulayh b. Sulayman reported to me from Hilal b. Usamah, from Anas b. Malik, who said '
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God, ﷺ, was not one to curse, use obscene language, or invoke curses. When he wanted to admonish someone, he would say: What is wrong with him? May his forehead be covered with dust.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 543
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي فُلَيْحُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي يُونُسَ، مَوْلَى عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ قَالَتِ:
entries.matn_ar: اسْتَأْذَنَ رَجُلٌ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «بِئْسَ ابْنُ الْعَشِيرَةِ» ، قَالَتْ: فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ تَبَسَّمَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَانْبَسَطَ إِلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ الرَّجُلُ وَاسْتَأْذَنَ رَجُلٌ آخَرُ، فَقَالَ: رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام حِينَ اسْتَأْذَنَ: «نِعْمَ ابْنُ الْعَشِيرَةِ» فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ لَمْ يَنْبَسِطْ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام كَمَا انْبَسَطَ إِلَى الْآخَرِ وَلَمْ يَهَشَّ لَهُ كَمَا هَشَّ لَهُ، قَالَتْ: فَلَمَّا خَرَجَ قَالَتْ: قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قُلْتَ لِفُلَانٍ مَا قُلْتَ وَهَشَشْتَ لَهُ، وَانْبَسَطْتَ إِلَيْهِ وَقُلْتَ لِفُلَانٍ مَا قُلْتَ، ثُمَّ لَمْ أَرَكَ صَنَعْتَ بِهِ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، قَالَ: «يَا عَائِشَةُ إِنَّ مِنْ شَرِّ النَّاسِ مَنِ اتُّقِيَ لِفُحْشِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Fulayh b. Sulayman reported to me from 'Abdullah b. 'Abd Al-Rahman, from Abu Yunus, the freed slave of 'Aishah, that 'Aishah, the wife of the Prophet, said
entries.matn_en: A man sought permission to enter upon the Messenger of God, ﷺ, and the Messenger of God said: 'What a bad son of his tribe.' When the man entered, the Messenger of God smiled at him and was cheerful with him. Then another man sought permission, and the Messenger of God said when he asked to enter: 'What a good son of his tribe.' But when he entered, the Messenger of God was not as cheerful with him as he was with the first man. 'Aishah said: When he left, I said: 'O Messenger of God, you said about so-and-so what you said and were cheerful with him, and you said about so-and-so what you said but did not act the same way with him.' He said: 'O 'Aishah, among the worst of people is the one who is avoided because of his obscenity.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 545
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا، سَأَلَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، فَقَالَ لَهُ: "
entries.matn_ar: رَجُلٌ كَثِيرُ الْعَمَلِ، كَثِيرُ الذُّنُوبِ أَعْجَبُ إِلَيْكَ، أَمْ رَجُلٌ قَلِيلُ الْعَمَلِ، قَلِيلُ الذُّنُوبِ؟ فَقَالَ: «لَا أَعْدِلُ بِالسَّلَامَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yahya b. Ayyub reported to me from al-Qasim b. Muhammad
entries.matn_en: that a man asked Ibn 'Abbas: “Which do you consider better: a man who does many deeds but commits many sins, or one who does few deeds and commits few sins?” He replied: “I would not trade safety from sin for anything.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 545
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَخْبَرَهُ، أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: مَا خَاصَمْتُ أَحَدًا قَطُّ»
entries.isnad_en: I heard 'Abdullah b. 'Umar narrate from a man who informed him that 'Ali b. Abi Talib said '
entries.matn_en: I have never argued with anyone.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 546
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُهُ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَانَ يَقُولُ: «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ الْخَاصِمَ مُلْفِحٌ»
entries.isnad_en: I heard him
entries.matn_en: narrate from 'Ubayd God b. 'Umar that al-Qasim b. Muhammad used to say: “The contentious person is a mulfih”—a rare word whose intended sense is uncertain.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 546
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ أَبْغَضَ الرِّجَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ الْأَلَدُّ الْخَصِمُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Jurayj reported to us from Ibn Abi Mulaykah, from 'Aishah, the wife of the Prophet, ﷺ, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: The most hateful of men to God is the one who is most contentious.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 548
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ عَاصِمَ بْنَ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ كَانَ يَقُولُ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا أُسَابُّ أَحَدًا أَبَدًا تَرَكَنِي أَدْخَلُ بَيْتِي فَلْيَقُلْ مَا بَدَا لَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar reported to us
entries.matn_en: that 'Asim b. 'Umar b. al-Khattab used to say: “I will never trade insults with anyone. If he leaves me to go into my house, let him say whatever he wishes.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 548
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، وَيُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: مِنْ حُسْنِ إِسْلَامِ الْمَرْءِ تَرْكُهُ مَا لَا يَعْنِيهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik b. Anas and Yunus b. Yazid reported to me from Ibn Shihab, from 'Ali b. Husayn, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: Part of the excellence of a person's Islam is leaving what does not concern him.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 548
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي مَنْ، سَمِعَ الْأَوْزَاعِيَّ يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ ، قَالَ: وَسَمِعْتُ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ، يَقُولُ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَقَدْ أَدْرَكْتُ النَّاسَ وَمَا يُعْجِبُهُمُ الْقَوْلُ ، إِنَّمَا كَانُوا يُعْجَبُونَ بِالْفِعْلِ»
entries.isnad_en: It was reported to me by someone who heard Al-Awzaa'i narrate from Yahya b. Sa'id that he said: I heard Al-Qasim b. Muhammad say: '
entries.matn_en: I have seen people who were not impressed by mere words; they were only impressed by actions.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 549
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ أُسَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَالِكٍ النَّخَعِيِّ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: خُذُوا مِنْ هَذَا الْعِلْمِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَنْفَدَ» قَالَ رَجُلٌ: وَكَيْفَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، وَكِتَابُ اللَّهِ بَيْنَ أَظْهُرِنَا؟ فَغَضِبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «ثَكِلَتْكَ أُمُّكَ، وَهَلْ هَلَكَ أَهْلُ التَّوْرَاةِ، وَالْإِنْجِيلِ إِلَّا وَالتَّوْرَاةُ وَالْإِنْجِيلُ بَيْنَ أَظْهُرِهِمْ؟ فَهَلْ أَغْنَتْ عَنْهُمْ شَيْئًا؟»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Layth b. Sa'd reported to me from Ishaq b. Usayd, from Abu Malik Al-Nakha'i, from 'Ali b. Abi Talib, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: Take from this knowledge before it vanishes.' A man said: 'How can it vanish, O Messenger of God, when the Book of God is with us?' The Messenger of God, ﷺ, became angry and said: 'May your mother be bereaved of you! Did the people of the Torah and the Gospel not perish even though the Torah and the Gospel were with them? Did it benefit them anything?'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 551
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَفْصٍ الدِّمَشْقِيِّ، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: الْعِلْمُ بِالتَّعَلُّمِ ، وَالْخَيْرُ عَادَةٌ ، وَإِذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيْرًا فَقُهَ فِي الدِّينِ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Layth reported to us from Abu Hafs Al-Dimashqi, from Makhul, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: Knowledge is through learning, goodness is a habit, and when God intends good for someone, He grants him understanding in religion.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 552
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ قَوْذَرَ، قَالَ: قَالَ كَعْبٌ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا تُكْثِرُوا الْكَلَامَ بِغَيْرِ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ فَتَقْسُوَ قُلُوبُكُمْ؛ فَإِنَّ الْقَلْبَ الْقَاسِيَ بَعِيدٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abdullah b. 'Ayyash reported to me from Yazid b. Qawdhar that Ka'b said '
entries.matn_en: Do not speak excessively without mentioning God, lest your hearts become hardened, for a hardened heart is far from God.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 553
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ قَوْذَرَ، عَنْ كَعْبٍ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: اتَّقُوا النَّمِيمَةَ؛ فَإِنَّ صَاحِبَهَا لَا يَسْتَرِيحُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَمَنْ كَانَ ذَا لِسَانَيْنِ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ لِسَانَيْنِ مِنَ النَّارِ، وَالْغِيبَةُ تُحْبِطُ الْعَمَلَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd Allah b. 'Ayyash reported to me from Yazid b. Qawdhar, from Ka'b, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Beware of tale-bearing, for its practitioner will find no respite from the punishment of the grave. Whoever is two-faced, God will give him two tongues of fire. Backbiting nullifies good deeds.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 554
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ قَوْذَرَ، عَنْ كَعْبٍ، رضي الله عنه قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: مَنْ لَعَنَ شَيْئًا مِنْ غَيْرِ ذَنْبِهِ لَمْ تَزَلِ اللَّعْنَةُ تَرَدَّدُ بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ حَتَّى تَلْزَمَ تَرْقُوَةَ صَاحِبِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abdullah b. 'Ayyash reported to me from Yazid b. Qawdhar, from Ka'b, ؓ, who said '
entries.matn_en: Whoever curses something without it deserving it, the curse will keep bouncing between the sky and the earth until it clings to the collarbone of its speaker.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 555
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، وَقَفَ عَلَى قَوْمٍ يَتَذَاكَرُونَ عَظَمَةَ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ: «إِنَّ قَوْمًا أَسْكَتَتْهُمْ خَشْيَةُ اللَّهِ، وَإِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ النُّبَلَاءُ الْعُقَلَاءُ الْفُصَحَاءُ، فَإِذَا ذَكَرُوا عَظَمَةَ اللَّهِ طَاشَتْ عُقُولُهُمْ ، فَإِذَا سُرِّيَ عَنْهُمْ فَزِعُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ بِالْأَعْمَالِ الزَّاكِيَّةِ ، فَأَيْنَ أَنْتُمْ مِنْهُمْ؟»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abdullah b. 'Ayyash reported to me
entries.matn_en: that 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas stood before a group of people discussing the greatness of God and said to them: 'There are people whom the fear of God silences, and they are the noble, intelligent, and eloquent ones. When they remember the greatness of God, their minds are overwhelmed. When they recover, they turn to God with pure deeds. Where do you stand in comparison to them?'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 556
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي. . . .، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ: "
entries.matn_ar: أَرْبَعٌ لَا يُصِبْنَ إِلَّا بِعَجَبٍ: أَوَّلُهُنَّ الصَّمْتُ، وَهُوَ أَوَّلُ الْعِبَادَةِ، وَذِكْرُ اللَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ، وَالتَّوَاضُعُ، وَقِلَّةُ الشَّيْءِ "
entries.isnad_en: It was reported to me from al-Hasan
entries.matn_en: that he used to say: “Four qualities are rarely found together except in someone remarkable: silence, which is the beginning of worship; remembrance of God in every state; humility; and having little.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 557
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي هِشَامُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سُئِلَ لُقْمَانُ الْحَكِيمُ: «أَيُّ عَمَلِكَ أَوْثَقُ فِي نَفْسِكَ؟» قَالَ: «تَرْكِي مَا لَا يَعْنِينِي»
entries.isnad_en: Hisham b. Sa'd reported to me from Zayd b. Aslam
entries.matn_en: that Luqman the Wise was asked: 'Which of your deeds do you trust the most?' He said 'Leaving what does not concern me.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 557
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي هِشَامُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ، قَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ: " يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، قُلْ لِي قَوْلًا يَنْفَعُنِي، وَلَا تُكْثِرُ عَلَيَّ فَأَنْسَى، فَقَالَ لَهُ: «أَمْسِكْ لِسَانَكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Hisham b. Sa'd reported to me from Zayd b. Aslam
entries.matn_en: that a man said to the Messenger of God, ﷺ: “Tell me something that will benefit me, and keep it brief so I can remember it.” He replied: “Restrain your tongue.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 558
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي هِشَامُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، قَالَ: "
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ أَحَبَّكُمْ إِلَيَّ وَأَقْرَبَكُمْ مِنِّي مَنْزِلَةً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَحَاسِنُكُمْ أَخْلَاقًا، وَإِنَّ أَبْغَضَكُمْ إِلَيَّ وَأَبْعَدَكُمْ مِنِّي مَنْزِلَةً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ الثَّرْثَارُونَ الْمُتَشَدِّقُونَ الْمُتَفَيْهِقُونَ، وَقَالَ: خِيَارُكُمُ الَّذِينَ إِذَا رُءُوا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ، وَشِرَارُكُمُ الْمَشَّاءُونَ بِالنَّمِيمَةِ الْمُفَرِّقُونَ بَيْنَ الْأَحِبَّةِ الْبَاغُونَ الْبُرَآءَ الْعَنَتَ "
entries.isnad_en: Hisham b. Sa'd reported to me from Muhammad b. al-Munkadir that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said:
entries.matn_en: “The most beloved of you to me and the closest to me in standing on the Day of Resurrection are those of you with the finest character. The most hated of you to me and the farthest from me in standing on that Day are the long-winded, the bombastic, and the affected speakers.” He also said: “The best of you are those whose sight reminds others of God. The worst of you are the talebearers who divide those who love one another and seek to cause distress to blameless people.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 559
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي دَاوُدُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ. . . .
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ دَخَلَ عَلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ مُدْلِعٌ لِسَانَهُ يَجْبِذُهُ مِنْ هَاهُنَا وَهَاهُنَا، فَقَالَ: «سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، مَا تَصْنَعُ بِلِسَانِكَ يَا خَلِيفَةَ رَسَولِ اللَّهِ؟» ، فَقَالَ: «هَذَا أَوْرَدَنِي الْمَوَارِدَ»
entries.isnad_en: Dawud b. Qays reported to me from...
entries.matn_en: that 'Umar b. Al-Khattab entered upon Abu Bakr Al-Siddiq while he was pulling his tongue this way and that. 'Umar said 'Glory be to God, what are you doing with your tongue, O successor of the Messenger of God?' He said: 'This is what has brought me to my doom.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 560
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَشْهَلُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو: «
entries.matn_ar: دَعْ مَا لَسْتَ مِنْهُ فِي شَيْءٍ، وَلَا تَنْطِقْ فِيمَا لَا يَعْنِيكَ، وَاخْزِنْ لِسَانَكَ كَمَا تَخْزِنُ وَرِقَكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Ashhal b. Hatim reported to me from Sulayman b. Al-Mughirah, from Humayd b. Hilal, who said 'Abdullah b. 'Amr said: '
entries.matn_en: Leave what does not concern you, do not speak about what does not concern you, and guard your tongue as you guard your money.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 561
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي جَرِيرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رِبْعِيَّ بْنَ حِرَاشٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَمْرٍو الْأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالَ: "
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ مِمَّا أَدْرَكَ النَّاسُ مِنْ كَلَامِ النُّبُوَّةِ الْأُولَى: إِذَا لَمْ تَسْتَحِ فَاصْنَعْ مَا شِئْتَ "
entries.isnad_en: Jarir b. 'Abd Al-Hamid reported to me from Mansur who said: I heard Rib'i b. Hirash from Abu Mas'ud 'Uqbah b. 'Amr Al-Ansari say: '
entries.matn_en: Among the sayings people have preserved from the early prophecies is: If you are not ashamed, do as you wish.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 562
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ، وَاللَّيْثُ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ، أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ، صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: طُوبَى لِمَنْ عَمِلَ بِعِلْمٍ، وَأَنْفَقَ مِنْ فَضْلِ مَالِهِ، وَأَخْزَنَ فَضْلَ كَلَامَهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. Sulaym and Al-Layth reported to me from Khalid b. Abi 'Imran that it reached him from the Messenger of God, ﷺ, that he said '
entries.matn_en: Blessed is the one who acts upon his knowledge, spends from his surplus wealth, and restrains his surplus speech.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 563
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي هِلَالٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنَ الْيَمَانِ، بَيْنَا وَهُوَ يُحَدِّثُ قَوْمًا يَوْمًا إِذْ أَفَاضُوا فِي ذِكْرِ الدُّنْيَا قَالَ: «قَدْ فَرَغْتُمْ؟ أَمَا وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَتُفْتَحَنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ دُنْيَا تَأْكُلُ الْإِيمَانَ كَمَا تَأْكُلُ. . . . . . .»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Layth reported to me from Khalid b. Yazid, from Ibn Abi Hilal,
entries.matn_en: that Hudhayfah b. Al-Yaman, while he was speaking to a group one day, they began to talk excessively about worldly matters. He said 'Have you finished? By the One in Whose hand is my soul, the world will be opened to you in a way that consumes faith as it consumes...'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 564
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنَا الْحَارِثُ بْنُ نَبْهَانَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا، مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ مَرَّ عَلَى مَجْلِسِ الْأَنْصَارِ، فَقَالَ: «تَطَهَّرُوا فَإِنَّ بَعْضَ مَا تَقُولُونَ شَرٌّ مِنَ الْحَدَثِ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Harith b. Nabhan reported to me from Ayyub, from Ibn Sirin,
entries.matn_en: that a man from the Ansar passed by a gathering of the Ansar and said 'Purify yourselves, for some of what you say is worse than impurity.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 565
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ قُرَّةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنِ ابْنِ سَمْعَانَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ: "
entries.matn_ar: ثَلَاثَةٌ لَا يُرِيحُونَ رِيحَ الْجَنَّةِ: رَجُلٌ كَذَبَ عَلَى رَجُلٍ كَذِبًا، أَوْ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ مَا لَمْ يَرَ، وَرَجُلٌ ادُّعِيَ لِغَيْرِ أَبِيهِ "
entries.isnad_en: Yahya b. Humayd reported to me from Qurrah b. 'Abd Al-Rahman, from Ibn Sam'an, from Al-Zuhri, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: Three will not smell the fragrance of Paradise: a man who lies about a man or says, I saw what I did not see, and a man who claims a lineage other than his father's.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 566
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بَابَاهَ، قَالَ: قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: «
entries.matn_ar: أَلَا أُنْذِرُكُمْ فُضُولَ الْكَلَامِ؟ بِحَسْبِ أَحَدِكُمْ مَا بَلَغَ حَاجَتَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abdullah b. Yazid reported to me from 'Abd Al-Rahman b. 'Abdullah b. 'Utbah, from Abu Husayn, from 'Abdullah b. Babah, who said 'Abdullah said: '
entries.matn_en: Shall I not warn you about excessive speech? It is enough for each of you to speak what fulfills his need.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 567
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي مَنْ، سَمِعَ الْأَوْزَاعِيَّ، يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ حَسَّانَ بْنِ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَ: "
entries.matn_ar: بَيْنَمَا رَجُلٌ رَاكِبًا عَلَى حِمَارٍ إِذْ عَثَرَ بِهِ الْحِمَارُ، فَقَالَ: تَعِسْتَ، فَقَالَ صَاحِبُ الْيَمِينِ: مَا هِيَ بِحَسَنَةٍ فَأَكْتُبُهَا. وَقَالَ صَاحِبُ الشِّمَالِ: مَا هِيَ بِسَيِّئَةٍ فَأَكْتُبُهَا. فَقَالَ صَاحِبُ الشِّمَالِ: مَا تَرَكَ صَاحِبُ الْيَمِينِ فَأَكْتُبُهُ "
entries.isnad_en: It was reported to me by someone who heard Al-Awzaa'i narrate from Hassan b. 'Atiyyah who said '
entries.matn_en: While a man was riding a donkey, it stumbled, and he said: May you perish. The angel on his right said: It is not a good deed to record. The angel on his left said: It is not an evil deed to record. The angel on the left said: What the angel on the right left, I will record.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 568
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا يَجْتَمِعُ الْإِيمَانُ وَالْكُفْرُ فِي قَلْبِ امْرِئٍ، وَلَا يَجْتَمِعُ الْكَذِبُ وَالصِّدْقُ جَمِيعًا، وَلَا تَجْتَمِعُ الْخِيَانَةُ وَالْأَمَانَةُ جَمِيعًا»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahii'ah reported to me from Abu Al-Aswad, from 'Abdullah b. Rafi', from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: Faith and disbelief do not coexist in a person's heart, nor do lying and truth, nor do treachery and trustworthiness.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 569
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَشْهَلُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَتَيْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَا وَشُعَيْبٌ، فَاعْتَذَرَ (. . . . . .) غَيْرَ مُعْتَذَرٍ «إِنَّ الِاعْتِذَارَ مُخَالَطَةُ الْكَذِبِ أَوْ يُخَالِطُهُ الْكَذِبُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ashhal reported to me from Ibn 'Awn who said
entries.matn_en: I came to Ibrahim with Shu'ayb, and he made an excuse that was not genuine. He said: 'Apology involves mixing with falsehood or falsehood mixes with it.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 569
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي قَيْسٌ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ كَعْبٍ الْقُرَظِيَّ، يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ، صلى الله عليه وسلم: «
entries.matn_ar: (. . .) فِي الدُّنْيَا وَيُحْرَمُ بِهِنَّ فِي الْآخِرَةِ، مَا هُوَ أَعْظَمُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ الْفُحْشُ وَالشُّحُّ، وَهُنَّ مِمَّا يَزِدْنَ بِهِنَّ الْعَبْدَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَيُدْرِكُ بِهِنَّ فِي الْآخِرَةِ مِنَ الْحَظِّ مَا هُوَ أَعْظَمُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ، إِنَّ الْحَيَاءَ وَالْعِيَّ عِيُّ اللِّسَانِ، لَا عِيَّ الْقَلْبِ»
entries.isnad_en: Qays reported
entries.matn_en: that he heard Muhammad b. Ka'b al-Qurazi say that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: “[Fragment] … in this world, while being deprived of them in the Hereafter. Nothing is worse than obscenity and miserliness. These are among the things by which a servant may gain in this world, yet attain an even greater share in the Hereafter. Modesty and verbal awkwardness are defects of the tongue, not of the heart.” [The beginning of the report is missing, so the referents are uncertain.]

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 570
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي النَّضْرِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: يَا عَائِشَةُ إِنَّ الْحَيَاءَ لَوْ كَانَ رَجُلًا كَانَ رَجُلًا صَالِحًا، وَإِنَّ الْعُجْبَ لَوْ كَانَ رَجُلًا كَانَ رَجُلَ سُوءٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahii'ah reported to me from Abu Al-Nadr, from Abu Salamah, from 'Aishah, the wife of the Prophet, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: O 'Aishah, if modesty were a man, he would be a righteous man, and if arrogance were a man, he would be a wicked man.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 571
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ قُرَّةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: الْحَيَاءُ مِنَ الْإِيمَانِ، وَالْإِيمَانُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ، وَالْبَذَاءُ مِنَ الْجَفَاءِ، وَالْجَفَاءُ فِي النَّارِ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Layth b. Sa'd reported to me from Khalid b. Yazid, from Qurrah b. 'Abd Al-Rahman, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: Modesty is part of faith, and faith is in Paradise. Obscenity is part of harshness, and harshness is in the Fire.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 572
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيِّ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ يَقُولُ: «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ الْجَنَّةَ حَرَامٌ عَلَى كُلِّ فَاحِشٍ أَنْ يَدْخُلَهَا» ،
entries.isnad_en: Al-Layth b. Sa'd reported to me from 'Ayyash, from Abu 'Abd al-Rahman al-Hubuli, who heard 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr b. al-'As say:
entries.matn_en: “Paradise is forbidden to every foul-mouthed person who would enter it.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 573
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَشْهَلُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَشْهَبِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، فِي هَذِهِ. . . قَالَ: "
entries.matn_ar: الْفَاحِشُ اللَّئِيمُ الضَّرِيبَةِ ،
entries.isnad_en: Ashhal b. Hatim reported to me from Abu al-Ashhab, from al-Hasan,
entries.matn_en: commenting on this report: “The foul-mouthed person is vile in disposition.” [The source wording is fragmentary.]

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 574
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَشْهَلُ، عَنْ قُرَّةَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي السَّوَّارِ الْعَدَوِيِّ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ الْحُصَيْنِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام «
entries.isnad_en: Ashhal reported to me from Qurrah b. Khalid, from Abu al-Sawwar al-'Adawi, from 'Imran b. al-Husayn, who said that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said:
entries.matn_en: “[ … all of it].” [The transmitted report is fragmentary.]

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 574
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَشْهَلُ،. . .، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُسَبَّ قَتْلَى بَدْرٍ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَصِلُ إِلَيْهِمْ وَتُؤْذُونَ الْأَحْيَاءَ»
entries.isnad_en: Ashhal reported... from Muhammad b. 'Ali who said '
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God, ﷺ, forbade cursing the polytheists killed at Badr, for it does not reach them and harms the living.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 575
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، وَابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ سِنَانِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: الْغَضَبُ جَمْرَةٌ فِي قَلْبِ الْإِنْسَانِ تُوقَدُ، أَلَمْ تَرَوْا إِلَى حُمْرَةِ عَيْنَيْهِ وَانْتِفَاخِ أَوْدَاجِهِ، فَإِذَا حَسَّ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنْ ذَلِكَ شَيْئًا فَلْيَجْلِسْ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd Al-Rahman b. Al-Harith and Ibn Lahii'ah reported to me from Yazid b. Abi Habib, from Sinan b. Sa'd, from the Messenger of God, ﷺ, that he said '
entries.matn_en: Anger is an ember in the heart of a person that is kindled. Have you not seen the redness of his eyes and the swelling of his neck veins? If any of you feels this, let him sit down.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 576
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، وَهِشَامُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: الْغَضَبُ طَعَنَاتٌ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ، أَلَمْ تَرَوْا كَيْفَ تَدُرُّ أَوْدَاجُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Maysarah and Hisham b. Sa'd reported to me from Zayd b. Aslam that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: Anger is stabs from Satan. Have you not seen how his neck veins swell?'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 577
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَحْرٍ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، "
entries.matn_ar: أَنْ يَحْيَى بْنَ زَكَرِيَّا، لَقِيَ عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ، فَقَالَ: أَخْبِرْنِي مَا يُقَرِّبُ مِنْ رِضَا اللَّهِ وَيُبْعِدُ مِنْ سَخَطِ اللَّهِ، فَقَالَ: لَا تَغْضَبْ ". قَالَ: الْغَضَبُ مَا يَبْدَأُهُ وَمَا يُعِيدُهُ؟ قَالَ: التَّعَزُّزُ، وَالْحَمِيَّةُ، وَالْكِبْرِيَاءُ، وَالْعَظَمَةُ. قَالَ: فَغَيْرُ ذَلِكَ أَسْأَلُكَ عَنْهُ. قَالَ: سَلْ عَمَّا بَدَا لَكَ، الزِّنَا مَا يَبْدَأُهُ وَمَا يُعِيدُهُ، قَالَ: النَّظَرُ فَيَقَعُ فِي الْقَلْبِ ، وَلَا تُكْثِرُوا الْخَطْوَ إِلَى اللَّهْوِ وَالْغِنَا فَتَكْثُرَ الْغَفْلَةُ، وَالْخَطِيئَةُ ، وَلَا تُدِمِ النَّظَرَ إِلَى مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ فَإِنَّهُ لَيْسَ يَفْتِنُكَ مَا لَمْ تَرَ وَلَمْ يُؤْذِكَ مَا لَمْ تَسْمَعْ "
entries.isnad_en: Yahya b. Ayyub reported to me from 'Ubaydullah b. Zahr, from Sa'd b. Mas'ud,
entries.matn_en: that Yahya b. Zakariyya met 'Isa b. Maryam and said 'Tell me what brings one closer to the pleasure of God and distances one from His wrath.' He said: 'Do not get angry.' He asked: 'What initiates and repeats anger?' He said: 'Pride, zealotry, arrogance, and haughtiness.' He said: 'I ask you about something else.' He said: 'Ask what you wish. What initiates and repeats adultery?' He said: 'Looking, which then settles in the heart... Do not walk much towards amusement and singing, lest heedlessness and sin increase. Do not persist in looking at what is not yours, for what you do not see does not tempt you, and what you do not hear does not harm you.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 578
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي. . . قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ: «
entries.matn_ar: رُبَّمَا غَضِبَ الْمُؤْمِنُ غَضْبَةً تُقْحِمُهُ»
entries.matn_en: The report’s chain is incomplete: … 'Umar b. al-Khattab said: “A believer may sometimes be seized by an anger that drives him headlong [into trouble].”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 579
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي الْحَارِثُ بْنُ نَبْهَانَ، عَنْ غَالِبِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
entries.matn_ar: إِذَا مَسَّهُمْ. . . الْغَضَب "
entries.isnad_en: Al-Harith b. Nabhan reported to me from Ghalib b. 'Ubayd God, from Mujahid,
entries.matn_en: concerning [the phrase] “when anger touches them …” [The transmitted report is fragmentary.]

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 579
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي شَبِيبُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبَانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ الْخُرَاسَانِيِّ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: مَا يَجْرَعُ عَبْدٌ جَرْعَتَينِ أَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنْ جَرْعَةِ غَيْظٍ كَتَمَهَا رَجُلٌ أَوْ جَرْعَةِ غَضَبٍ رَدَّهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Shabib b. Sa'id reported to me from Aban, from Muhammad b. Al-Munkadir, from 'Ata' Al-Khurasani, that Ibn 'Abbas said The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: '
entries.matn_en: No servant swallows two gulps more beloved to God than a gulp of suppressed anger or a gulp of restrained rage.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 580
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ ابْنُ وَهْبٍ: أَخْبَرَنِي حَيْوَةُ بْنُ شُرَيْحٍ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ أَحَبَّكُمْ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَوْ إِلَيَّ وَأَقْرَبَكُمْ مِنِّي مَجْلِسًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَحْسَنُكُمْ أَخْلَاقًا، وَإِنَّ أَبْغَضَكُمْ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَأَبْعَدَكُمْ مِنِّي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ الثَّرْثَارُونَ، الْمُفَيْهِقُونَ، الْمُتَشَادِّقُونَ» ، قَالُوا: وَمَا الْمُفَيْهِقُونَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: «الْمُسْتَكْبِرُونَ» قَالَ عُقْبَةُ: وَالثَّرْثَارُونَ الَّذِينَ يُكْثِرُونَ مِنَ الْحَدِيثِ فِي خَوْضِ الْبَاطِلِ وَالْمُتَشَادِّقُونَ الَّذِينَ يَشَّدَّقُونَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb reported to me: Haywah b. Shurayh reported to me from 'Uqbah b. Muslim, who said
entries.matn_en: it had reached him that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: “The most beloved of you to God—or to me—and the closest to me in standing on the Day of Resurrection are those with the best character. The most hated of you to God and the farthest from me on that Day are the long-winded, the bombastic, and the affected speakers.” They asked, “Who are the mufayhiqun, Messenger of God?” He replied, “The arrogant.” 'Uqbah said: “The long-winded are those who speak at length about falsehood, and the affected speakers are those who distort their mouths while speaking.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 581
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي حَيْوَةُ بْنُ شُرَيْحٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ الْقَيْسِيِّ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ أَشْيَاخُنَا يَنْهَوْنَ الرَّجُلَ أَنْ يَبْتَئِسَ»
entries.isnad_en: Haywah b. Shurayh reported to me from Qays b. Rafi' al-Qaysi, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Our elders used to forbid a man from becoming downhearted.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 581
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ سِنَانِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ، عليه السلام ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: حَسْبُ امْرِئٍ مِنَ السُّوءِ إِلَّا مَنْ عَصَمَهُ اللَّهُ أَنْ يُشِيرَ النَّاسُ إِلَيْهِ بِالْأَصَابِعِ فِي دِينِهِ وَدُنْيَاهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahii'ah reported to me from Yazid b. Abi Habib, from Sinan b. Sa'd, from Anas b. Malik, from the Messenger of God, ﷺ, that he said '
entries.matn_en: It is enough evil for a man, unless God protects him, that people point at him with their fingers regarding his religion or his worldly affairs.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 582
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ حُجَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرٍو، سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، يَقُولُ: «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ الْمُسْلِمَ الْمُسَدِّدَ لَيُدْرِكُ دَرَجَةَ الصُّوَّامِ الْقُوَّامِ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ بِحُسْنِ خُلُقِهِ وَكَرَمِ ضَرِيبَتِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahi'ah reported to me from al-Harith b. Yazid, from Ibn Hujayrah, who said:
entries.matn_en: I heard 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr say: I heard the Messenger of God, ﷺ, say: “By his good character and noble disposition, a rightly guided Muslim can attain the rank of those who fast and stand in prayer reciting God’s signs.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 584
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي هِشَامُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ أَكْمَلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِيمَانًا أَحْسَنُهُمْ خُلُقًا، وَإِنَّمَا بُعِثْتُ لِأُتَمِّمَ صَالِحَ الْأَخْلَاقِ»
entries.isnad_en: Hisham b. Sa'd reported to me from Zayd b. Aslam that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: The most perfect of believers in faith are those with the best character, and I was sent to perfect good character.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 585
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَشْهَلُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ بْنِ الْحَجَّاجِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام: «
entries.matn_ar: خَيْرُ مَا أُعْطِيَ الْإِنْسَانُ الْخُلُقُ الْحَسَنُ، وَإِنَّ شَرَّ مَا أُعْطِي الْإِنْسَانُ الْخُلُقُ السَّيِّئُ فِي صُورَةِ الْحَسَنَةِ» ، قَالَ: «وَمَا كَرِهْتَ أَنْ يَعْلَمَهُ النَّاسُ إِذَا عَمِلْتَهُ فَلَا تَعْمَلْهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ashhal b. Hatim reported to me from Shu'bah b. Al-Hajjaj, from Abu Ishaq, from a man, who said The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: '
