entries.isnad_en: Ya‘qub b. ‘Abd al-Rahman reported to me from Hisham b. ‘Urwah, from his father, from Zaynab, from Umm Habibah, except that in the narration of al-Layth and Ya‘qub, she said: '
entries.matn_en: I heard that you are marrying Durrah, the daughter of Abi Salamah.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 674
entries.matn_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ ، دَعَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: " اللَّهُمَّ هَذَا شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ، وَهَذَا شَهْرُ الصِّيَامِ، وَهَذَا شَهْرُ الْقِيَامِ، وَهَذَا شَهْرُ التَّوْبَةِ، وَهَذَا شَهْرُ الرَّحْمَةِ، وَالْمَغْفِرَةِ، وَالنَّجَاةِ مِنَ النَّارِ، وَالْفَوْزِ بِالْجَنَّةِ، اللَّهُمَّ فَسَلِّمْهُ لِي، وَسَلِّمْنِي فِيهِ، وَسَلِّمْهُ مِنِّي، وَأَعِنِّي فِيهِ بِأَفْضَلِ عَونِكَ، وَوَفِّقْنِي فِيهِ لِطَاعَتِكَ، وَأَفْرِغْنِي فِيهِ بِعِبَادَتِكَ وَدُعَائِكَ وَتِلَاوَةِ كِتَابِكَ، وَأَعْظِمْ لِي فِيهِ الْبَرَكَةَ، وَأَحْسِنْ لِي فِيهِ الْعَافِيَةَ، وَأَصِحَّ فِيهِ بَدَنِي، وَأَوْسِعْ فِيهِ رِزْقِي، وَاكْفِنِي فِيهِ مَا مِنِّي، وَاسْتَجِبْ فِيهِ دُعَائِي، وَبَلِّغْنِي فِيهِ رَجَائِي، اللَّهُمَّ أَذْهِبْ عَنِّي فِيهِ النُّعَاسَ، وَالْكَسَلَ، وَالسَّآمَةَ، وَالْفَتْرَةَ، وَالْقَسْوَةَ، وَالْغَفْلَةَ، وَالْغِرَّةَ، وَجَنِّبْنِي فِيهِ الْعِلَلَ، وَالْأَشْغَالَ، وَالْهُمُومَ، وَالْأَحْزَانَ، وَالْأَعْرَاضَ، وَالْأَمْرَاضَ، وَالْخَطَايَا، وَالذُّنُوبَ، وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي فِيهِ السُّوءَ، وَالْفَحْشَاءَ، وَالْجَهْلَ، وَاللَّهْوَ، وَالتَّعَبَ، وَالْعَنَاءَ ، إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ، اللَّهُمَّ فَأَعِذْنِي فِيهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ، وَهَمْزِهِ، وَنَفْثِهِ، وَنَفْخِهِ، وَوَسْوَسَتِهِ، وَتَثْبِيطِهِ، وَكَيْدِهِ، وَمَكْرِهِ، وَخَيْلِهِ، وَحِيَلِهِ، وَرَجِلِهِ، وَشَرَكِهِ، وَأَعْوَانِهِ، وَأَحْزَابِهِ، وَأَتْبَاعِهِ، وَأَوْلِيَائِهِ، وَشُرَكَائِهِ ، اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي فِيهِ الْجِدَّ، وَالِاجْتِهَادَ، وَالْقُوَّةَ، وَالنَّشَاطَ، وَالْإِنَابَةَ، وَالتَّوْبَةَ، وَالرَّغْبَةَ، وَصِدْقَ النِّيَّةِ، وَالرَّوْعَةَ، وَالوَرِعَةَ، وَالْوَجَلَ مِنْكَ، وَالرَّجَاءَ لَكَ، وَالثِّقَةَ بِكَ، وَالتَّوَكُّلَ عَلَيْكَ، وَالْوَزَعَ عَنْ مَحَارِمِكَ، وَصَالِحَ الْعِلْمِ، وَمَرْفُوعَ الْعَمَلِ، وَمُسْتَجَابَ الدُّعَاءِ، وَلَا تَحُلْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ شَيْءٍ مِنْ ذَلِكَ بِعَرَضٍ، وَلَا مَرَضٍ ، وَلَا هَمٍّ، وَلَا حَزَنٍ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ، وَأَعْظِمْ لِي فِيهِ أَفْضَلَ مَا تُعْطِي فِيهِ أَوْلِيَاءَكَ الْمُتَّقِينَ مِنَ الْمَغْفِرَةِ، وَالرَّحْمَةِ، وَالتَّحَنُّنِ، وَالْمُعَافَاةِ، وَالْعَافِيَةِ الدَّائِمَةِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ دُعَائِي فِيهِ إِلَيْكَ وَاصِلًا ، عَمَلِي فِيهِ مَقْبُولًا، وَذَنْبِي فِيهِ مَغْفُورًا ، حَتَّى يَكُونَ نَصِيبِي فِيهِ الْأَكْثَرَ وَحَظِّي فِيهِ الْأَكْبَرَ لِلَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ عَلَى أَفْضَلَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ مِنْ أَوْلِيَائِكِ وَأَرْضَاهَا عِنْدَكَ. شَهْرٌ وَارْزُقْنِي فِيهَا أَفْضَلَ مَا رَزَقْتَ أَحَدًا مِمَّنْ بَلَّغْتَهُ إِيَّاهَا وَأَكْرَمْتَهُ بِهَا، اجَعَلَنِي مِنْ عُتَقَائِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ، وَطُلَقَائِكَ مِنْ جَهَنَّمَ، وَسُعَدَاءِ خَلْقِكَ بِمَغْفِرَتِكَ، وَرَحْمَتِكَ، وَرِضْوَانِكَ، وَمُعَافَاتِكَ، وَعَافِيَتِكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ. اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ الْفَجْرِ وَلَيَالٍ عَشَرٍ، رَبَّ جِبْرِيلَ، وَمِيكَائِيلَ، وَإِسْرَافِيلَ، وَإِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ، وَإِسْحَاقَ، وَيَعْقُوبَ، وَرَبَّ مُوسَى، فَرَرْنَا إِلَيْكَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِنَا فَآوِنَا، وَتَائِبِينَ فَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا، وَمُسْتَغْفِرِينَ فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا، وَمُسْتَجِيرِينَ فَأَجِرْنَا، وَمُسْتَسْلِمِينَ فَلَا تَخْذُلْنَا، وَهَارِبِينَ فَأَمِّنَّا، وَرَاغِبِينَ فَشَفِّعْنَا. . . . . . أَوْلَادُهَا قَالَ: وَقَالُوا: يَا لَبَّيْكَ، يَا لَبَّيْكَ، قَالَ: وَأَقْبَلُوا وَالدَّعْوَةُ فِي الْأَنْصَارِ، يَقُولُونَ: يَا مَعْشَرَ الْأَنْصَارِ، يَا مَعْشَرَ الْأَنْصَارِ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ قُصِرَتِ الدَّعْوَةُ عَلَى بَنِي الْحَارِثِ بْنِ الْخَزْرَجِ، قَالُوا: يَا بَنِي الْحَارِثِ بْنِ الْخَزْرَجِ، يَا بَنِي الْحَارِثِ بْنِ الْخَزْرَجِ، فَنَظَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ، صلى الله عليه وسلم ، وَهُوَ عَلَى بَغْلَتِهِ كَالْمُتَطَاوِلِ عَلَيْهَا إِلَى قِتَالِهِمْ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ، صلى الله عليه وسلم: «هَذَا حِينَ حَمِيَ الْوَطِيسُ» ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ أَخَذَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ حَصَيَاتٍ فَرَمَاهُنَّ فِي وُجُوهِ الْكُفَّارِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «انْهَزَمُوا وَرَبِّ مُحَمَّدٍ» ، قَالَ: فَذَهَبْتُ أَنْظُرُ فَإِذَا الْقِتَالُ عَلَى هَيْئَتِهِ فِيمَا أَرَى أَنْ رَمَاهُمُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ، صلى الله عليه وسلم ، بِحَصَيَاتِهِ فَمَا زِلْتُ أَرَى حَدَّهُمْ كَلِيلًا وَأَمْرَهُمْ مُدْبِرًا، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ: {لَقَدْ نَصَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ فِي مَوَاطِنَ كَثِيرَةٍ وَيَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ إِذْ أَعْجَبَتْكُمْ كَثْرَتُكُمْ فَلَمْ تُغْنِ عَنْكُمْ شَيْئًا وَضَاقَتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْأَرْضُ بِمَا رَحُبَتْ ثُمَّ وَلَّيْتُمْ مُدْبِرِينَ ثُمَّ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ وَعَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَأَنْزَلَ جُنُودًا لَمْ تَرَوْهَا وَعَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَذَلِكَ جَزَاءُ الْكَافِرِينَ} [التوبة: 26] قَالَ: وَسَبَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ، صلى الله عليه وسلم ، مِنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ سِتَّةَ آلَافٍ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ وَالذَّرَارِيِّ وَأَخَذَ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ وَالشَّاءِ مَا لَا يَدْرُونَ مَا عَدَدُهُ ، وَخَمَّسَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ، صلى الله عليه وسلم ، السَّبْيَ وَالْأَمْوَالَ، ثُمَّ جَاءَهُ وَفْدُ هَوَزِانَ، فَقَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنْتَ أَعْدَلُ النَّاسِ وَأَبَرُّهُمْ وَأَرْحَمُهُمْ بِالنَّاسِ، وَقَدْ أَخَذْتَ نِسَاءَنَا وَذَرَارِيَّنَا. . . . لينا ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ، صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّ خَيْرَ الْحَدِيثِ أَصْدَقُهُ، وَعِنْدِي مَنْ تَرَوْنَ مِنَ النَّاسِ. . . . . كُلِّهِ، فَانْظُرُوا أَيَّ الطَّائِفَتَيْنِ شِئْتُمْ، فَإِنْ شِئْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ وَالذَّرَارِيَّ، وَإِنْ شِئْتُمُ الْأَمْوَالَ» ، قَالُوا: نِسَاءَنَا وَذَرَارِيَّنَا، فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ، صلى الله عليه وسلم ، فِي الْمُسْلِمِينَ فَقَالَ: «يَا مَعْشَرَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ إِنَّ إِخْوَانَكُمْ هَؤُلَاءِ مِنْ هَوَزِانَ قَدْ رَدَدْتُ نِسَاءَهُمْ وَذَرَارِيَّهُمْ، فَمَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يُطَيِّبَ ذَلِكَ فَلْيَفْعَلْ، وَمَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يَكْتُبَ عَلَيْنَا فَلْيَفْعَلْ» ، فَقَالَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ: لَا ، بَلْ قَدْ طَيَّبْنَا ذَلِكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ. . . . . ذَلِكَ مِنْكُمْ مِمَّنْ لَمْ يَطِبْهُ فَارْجِعُوا حَتَّى يَرْفَعَ إِلَيْنَا عُرَفَاؤُكُمْ بَيَانَ أَمْرِكُمْ فِي ذَلِكَ، فَطَيَّبَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ خَيْرَ مُجِيبٍ دَعَوَاتِ الْمُضْطَرِّينَ، كَاشِفَ كُلِّ سُوءٍ إِلَهَ الْعَالَمِينَ، أَدْعُوكَ بِأَسْمَائِكَ كُلِّهَا مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهَا وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ، يَا رَبِّ سُبْحَانَكَ لَكَ الصِّفَاتُ الْعُلَا، وَالْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَى جِبْرِيلَ وَإِلَهَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ، وَإِسْحَاقَ، وَيَعْقُوبَ ذُو الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ ، أَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبِّ بِكَ تُعْطِيَنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ، وَلَا تَخْلِفْ وَجُوهَنَا إِلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ ، بِالَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَأَنْ تَجْعَلَنَا مِنْ. . . . صلك، وَتَمُنُّ عَلَيْهِمْ بِطَوْلِكَ، وَتَجُودُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِعَفْوِكَ، بِالَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ. . . . . . مَنَعْتَ، سُبْحَانَكَ يَا رَبِّ لَمْ تَنْسَ أَحَدًا طَلَبَكَ، وَلَمْ تُخَيِّبْ أَحَدًا سَأَلَكَ، وَلَمْ تُعْطِبْ أَحَدًا اتَّكَلَ عَلَيْكَ، يَا رَبِّ سُبْحَانَكَ إِرَادَتُكَ فِعْلٌ، وَقَضَاؤُكَ عَدْلٌ، وَأَمَرُكَ مَاضٍ. . . راك تحويل، مَنْ عَصَمْتَهُ سَعِدَ وَنَجَا، وَمَنْ خَذَلْتَهُ عَطِبَ. . . وَغموا فَلَا إِلَهَ. . . . وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ {سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ وَسَلَّامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ} [الصافات: 180] ، فَسُبْحَانَ رَبِّنَا وَتَقَدَّسَتْ أَسْمَاؤُهُ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، أَهْلُ الْحَمْدِ وَمُنْتَهَاهُ، وَمَأْوَاهُ وَمُبْتَدِئُ الْجِدِّ وَمُبْتَدِعُهُ وَمُصْطَفِيهِ سُبْحَانَهُ وَبِحَمْدِهِ نَحْمَدُكَ، {وَلَكِنْ لَا تَفْقَهُونَ تَسْبِيحَهُمْ} [الإسراء: 44] ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَلَا فَقَهَرَ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي مَلَكَ فَقَدَرَ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَهُ سُبْحَانَهُ مِنْ كُلِّ غَيْرِ الْمُرْتَدِي بِالْكِبْرِيَاءِ، اغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي، وَعَثْرَتِي، وَظُلْمِي، وَإِسْرَافِي عَلَى نَفْسِي، وَارْزُقْنِي مِنْ فَضْلِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ ، فَإِنَّهُمَا بِيَدِكَ لَا يَمْلِكُهُمَا أَحَدٌ غَيْرُكَ، اغْفِرْ لِي مَا سَلَفَ مِنِّي، وَاعْصِمْنِي فِيمَا بَقِيَ مِنْ عُمُرِي، وَاسْتُرْ عَلَى وَالِدَيَّ وَمَنْ كَانَ مِنِّي مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بسب. . . . . . .، وَالْآخِرَة فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ كُلَّهُ بِيَدِكَ، وَأَنْتَ وَاسِعُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ، وَلَا تُخَيِّبْنِي يَا رَبِّ، وَلَا تَرُدَّ يَدَيَّ فِي نَحْرِي حِينَ دُعَائِكَ، وَتَسْتَجِيبُ لِي جَمِيعَ مَا سَأَلْتُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي تَمَامَ صِيَامِهِ وَبُلُوغَ الْأَمَلِ فِي كُلِّ مَا يُرْضِيكَ فِيهِ صَبْرًا وَإِيمَانًا وَيَقِينًا وَاحْتِسَابًا، ثُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ ذَلِكَ مِنِّي بِالْإِضْعَافِ الدَّائِمِ ، صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ مُجِيبٌ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ ، وَحَقِّ مَنْ سَأَلَ الْعَبْدُ رَبَّهُ وَلَمْ يَسَلِ الْعِبَادُ مِثْلَكَ. . . السَّائِلِينَ وَمُنْتَهَى حَاجَةِ الرَّاغِبِينَ، وَيَا رَجَاءَ الْمُضْطَرِّينَ، وَيَا غِيَاثَ الْمُسْتَغِيثِينَ، وَيَا اللَّهُ الرَّحْمَنُ الرَّحِيمُ، وَيَا جَارَ الْمُسْتَجِيرِينَ، الْمَكْنُونُ مِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ، الْمَكْنُونُ مِنْ كُلِّ. . . وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا، صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ، صلى الله عليه وسلم ، وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ، لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ، حَسْبِيَ الرَّبُّ مِنَ الْعِبَادِ، حَسْبِيَ الْخَالِقُ مِنَ الْمَخْلُوقِينَ، حَسْبِيَ الَّذِي لَا يَمُنُّ مِمَّنْ يَمُنُّ، حَسْبِي الْعَظِيمُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي بِذِمَّتِكَ، وَأَسْكِنِّي فِي الْجَنَّةِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ، يَا كَرِيمُ يَا رَبِّ، سُبْحَانَكَ، لَا يَجْزِي بَآلَائِكَ أَحَدٌ، وَلَا يُحْصِي نَهَاكَ أَحَدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بِخَيرِكَ انْصَرَفْتُ، وَبِذُنُوبِي اعْتَرَفْتُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا اقْتَرَفْتُ، يَا. . . دِينكَ حَتَّى أَلْقَاكَ بِهِ ، الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، يَا كَرِيمُ، اللَّهُمَّ وَمَا قَصَّرَتْ عَنْهُ رَغْبَتِي، وَعَجَزَتْ فِيهِ طَاعَتِي، وَصَلَاحُ آخِرَتِي وَدُنْيَايَ، وَفِي السَّلَامَةِ مِنْ كُلِّ سُوءٍ فَأَعْطِنِيهُ، وَمُنَّ بِهِ عَلَيَّ عَاجِلًا، وَأُحْسِنُ تِلَاوَةَ كِتَابِكَ كُلَّمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي وَحَبِّبْهُ إِلَيَّ، وَزَيِّنْهُ فِي عَيْنِي ، وَنُوِّرْهُ فِي قَلْبِي، وَاشْرَحْ بِهِ صَدْرِي. . . تَنْهَى فِيهِ عَنْ فِتَنِكَ حَتَّى تُبَلِّغَنِي بِنِعْمَتِكَ عِنْدِي فِيهِ دَرَجَاتِ مَنْ أَتْمَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ فِيهِ. . . بِهِ مِنَّةً يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ، اجْعَلْهُ لِي يَا رَبِّ إِمَامًا، وَنُورًا، وَهُدًى، وَرَحْمَةً، وَحُجَّةً لِي وَلَا تَجْعَلْهُ حُجَّةً عَلَيَّ، عَلِّمْنِي مِنْهُ مَا جَهِلْتُ، وَارْزُقْنِي تِلَاوَتَهُ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ عَلَى النَّحْوِ الَّذِي يُرْضِيكَ عَنِّي ، بِالَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَدْعُوكَ بِاسْمِكَ ، ذَكَرْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عَلِمِ الْغَيْبِ، أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ فِي جَمِيعِ أَمْرِي، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ فِي جَمِيعِ أَمْرِي، فَخَيِّرْ لِي خِيَرَةً فِي كُلِّ مَا دَخَلْتُ فِيهِ، وَفِي كُلِّ مَا خَرَجْتُ مِنْهُ، وَفِي كُلِّ مَا ذَكَرْتُ اسْتِجَارَتَكَ عِنْدَهُ، فَأَسْأَلُكَ فِي ذَلِكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ مِمَّا عَلِمْتَ لِي ، يَا عَلَّامَ الْغُيُوبِ، فِيهِ الْخَيْرُ فِي الْعَاجِلَةِ. . . . . .، لِنُورِهِ السَّمَوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ يَا اللَّهُ ذُو الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ، لَا تَحْرِمْنِي ثَوَابَ مَا أَسْأَلُكَ. . . . . . وَمَا مِنَ الْخَائِفِينَ، وَمُنْتَهَى رَغْبَةِ الْعَابِدِينِ، الْمُفَرِّجُ عَنِ الْمَكْرُوبِينَ، الْمُرَوِّحُ عَنِ الْمَغْمُومِينَ. . . . . . . وَعَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ، وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ، مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ، أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا
entries.matn_en: In the name of God, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate. ‘Abd Allah b. ‘Abbas supplicated: 'O God, this is the month of Ramadan, the month of fasting, the month of standing in prayer, the month of repentance, the month of mercy, forgiveness, salvation from the Fire, and attainment of Paradise. O God, bring Ramadan safely to me, preserve me throughout it, and accept it from me. Assist me in it with Your best assistance, guide me in it to Your obedience, occupy me in it with Your worship, supplication, and recitation of Your Book. Increase for me in it blessings, grant me in it good health, keep my body healthy in it, expand my provision in it, suffice me in it for what comes from me, answer my supplication in it, and fulfill my hope in it. O God, remove from me in it drowsiness, laziness, boredom, slackness, hardness of heart, heedlessness, and deception. Keep me away from illnesses, distractions, worries, sorrows, ailments, sins, and transgressions. Turn away from me evil, indecency, ignorance, play, fatigue, and hardship. You are the One who answers supplications. O God, protect me in it from Satan, his whispering, his spitting, his blowing, his insinuations, his discouragement, his plotting, his deception, his cavalry, his tricks, his infantry, his snares, his helpers, his parties, his followers, and his partners. O God, grant me in it diligence, striving, strength, energy, turning to You, repentance, desire, sincerity of intention, awe, piety, fear of You, hope in You, trust in You, restraint from Your prohibitions, beneficial knowledge, elevated deeds, answered supplications, and do not let anything prevent me from these due to an affliction, illness, worry, or sorrow, by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful. Grant me in it the best of what You grant to Your righteous servants of forgiveness, mercy, tenderness, well-being, and continuous safety in this world and the Hereafter. O God, make my supplication in it reach You, my deeds in it accepted, and my sins in it forgiven, so that my share in it is the greatest and my portion in it is the largest, for the Night of Decree, so that no one from Your friends and those most pleasing to You is given preference over it. A month, grant me in it the best of what You have granted anyone whom You have allowed to reach it and honored with it. Make me among those freed by You from the Fire, those released by You from Hell, and the fortunate of Your creation through Your forgiveness, mercy, pleasure, well-being, and safety, by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful. O God, Lord of the dawn and the ten nights, Lord of Jibril, Mika’il, Israfil, Ibrahim, Isma‘il, Ishaq, Ya‘qub, Lord of Musa, we flee to You from our sins, so shelter us; we are repentant, so accept our repentance; we seek forgiveness, so forgive us; we seek refuge, so grant us refuge; we submit, so do not forsake us; we flee, so grant us security; we desire, so intercede for us... Her children said, 'At your service! At your service!' They came while the call was among the Ansar, saying: 'O assembly of the Ansar, O assembly of the Ansar.' Then the call was restricted to Bani al-Harith b. al-Khazraj, saying: 'O Bani al-Harith b. al-Khazraj, O Bani al-Harith b. al-Khazraj.' The Messenger of God, ﷺ, looked while he was on his mule, stretching towards their fighting, and said: 'This is when the battle heats up.' Then the Messenger of God, ﷺ, took pebbles and threw them at the faces of the disbelievers, then said: 'They have been defeated by the Lord of Muhammad.' I went to look, and the battle was as it was, but the Messenger of God, ﷺ, had thrown pebbles at them. I kept seeing their edge dull and their affair retreating. God revealed: {Certainly has God given you victory on many battlefields, and on the day of Hunayn, when your great number pleased you, but it did not avail you at all, and the earth, vast as it is, was straitened for you; then you turned back, fleeing. Then God sent down His tranquility upon His Messenger and upon the believers and sent down soldiers you did not see and punished those who disbelieved. And that is the recompense of the disbelievers.} [At-Tawbah: 25-26]. The Messenger of God, ﷺ, took six thousand women and children captive that day and took camels and sheep in numbers they could not count. He set aside one-fifth of the captives and property. Then the delegation of Hawazin came to him and said: 'O Messenger of God, you are the most just and most righteous of people and the most merciful to people. You have taken our women and children...' He said to them: 'The best speech is the truest. I have with me those you see of the people... all of it. Look which of the two groups you prefer. If you prefer the women and children, or if you prefer the wealth.' They said: 'Our women and children.' The Messenger of God, ﷺ, stood among the Muslims and said: 'O assembly of Muslims, these are your brothers from Hawazin. I have returned their women and children to them. Whoever wishes to make this voluntary, let him do so, and whoever wishes to have it recorded against us, let him do so.' The Muslims said: 'No, we willingly agree to it, O Messenger of God...' Whoever among you has not willingly agreed to this, return until your leaders convey your decision to us. The Muslims willingly agreed. [The supplication resumes:] O best responder to the supplications of the distressed, the remover of every evil, the God of the worlds. I call upon You by all Your names, those I know and those I do not know, O Lord, glory be to You. To You belong the loftiest attributes and the most beautiful names, Jibril, the God of Ibrahim, Isma‘il, Ishaq, and Ya‘qub, the Possessor of Majesty and Honor. I ask You, O Lord, by You, to grant us from poverty, and do not turn our faces to anyone from Your creation, by the One besides Whom there is no deity, and to make us among... Your protection, and bestow upon them by Your grace, and be generous to them with Your pardon, by the One besides Whom there is no deity, glory be to You, O Lord. You have not forgotten anyone who sought You, nor have You disappointed anyone who asked You, nor have You let down anyone who relied on You, O Lord, glory be to You. Your will is action, Your decree is just, and Your command is executed... whom You protect is fortunate and saved, and whom You forsake is ruined... and they are saddened, so there is no deity... and He gives life and causes death, while He is alive and does not die. Good is in His hand, and He is over all things competent. God has fulfilled His promise, aided His servant, and defeated the confederates alone. {Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe. And peace upon the messengers. And praise to God, Lord of the worlds.} [As-Saffat: 180-182]. So glory be to our Lord, and His names are sanctified and praised. The people of praise and its ultimate end, its refuge and its originator, the initiator of seriousness, its creator, and its chosen one, glory be to Him and praised. We praise You, {but you do not understand their praise.} [Al-Isra: 44]. Praise be to God who is exalted and overpowering, praise be to God who possesses and decrees, praise be to God who gives life and causes death, and He is over all things competent. Glory be to Him, glory be to Him, from every other who is clothed with pride. Forgive my sins, my stumbling, my oppression, and my excesses upon myself. Provide for me from Your bounty and mercy, for they are in Your hand, and no one else possesses them. Forgive what has passed from me, protect me in what remains of my life, and conceal the faults of my parents and those of the believers from me... and the Hereafter, for all of that is in Your hand, and You are vast in forgiveness. Do not disappoint me, O Lord, nor turn my hands against my throat when I call upon You, and answer all that I have asked of You by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful. O God, grant me the completion of its fasting and the attainment of hope in all that pleases You in it, with patience, faith, certainty, and expectation. Then accept that from me with continuous multiplication. May God’s blessings be upon Muhammad, the one who answers. O God, You are my Lord and I am Your servant, by the right of the servant who asks his Lord, and no servant has asked the likes of You... the seekers, the end of the need of those who desire, O hope of the distressed, O refuge of those who seek help, O God, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate, O neighbor of those who seek refuge, hidden from every eye, hidden from every... and much praise be to God. May God’s blessings be upon our Prophet Muhammad, the servant of God and His Messenger, peace and blessings of God. There is no power except with God, the Most High, the Most Great. My Lord suffices me among the servants, my Creator suffices me among the created, He who does not bestow from those who bestow suffices me, the Most Great suffices me. O God, assist me with Your protection, and settle me in Paradise by Your mercy, O Generous, O Lord, glory be to You. No one can repay Your favors, nor can anyone enumerate Your prohibitions. O God, I have turned to You with Your goodness, and I have confessed my sins. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have committed. O... Your religion until I meet You with it, the One besides Whom there is no deity, O Generous. O God, whatever my desire has fallen short of, and my obedience has been incapable of, and the goodness of my Hereafter and my world, and safety from every evil, so grant it to me and bestow it upon me soon. Let me recite Your Book well whenever You teach me, make it beloved to me, beautify it in my eyes, illuminate it in my heart, and expand my chest with it... You prohibit in it from Your trials until You bring me, by Your favor, to the ranks of those whom You have perfected in it... by it, O Most Merciful of the merciful. Make it for me, O Lord, a guide, a light, guidance, mercy, and an argument for me, and do not make it an argument against me. Teach me from it what I do not know, and grant me its recitation during the hours of the night and day in the manner that pleases You... I call upon You by Your name, which You have mentioned in Your Book, or taught to any of Your creation, or kept to Yourself in the knowledge of the unseen. I seek Your guidance by Your knowledge in all my affairs, and I seek Your power by Your ability in all my affairs. Choose for me the best choice in everything I enter into, and in everything I leave, and in everything I have mentioned seeking Your refuge in it. I ask You from Your bounty in that which You know is good for me, O Knower of the unseen. In it is the good in the immediate... for its light are the heavens and the earth, O God, Possessor of Majesty and Honor. Do not deprive me of the reward of what I ask You... and from the fearful, and the end of the desire of the worshippers, the reliever of the distressed, the comforter of the grieving... and upon him be peace, and the mercy of God. What God wills, there is no power except with God the Most Great. I bear witness that God is over all things competent, and that God encompasses all things in knowledge.

entries.isnad_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ، وَأَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي كَثِيرُ بْنُ عَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ، قَالَ قَالَ عَبَّاسٌ:
entries.matn_ar: شَهِدْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ، صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ ، فَلَزِمْتُ أَنَا وَأَبُو سُفْيَانَ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، فَلَمْ نُفَارِقْهُ، وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ عَلَى بَغْلَةٍ لَهُ بَيْضَاءَ أَهْدَاهَا لَهُ فَرْوَةُ بْنُ نُفَاثَةَ الْجُذَامِيُّ، فَلَمَّا الْتَقَى الْمُسْلِمُونَ وَالْكُفَّارُ وَلَّى الْمُسْلِمُونَ مُدْبِرِينَ، فَطَفِقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ، صلى الله عليه وسلم ، يَرْكُضُ بَغْلَتَهُ قِبَلَ الْكُفَّارِ، قَالَ عَبَّاسٌ: وَأَنَا آخِذٌ بِلِجَامِ بَغْلَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، أَكُفُّهَا إِرَادَةَ أَنْ لَا تُسْرِعَ وَأَبُو سُفْيَانَ آخِذٌ بِرِكَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَيْ عَبَّاسُ نَادِ أَصْحَابَ السَّمُرَةِ» ، قَالَ: فَوَاللَّهِ لَكَأَنَّ عَطْفَتَهُمْ حِينَ سَمِعُوا صَوْتِي عَطْفَةُ الْبَقَرِ عَلَيَّ لَرَفَعَتِ الْعُرَفَاءُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، فَرَدَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَيْهِمْ نِسَاءَهُمْ وَذَرَارِيَّهُمْ، وَقَسَّمَ النَّعَمَ، وَالشَّاءَ بَيْنَ مَنْ مَعَهُ، وَأَنَّهُ ثَمَّ إِنْ قَفَلَ فِيهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِعُمْرَةٍ، وَذَلِكَ فِي ذِي الْقِعْدَةِ، قَالَ: وَتَأَلَّفَ يَوْمَئِذٍ رِجَالًا مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ رِجَالًا مِنَ الْعَرَبِ، فَأَعْطَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَئِذٍ صَفْوَانَ بْنَ أُمَيَّةَ مِنَ النَّعَمِ مِائَةً ثُمَّ مِائَةً، ثُمَّ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ: فَحَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ أَنَّ صَفْوَانَ بْنَ أُمَيَّةَ قَالَ: وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ أَعْطَانِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا أَعْطَانِي، وَإِنَّهُ لَأَبْغَضُ النَّاسِ إِلَيَّ ، فَمَا بَرِحَ يُعْطِينِي حَتَّى إِنَّهُ لَأَحَبُّ النَّاسِ إِلَيَّ، وَأَعْطَى حَكِيمَ بْنَ حِزَامٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ مِائَةً مِنَ النَّعَمِ، ثُمَّ مِائَةً ثُمَّ مِائَةً، ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِحَكِيمٍ: «إِنَّ هَذَا الْمَالَ خَضِرَةٌ حُلْوَةٌ مَنْ أَخَذَهُ بِحَقِّهِ بُورِكَ لَهُ فِيهِ، وَمَنْ أَخَذَهُ بِإِشْرَافِ نَفْسٍ لَمْ يُبَارَكْ لَهُ فِيهِ، وَكَانَ كَالَّذِي يَأْكُلُ وَلَا يَشْبَعُ، وَالْيَدُ الْعُلْيَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْيَدِ السُّفْلَى» . . . . . . رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَئِذٍ رحران مِائَةً مِنَ الْإِبِلِ، وَأَعْطَى الْأَقْرَعَ بْنَ حَابِسٍ مِائَةً مِنَ الْإِبِلِ، وَأَعْطَى فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: «لَكَ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ» حَتَّى إِذَا قَدِمْنَا أَمَّرَ أَبَا بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقَ عَلَى الْحَجِّ
entries.matn_en: In the name of God, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate. Yunus reported to me from Ibn Shihab who said Kathir b. ‘Abbas b. ‘Abd al-Muttalib told me that ‘Abbas said: I witnessed the Battle of Hunayn with the Messenger of God, ﷺ. I and Abu Sufyan b. al-Harith b. ‘Abd al-Muttalib stayed close to the Messenger of God, ﷺ, and did not leave him. The Messenger of God was on a white mule that Farwah b. Nufathah al-Judhami had gifted to him. When the Muslims and the disbelievers met, the Muslims turned and fled. The Messenger of God, ﷺ, began urging his mule towards the disbelievers. ‘Abbas said: I was holding the reins of the Messenger of God’s mule, restraining it so it would not rush, and Abu Sufyan was holding the stirrup of the Messenger of God. The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: 'O ‘Abbas, call the companions of the Samurah tree.' By God, when they heard my voice, they turned like cows turning to their calves. The leaders came to the Messenger of God, and he returned their women and children to them. He divided the camels and sheep among those with him. Then the Messenger of God, ﷺ, returned from there with an ‘Umrah, and that was in Dhu al-Qa‘dah. On that day, he reconciled some men from Quraysh with some men from the Arabs. The Messenger of God, ﷺ, gave Safwan b. Umayyah one hundred camels, then another hundred, then another hundred. Ibn Shihab said: Sa‘id ibn al-Musayyib told me that Safwan b. Umayyah said: By God, the Messenger of God, ﷺ, gave me what he gave me, and he was the most hateful of people to me. But he kept giving me until he became the most beloved of people to me. He also gave Hakim b. Hizam one hundred camels, then another hundred, then another hundred. Then the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said to Hakim: 'This wealth is fresh and sweet. Whoever takes it rightfully will be blessed in it, but whoever takes it with covetousness will not be blessed in it. He is like one who eats and is not satisfied. The upper hand is better than the lower hand.'... The Messenger of God, ﷺ, gave Rahran one hundred camels that day, and he gave al-Aqra‘ b. Habis one hundred camels... The Messenger of God said: 'You may go to Medina.' When we arrived, Abu Bakr al-Siddiq was appointed to lead the Hajj.

entries.isnad_ar: حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ "
entries.matn_ar: اتَّخَذَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَاتَمًا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، فَقَالَ: «إِنِّي كُنْتُ أَلْبَسُ هَذَا الْخَاتَمَ» ، فَنَبَذَهُ، وَقَالَ: «لَا أَلْبَسُهُ أَبَدًا» . قَالَ: فَنَبَذَ النَّاسُ خَوَاتِمَهُمْ "
entries.isnad_en: Harmalah b. Yahya reported to us: ‘Abd Allah b. Wahb reported to me: Malik b. Anas reported to me from ‘Abd Allah b. Dinar, from ‘Abd Allah b. ‘Umar, who said 'The Messenger of God, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: had a ring made of gold. Then the Messenger of God, ﷺ, stood up and said: "I used to wear this ring." So he threw it away and said: "I will never wear it again." The people then threw away their rings.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 684
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ سَمْعَانَ، وَأُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ اللَّيْثِيُّ، وَغَيْرُهُمَا، أَنَّ نَافِعًا أَخْبَرَهُمْ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ اصْطَنَعَ خَاتَمًا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَكَانَ فَصُّهُ مِنْ دَاخِلٍ إِذَا لَبِسَهُ، فَإِنَّ النَّاسَ صَنَعُوا خَوَاتِمَ، فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ فَنَزَعَ خَاتَمَهُ، وَقَالَ: «كُنْتُ أَلْبَسُ هَذَا الْخَاتَمَ، فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتُمُونِي صَنَعْتُ هَذِهِ الْحَلْقَةَ صَنَعْتُمُوهَا» ، فَقَالَ: «لَا أَلْبَسُهُ أَبَدًا» ، فَنَبَذَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ الْخَاتَمَ، فَنَبَذَ النَّاسُ خَوَاتِمَهُمْ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Sam‘an, Usamah b. Zayd al-Laythi, and others reported to me that Nafi‘ told them from ‘Abd Allah b. ‘Umar, from the Messenger of God, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: that he had a ring made of gold, and its stone was on the inside when he wore it. The people then made rings, so the Messenger of God, ﷺ, stood on the pulpit, removed his ring, and said "I used to wear this ring. When you saw me make this ring, you made them." He said: "I will never wear it again." The Messenger of God, ﷺ, threw away the ring, and the people threw away their rings.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 685
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام «
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ يَلْبَسُ خَاتَمًا فِي يَمِينِهِ ، وَيَجْعَلُ فَصَّهُ فِي بَاطِنِ كَفِّهِ» قَالَ نَافِعٌ: وَكَانَ خَاتَمُ ابْنِ عُمَرَ مِنْ وَرِقٍ
entries.isnad_en: ‘Abd Allah b. ‘Umar b. Hafs b. ‘Asim b. ‘Umar b. al-Khattab reported to me from Nafi‘, from ‘Abd Allah b. ‘Umar, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, '
entries.matn_en: used to wear a ring on his right hand and place its stone on the inside of his palm.' Nafi‘ said 'Ibn ‘Umar’s ring was made of silver.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 686
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو إِدْرِيسَ الْخَوْلَانِيُّ، "
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا مِمَّنْ أَدْرَكَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام لَبِسَ خَاتَمًا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، فَرَآهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، فِي يَدِهِ، فَقَرَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام بِعَصًا فِي يَدِهِ وَضَرَبَ أُصْبُعَ الرَّجُلِ الَّذِي فِيهِ الْخَاتَمُ حَتَّى أَوْجَعَهُ، ثُمَّ شُغِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ، صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَعْضِ كَلَامِ النَّاسِ، فَنَزَعَ الرَّجُلُ خَاتَمَهُ فَرَمَى بِهِ، فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، نَظَرَ وَإِذَا هُوَ لَا يَرَى خَاتَمَهُ فِي يَدِهِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَيْنَ خَاتَمُكَ؟» قَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَلَا ظَنَنْتُ أَنَّكَ حِينَ ضَرَبْتَنِي بِالْعَصَا كَرِهْتَ مَكَانَ خَاتَمِي ، فَنَزَعْتُهُ، فَرَمَيْتُ بِهِ، قَالَ: رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَظُنُّنَا قَدْ أَوْجَعْنَاكَ وَغَرَّمْنَاكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yunus b. Yazid reported to me from Ibn Shihab who said Abu Idris al-Khawlani told me
entries.matn_en: that a man who had met the Messenger of God, ﷺ, wore a gold ring. The Messenger of God, ﷺ, saw it on his hand and struck the man’s finger that had the ring with a stick he was holding until it hurt him. Then the Messenger of God, ﷺ, was distracted by some people’s conversation. The man removed his ring and threw it away. When the Messenger of God, ﷺ, finished, he looked and did not see the ring on his hand. He asked him: 'Where is your ring?' The man said: 'O Messenger of God, I thought that when you struck me with the stick, you disliked the place of my ring, so I removed it and threw it away.' The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: 'I think we have hurt you and caused you to lose your ring.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 687
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، أَوْ عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، وَابْنُ سَمْعَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ، صلى الله عليه وسلم ، بِذَلِكَ
entries.isnad_en: Yunus b. Yazid, or ‘Amr b. al-Harith, and Ibn Sam‘an reported to me from Ibn Shihab, from the Messenger of God, ﷺ, similarly.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 688
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي مَنْ لَا أَتَّهِمُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: رَأَى عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ فِي خِلَافَتِهِ فِي يَدِي خَاتَمًا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، فَبَانَ غَضَبُهُ لِكَيْ يَنْزِعَهُ مِنْ أُصْبُعِي، فَبَسَطْتُ أُصْبُعِي لَهُ «فَاسْتَلَّهُ فَخَذَفَ بِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yunus b. Yazid reported to me from Ibn Shihab who said Someone I do not suspect told me from ‘Abd Allah b. ‘Abbas that he said:
entries.matn_en: ‘Umar b. al-Khattab saw a gold ring on my hand during his caliphate. His anger was evident, intending to remove it from my finger. I extended my finger to him, 'so he pulled it off and threw it away.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 688
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِيهُ عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، وَابْنُ سَمْعَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: ‘Amr b. al-Harith and Ibn Sam‘an reported to me from Ibn Shihab similarly.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 689
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ سَوَادَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا النَّجِيبِ حَدَّثَهُ، أَنَّ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ حَدَّثَهُ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَدِمَ مِنْ نَجْرَانَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، وَعَلَيْهِ خَاتَمٌ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، وَقَالَ: «إِنَّكَ جِئْتَنِي وَفِي يَدِكَ جَمْرَةٌ مِنْ نَارٍ»
entries.isnad_en: ‘Amr b. al-Harith reported to me from Bakr b. Sawadah that Abu al-Najib told him that Abu Sa‘id al-Khudri told him that a man came
entries.matn_en: from Najran to the Messenger of God, ﷺ, wearing a gold ring. The Messenger of God, ﷺ, turned away from him and said 'You have come to me with a coal of fire in your hand.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 690
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ مَكْحُولَ الدِّمَشْقِيَّ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: دَخَلَ عَوْفُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ الْأَشْجَعِيَّ عَلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، وَعَلَيْهِ خَاتَمٌ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ فَضَرَبَ عُمَرُ يَدَهُ وَقَالَ: «ارْمِ بِهَذَا» . فَرَمَى بِهِ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: «مَا أَرَانَا إِلَّا قَدْ أَوْجَعْنَاكَ وَأَهْلَكْنَا خَاتَمَكَ» ، ثُمَّ جَاءَ الْغَدُ وَعَلَيْهِ خَاتَمٌ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ، فَقَالَ: «اسْتَبْدَلْتَ حِلْيَةَ أَهْلِ النَّارِ» ، قَالَ: فَرَمَى بِهِ، ثُمَّ جَاءَ الْغَدُ وَعَلَيْهِ خَاتَمٌ مِنْ وَرِقٍ فَسَكَتَ عَنْهُ
entries.isnad_en: Usamah b. Zayd reported to me that he heard Makhul al-Dimashqi say:
entries.matn_en: ‘Awf b. Malik al-Ashja‘i entered upon ‘Umar b. al-Khattab wearing a gold ring. ‘Umar struck his hand and said 'Throw this away.' He threw it away. ‘Umar said: 'I think we have hurt you and destroyed your ring.' The next day, he came wearing an iron ring. ‘Umar said: 'You have replaced the adornment of the people of the Fire.' He threw it away. The next day, he came wearing a silver ring, and ‘Umar remained silent.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 691
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو صَخْرٍ، أَنَّ يَزِيدَ بْنِ قُسَيْطٍ، حَدَّثَهُ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ قَعَدَ عِنْدَ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، وَهُوَ مُتَخَتِّمٌ بِخَاتَمٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، فَمَسَحَ لِحْيَتَهُ، فَلَمَّا رَآهُ عُمَرُ، قَالَ: «حِلْيَةٌ مِنْ نَارٍ؟» ، فَرَجَعَ الرَّجُلُ، فَتَخَتَّمَ بِخَاتَمٍ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ، فَلَمَّا رَآهُ عُمَرُ قَالَ: «حِلْيَةُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ؟» ، فَرَجَعَ الرَّجُلُ فَتَخَتَّمَ بِخَاتَمٍ مِنْ وَرِقٍ، فَلَمَّا رَآهُ عُمَرُ سَكَتَ
entries.isnad_en: Abu Sakhr reported to me that Yazid b. Qusayt told him that
entries.matn_en: a man from the Ansar sat with ‘Umar b. al-Khattab while he was wearing a gold ring. He stroked his beard, and when ‘Umar saw it, he said 'An adornment from the Fire?' The man returned and wore an iron ring. When ‘Umar saw it, he said: 'The adornment of the people of the Fire?' The man returned and wore a silver ring. When ‘Umar saw it, he remained silent.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 692
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَفْلَحُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ، قَالَ: "
entries.matn_ar: رَأَيْتُ خَاتَمَ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ مِنْ وَرِقٍ فِي يَسَارِهِ، وَكَانَ نَقْشُهُ: الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ أَفْلَحُ: وَكَذَلِكَ نَقْشُ فَصِّ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، وَهُمَا مِنْ وَرِقٍ جَمِيعًا "
entries.isnad_en: Aflah b. Humayd al-Ansari reported: '
entries.matn_en: I saw al-Qasim b. Muhammad’s ring made of silver on his left hand, and its inscription was: "Al-Qasim b. Muhammad." Aflah said Similarly, the inscription on the stone of ‘Abd al-Rahman b. al-Qasim’s ring was the same, and both were made of silver.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 693
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، وَأَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الطَّوِيلِ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، وَسُئِلَ هَلِ اتَّخَذَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَاتَمًا؟ فَقَالَ: نَعَمْ، أَخَّرَ الصَّلَاةَ الْعِشَاءَ إِلَى شَطْرِ اللَّيْلِ، ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْنَا حِينَ صَلَّى بِوَجْهِهِ، فَقَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ صَلُّوا وَنَامُوا، وَأَنْتُمْ لَمْ تَزَالُوا فِي صَلَاةٍ مُنْذُ انْتَظَرْتُمُوهَا، كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى وَبِيصِ خَاتَمِهِ فِي الظُّلْمَةِ لَيْلَتَئِذٍ، وَبَعْضُهُمْ يَزِيدُ عَلَى بَعْضٍ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, Anas b. 'Iyad, and Yahya b. Ayyub reported to me from Humayd al-Tawil, who said:
entries.matn_en: I heard Anas b. Malik being asked whether the Prophet, ﷺ, had a ring. He replied, ‘Yes. He delayed the 'Isha' prayer until the middle of the night. After praying, he turned to us and said, “The people have prayed and gone to sleep, while you have remained in prayer ever since you waited for it.”’ Anas added, ‘I can still see the gleam of his ring in the darkness that night.’ Some transmitters add more than others.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 694
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي غَيْرُهُمْ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: لَمَّا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَكْتُبَ إِلَى كِسْرَى، وَقَيْصَرَ وَالْمُلُوكِ، قِيلَ: إِنَّهُمْ لَا يَقْبَلُونَ الصُّحُفَ وَالْكُتُبَ إِلَّا بِخَوِاتِمَ، قَالَ: فَصَنَعَ خَاتَمًا مِنْ وَرِقٍ، قَالَ: وَنَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ، صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ خَاتَمِ الذَّهَبِ، وَأَمَرَ بِخَاتَمِ الْوَرِقِ، قَالَ أَنَسٌ: فَصَلَّى بِنَا الْعِشَاءَ، فَكُنْتُ فِي الثَّانِي أَوِ الثَّالِثِ ، فَالْتَفَتَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، فَقَالَ: «إِنِّي قَدِ اصْطَنَعْتُ خَاتَمًا ، وَرَفَعَ أُصْبُعَهُ فَلَا. . . تَصْطَنِعُوا عَلَيْهِ» ، قَالَ أَنَسٌ: يَعْنِي: وَلَا تَنْقُشُوا عَلَيْهِ، وَكَانَ نَقْشُهُ: مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
entries.isnad_en: Others reported to me from Anas b. Malik
entries.matn_en: that when the Prophet, ﷺ, wanted to write to Kisra, Qaysar, and the kings, he was told they would accept letters only if sealed. So he had a silver ring made. The Messenger of God forbade gold rings and instructed that silver rings be used. Anas said: He led us in the 'Isha' prayer, and I was in the second or third row. The Messenger of God turned to us and said, ‘I have had a ring made,’ and raised his finger, ‘so do not … make [an inscription] on it.’ Anas explained: ‘That is, do not engrave it.’ Its inscription was ‘Muhammad, the Messenger of God.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 695
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ خَاتَمُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام فِضَّةً، وَفَصُّهُ حَبَشِيٌّ»
entries.isnad_en: Yunus b. Yazid reported to me from Ibn Shihab, from Anas b. Malik, who said '
entries.matn_en: The ring of the Messenger of God, ﷺ, was made of silver, and its stone was Ethiopian.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 696
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ، حَدَّثَهُ، "
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ مُعَاذَ بْنَ جَبَلٍ لَمَّا قَدِمَ مِنَ الْيَمَنِ حِينَ بَعَثَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدِمَ وَفِي يَدِهِ خَاتَمٌ مِنْ وَرِقٍ نَقْشُهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم : «يَا مُعَاذُ ، مَا هَذَا الْخَاتَمُ؟» ، فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّي كُنْتُ أَكْتُبُ كُتُبًا إِلَى النَّاسِ فَأَفْرُقُ أَنْ يُزَادَ فِيهَا وَيُنقَصَ مِنْهَا، وَاتَّخَذْتُ خَاتَمًا أَخْتِمُ بِهِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَا نَقْشُهُ؟» ، فَقَالَ مُعَاذٌ: مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، فَقَالَ: «آمَنَ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ مِنْ مُعَاذٍ حَتَّى خَاتَمُهُ» ثُمَّ أَخَذَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، فَتَخَتَّمَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Usamah b. Zayd reported to me that Muhammad b. ‘Abd Allah b. ‘Amr b. ‘Uthman b. ‘Affan told him
entries.matn_en: that Mu‘adh b. Jabal, when he returned from Yemen after the Messenger of God, ﷺ, sent him, arrived with a silver ring engraved with "Muhammad, the Messenger of God." The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said to him: 'O Mu‘adh, what is this ring?' He said: 'O Messenger of God, I used to write letters to the people and feared that something might be added or removed, so I made a ring to seal with.' The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: 'What is its engraving?' Mu‘adh said: 'Muhammad, the Messenger of God, ﷺ.' He said: 'Everything about Mu‘adh is trustworthy, even his ring.' Then the Messenger of God, ﷺ, took it and wore it.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 697
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ صَدَقَةَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيِّبِ عَنْ لُبْسِ الْخَاتَمِ، فَقَالَ: «الْبِسْهُ، وَأَخْبِرِ النَّاسَ أَنِّي قَدْ أَفْتَيْتُكَ بِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik reported to me that Sadaqah b. Yasar said
entries.matn_en: I asked Sa‘id ibn al-Musayyib about wearing a ring, and he said: 'Wear it and inform the people that I have given you a fatwa about it.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 697
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَقَالَ لِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ فِي التَّخَتُّمِ بِالْحَدِيدِ وَالنُّحَاسِ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَمْ أَزَلْ أَسْمَعُ أَنَّ الْحَدِيدَ مَكْرُوهٌ ، فَأَمَّا غَيْرُهُ فَلَا»
entries.isnad_en: Malik b. Anas said to me about wearing rings of iron and copper: '
entries.matn_en: I have always heard that iron is disliked, but as for others, no.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 698
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ اللَّيْثِيُّ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ فِي سَيْفِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ الَّذِي شَهِدَ بِهِ بَدْرًا سَبِيكَةٌ أَوْ سَبِيكَتَانِ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Usamah b. Zayd al-Laythi reported to me from Nafi'
entries.matn_en: that ‘There was one or two ingots of gold set into the sword with which 'Umar b. al-Khattab had fought at Badr.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 698
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ نَعْلَ سَيْفِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَحَلْقَهُ، وَقَبَاعَهُ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Anas b. 'Iyad reported to me from Ja'far b. Muhammad, from his father,
entries.matn_en: that ‘the metal fitting at the end of the scabbard of the Messenger of God’s sword, its ring, and its pommel were made of silver.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 700
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ ابْنُ وَهْبٍ: أَخْبَرَنِي خَالِدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ بَقِيَّةَ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ، عَنْ طُعْمَةَ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: رَأَيْتُ مُوسَى بْنَ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ التَّيْمِيَّ وَقَدْ. . . بِالذَّهَبِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said Khalid b. Humayd reported to me from Baqiyyah b. al-Walid, from Tu‘mah, who said: '
entries.matn_en: I saw Musa b. Talhah b. ‘Ubayd God al-Taymi... with gold.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 700
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ بَقِيَّةُ: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا بَأْسَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ الرَّجُلُ سِنًّا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ إِذَا وَقَعَتْ سِنُّهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Baqiyyah said ‘Abd Allah b. ‘Uthman reported to me from Ibrahim b. Yazid who said: '
entries.matn_en: There is no harm in a man making a tooth of gold if his tooth falls out.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 701
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي رَبْطِ الْأَسْنَانِ بِالذَّهَبِ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ ، قَدْ رَبَطَ عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ مَرْوَانَ أَسْنَانَهُ بِالذَّهَبِ»
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. ‘Amr reported to me from Ibn Jurayj, from Ibn Shihab, who said about binding teeth with gold: '
entries.matn_en: There is no harm in it. ‘Abd al-Malik b. Marwan bound his teeth with gold.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 702
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي غَيْرُ وَاحِدٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا أُصِيبَ أَنْفُهُ يَوْمَ الْكُلَابِ فَاتَّخَذَ أَنْفًا مِنْ فِضَّةٍ، فَنَتِنَ عَلَيْهِ، «فَأَمَرَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ أَنْفًا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ»
entries.isnad_en: More than one person reported to me that
entries.matn_en: a man’s nose was injured on the Day of al-Kulab, so he made a silver nose, but it became foul-smelling. 'The Prophet, ﷺ, ordered him to make a gold nose.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 703
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: أُحِلَّ لُبْسُ الْحَرِيرِ وَالذَّهَبِ لِإِنَاثِ أُمَّتِي، وَحُرِّمَ عَلَى ذُكُورِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: I heard ‘Abd Allah b. ‘Umar narrate from Nafi‘, from Sa‘id ibn Abi Hind, from Abu Musa al-Ash‘ari, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: Wearing silk and gold is permitted for the women of my nation and forbidden for its men.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 704
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ زِيَادِ بْنِ أَنْعَمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ التَّنُوخِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام
entries.matn_ar: خَرَجَ وَفِي إِحْدَى يَدَيْهِ ثَوْبٌ مِنْ حَرِيرٍ، وَفِي الْأُخْرَى ذَهَبٌ، فَقَالَ: «إِنَّ هَذَيْنِ يَحْرُمَانِ عَلَى ذُكُورِ أُمَّتِي، حِلٌّ لِإِنَاثِهِمْ»
entries.isnad_en: ‘Abd al-Rahman b. Ziyad b. An‘am reported to me from ‘Abd al-Rahman b. Rafi‘ al-Tanukhi, from ‘Abd Allah b. ‘Amr b. al-‘As, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: came out with a silk garment in one hand and gold in the other and said 'These two are forbidden for the men of my nation and permitted for its women.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 705
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي مَخْرَمَةُ بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيِّبِ، يَقُولُ: «
entries.matn_ar: قَدِمَتْ صَفِيَّةُ بِنْتُ حُيَيٍّ وَفِي أُذُنَيْهَا أَخْرِصَةٌ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ فَوَهَبَتْ لِفَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ وَلِنِسَاءٍ مَعَهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Makhramah b. Bukayr reported to me from his father who said: I heard ‘Umar b. ‘Abd Allah say: I heard Sa‘id ibn al-Musayyib say: '
entries.matn_en: Safiyyah bint Huyayy arrived with gold earrings and gave them to Fatimah, the daughter of the Messenger of God, and to some women with her.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 706
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتَ حُيَيٍّ، قَدِمَتْ مِنْ حُنَيْنٍ بِخُرْصَانَ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، فَوَهَبَتْ مِنْهَا لِفَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ وَلِبَعْضِ أَزْوَاجِهِ
entries.isnad_en: It was reported from Malik b. Anas that
entries.matn_en: Safiyyah bint Huyayy arrived from Hunayn with gold earrings and gave some of them to Fatimah, the daughter of the Messenger of God, and to some of his wives.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 706
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَسُئِلَ مَالِكٌ، عَنْ مَنْ لَبَّسَ ابْنَهُ صَغِيرًا ثَوْبًا مِنْ حَرِيرٍ أَوْ حُلِيٍّ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ ،
entries.matn_ar: فَكَرِهَ ذَلِكَ "
entries.isnad_en: Malik was asked about someone who dressed his young son in a silk garment or gold jewelry,
entries.matn_en: and he disliked that.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 707
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، أَخْبَرَتْهُ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، قَالَ: «الَّذِي يَشْرَبُ فِي آنِيَةِ الْفِضَّةِ إِنَّمَا يُجَرْجِرُ فِي بَطْنِهِ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik b. Anas reported to me from Nafi‘, from Zayd b. ‘Abd Allah b. ‘Umar, from ‘Abd Allah b. ‘Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Bakr al-Siddiq, from Umm Salamah, the wife of the Prophet, ﷺ, who told him that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: Whoever drinks from silver vessels only gulps the fire of Hell into his belly.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 708
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ سَمْعَانَ، وَجَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، وَغَيْرُهُمَا، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ لَمْ يَكُنْ يَشْرَبُ فِي قَدَحٍ لَهُ حَلْقَةٌ مِنْ وَرِقٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Sam‘an, Jarir b. Hazim, and others reported to me from Nafi‘ that '
entries.matn_en: ‘Abd Allah b. ‘Umar did not drink from a cup that had a silver ring.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 709
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُ مَالِكًا، وَغَيْرَهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ «
entries.matn_ar: كَانُوا يَكْرَهُونَ أَنْ يُشْرَبَ فِي الْقَدَحِ الَّذِي فِيهِ الْحَلْقَةُ الْوَرِقُ، وَالْقَدَحِ الْمُضَبَّبِ بِالْوَرِقِ»
entries.isnad_en: I heard Malik and other scholars say: '
entries.matn_en: They disliked drinking from a cup that had a silver ring or was reinforced with silver.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 709
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ سَالِمَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، «
entries.matn_ar: أُتِيَ بِشَرَابٍ فِي قَدَحٍ مُفَضَّضٍ فَرَدَّهُ، فَأُتِيَ بِقَدَحٍ غَيْرَ مُفَضَّضٍ فَشَرِبَ»
entries.isnad_en: Jarir b. Hazim reported to me: I saw
entries.matn_en: Salim b. 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar was brought a drink in a silver-inlaid cup, but he refused it. Then a cup without silver inlay was brought to him, and he drank from it.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 710
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنِ ابْنَةِ أَبِي عَمْرٍو، مَوْلَى عَائِشَةَ: «
entries.matn_ar: أَبَتْ عَائِشَةُ حَتَّى مَاتَتْ أَنْ تُرَخِّصَ لَنَا فِي تَفْضِيضِ الْإِنَاءِ»
entries.isnad_en: Jarir reported to me from Muhammad b. Sirin, from the daughter of Abu 'Amr—a
entries.matn_en: freedman of 'A'ishah—who said: ‘'A'ishah continued to refuse to grant us permission to silver-plate vessels until she died.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 710
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، بِمَكَّةَ فَدَعَا بِشَرَابٍ ، فَأُتِيَ بِقَدَحٍ مُورَقٍ فِيهِ شَرَابٌ، فَضَرَبَهُ بِالْجِدَارِ فَكَسَرَهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «إِنَّ هَذَا يُنْهَى عَنِ الشَّرَابِ فِيهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahi‘ah reported to me from Muhammad b. ‘Abd al-Rahman who said
entries.matn_en: ‘Urwah b. al-Zubayr was in Mecca and called for a drink. He was brought a silver-plated cup with a drink, so he struck it against the wall and broke it, then said: 'This is forbidden for drinking.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 710
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْهَادِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، وَعُمَرَ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «
entries.matn_ar: نَهَى عَنْ آنِيَةِ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ أَنْ يُؤْكَلَ فِيهِمَا أَوْ يُشْرَبَ فِيهِمَا»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Layth reported to me from Ibn al-Had, from ‘Ali and ‘Umar b. ‘Ali, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, '
entries.matn_en: forbade using vessels of gold and silver for eating or drinking.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 711
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: نَهَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ نَأْكُلَ وَنَشْرَبَ فِي آنِيَةِ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ وَأَنْ نَلْبَسَ الْحَرِيرَ وَالدِّيبَاجَ، وَقَالَ: «هِيَ لَهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا، وَهِيَ لَنَا فِي الْآخِرَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Jarir b. Hazim reported to me from Sulayman b. Mihran, from ‘Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Layla, from Hudhayfah b. al-Yaman, who said The Messenger of God, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: forbade us from eating and drinking from vessels of gold and silver and from wearing silk and brocade. He said: 'These are for them in this world and for us in the Hereafter.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 713
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ سَمْعَانَ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «نَهَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: عَنْ آنِيَةِ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ، وَعَنْ تَخَتُّمِ الذَّهَبِ، وَعَنْ لُبْسِ الْقِسِّ وَالْحَرِيرِ، وَعَنِ الْإِسْتَبْرَقِ، وَالدِّيبَاجِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Sam‘an reported to me from Ash‘ath b. Abi al-Sha‘tha’, from Mu‘awiyah b. Suwayd, from al-Bara’ b. ‘Azib, who said 'The Messenger of God, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: forbade us from vessels of gold and silver, wearing gold rings, and wearing fine and thick silk, brocade, and heavy silk.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 713
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ سَمْعَانَ، عَنْ غَالِبِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ الْيَمَانِ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا تَشْرَبُوا فِي الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةَ، وَلَا تَأْكُلُوا فِيهَا، فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ فِي الدُّنْيَا لِأَهْلِ الشِّرْكِ، وَهِيَ لَكُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Sam'an reported to me from Ghalib b. 'Ubayd God, from Mujahid, from Hudhayfah b. al-Yaman, from the Messenger of God, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Do not drink from gold and silver vessels, nor eat from them. They are for the people of polytheism in this world, and for you in the Hereafter.”

sections.title_en: On Omens, Contagion, Owl Superstition, Safar, and Ghouls
sections.title_ar: فِي الطِّيَرَةِ وَالْعَدَوَى وَالْهَامِ وَالصَّفَرِ وَالْغُولِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 715
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ ابْنُ وَهْبٍ: أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، وَيُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، وَابْنُ سَمْعَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ السُّلَمِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قُلْتُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، أُمُورًا كُنَّا نَصْنَعُهَا فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ: كُنَّا نَأْتِي الْكُهَّانَ، قَالَ: «فَلَا تَأْتُوا الْكُهَّانَ» ، قَالَ: كُنَّا نَتَطَيَّرُ. قَالَ: «ذَلِكَ شَيْءٌ يَجِدُهُ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي نَفْسِهِ فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمْ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said Malik b. Anas, Ibn Abi Dhi’b, Yunus b. Yazid, and Ibn Sam‘an reported to me from Ibn Shihab, from Abi Salamah b. ‘Abd al-Rahman, from Mu‘awiyah b. al-Hakam al-Sulami,
entries.matn_en: who said: I said to the Messenger of God, ﷺ, about some things we used to do in the Jahiliyyah: We used to visit soothsayers. He said: 'Do not visit soothsayers.' I said: We used to take omens. He said: 'That is something one of you finds in himself, so do not let it prevent you.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 716
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ: بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا عَدْوَى، وَلَا طِيَرَةَ وَخَيْرُهَا الْفَأْلُ» ، قَالَ: وَمَا الْفَأْلُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟، قَالَ: «الْكَلِمَةُ الصَّالِحَةُ يَسْمَعُهَا أَحَدُكُمْ»
entries.isnad_en: Yunus b. Yazid reported to me from Ibn Shihab who said It reached me that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: '
entries.matn_en: There is no contagion, no omens, and the best of them is a good omen.' He was asked: 'What is a good omen, O Messenger of God?' He said: 'A good word that one of you hears.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 717
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا طَلْحَةُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ "
entries.matn_ar: لَا طِيَرَةَ وَلَكِنَّهُ فَأْلٌ ، وَالْفَأْلُ الْمُرْسَلُ: يَسَارٌ، وَسَالِمٌ وَنَحْوُهُ مِنَ الْأَسْمَاءِ يَعْرِضُ لَكَ عَلَى غَيْرِ مِيعَادٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Talhah b. 'Amr reported to us from 'Ata', from Ibn 'Abbas, that the Prophet, ﷺ, said:
entries.matn_en: ‘There are no omens; rather, there is a good omen. A good omen that comes unexpectedly is a name such as Yasar (“Prosperity”), Salim (“Safe”), or a similar name.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 717
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُلَيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا، قَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ
entries.matn_ar: مَا تَقُولُ فِي الطِّيَرَةِ؟، قَالَ: «لَا شَيْءَ» ، ثُمَّ قَالَ الثَّانِيَةَ، «لَا شَيْءَ، وَخَيْرُهَا الْفَأْلُ الصَّالِحُ»
entries.isnad_en: Musa b. ‘Ulayy reported to us from his father that a man said 'O Messenger of God,
entries.matn_en: what do you say about omens?' He said: 'Nothing.' Then he asked again, and he said: 'Nothing, and the best of them is a good omen.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 718
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ: بَلَغَنَا أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا عَدْوَى، وَلَا طِيَرَةَ، وَلَا هَامَةَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yunus reported to me from Ibn Shihab, who said:
entries.matn_en: It reached us that Abu Hurayrah said the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: ‘There is no contagion, no ill omen, and no hamah (the pre-Islamic omen bird).’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 718
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ: فَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ حِينَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا عَدْوَى، وَلَا صَفَرَ، وَلَا هَامَةَ» ، فَقَالَ الْأَعْرَابِيُّ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، فَمَا بَالُ الْإِبِلِ يَكُونُ فِي الرَّمْلِ كَأَنَّهَا الظَّبْيُ، فَيَجِيءُ الْبَعِيرُ الْأَجْرَبُ فَيَدْخُلُ فِيهَا فَيُجْرِبُهَا، قَالَ: «فَمَنْ أَعْدَى الْأَوَّلَ؟»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Shihab said Abu Salamah b. ‘Abd al-Rahman told me that Abu Hurayrah said: The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: '
entries.matn_en: There is no contagion, no Safar, and no haunting.' A Bedouin said: 'O Messenger of God, what about camels that are in the sand like gazelles, then a mangy camel comes and mixes with them and makes them mangy?' He said: 'Who made the first one mangy?'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 719
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا عَدْوَى» . وَيُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ: «لَا يُورِدُ مُمْرِضٌ عَلَى مُصِحٍّ» ، قَالَ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ: كَانَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ يُحَدِّثُهُمَا كِلَيْهِمَا عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، ثُمَّ صَمَتَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ عَنْ قَوْلِهِ: وَلَا عَدْوَى، وَأَقَامَ عَلَى أَنْ لَا يُورِدَ مُمْرِضٌ عَلَى مُصِحٍّ، قَالَ: فَقَالَ الْحَارِثُ بْنُ أَبِي ذُبَابٍ، وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَمِّ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: قَدْ كُنْتُ أَسْمَعُكَ يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ تُحَدِّثُنَا مَعَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ حَدِيثًا آخَرَ، قَالَ: قَدْ كُنْتُ سَكَتُّ عَنْهُ، كُنْتَ تَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: «لَا عَدْوَى» ، فَأَبَى أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ أَنْ يُعْرَفَ ذَلِكَ، وَقَالَ: لَا يُورِدُ مُمْرِضٌ عَلَى مُصِحٍّ، فَمَا رَآهُ الْحَارِثُ فِي ذَلِكَ حَتَّى غَضِبَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، فَرَطَنَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ بِالْحَبَشِيَّةِ، فَقَالَ لِلْحَارِثِ: أَتَدْرِي مَاذَا أَنِّي قُلْتُ؟، قَالَ: لَا ، قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ: أَبَيْتُ، قَالَ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ: فَلَعَمْرِي لَقَدْ كَانَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ يُحَدِّثُنَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، قَالَ: «لَا عَدْوَى» وَلَا أَدْرِي أَنَسِيَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ أَمْ نَسَخَ أَحَدُ الْقَوْلَيْنِ الْآخَرَ
entries.isnad_en: Yunus b. Yazid reported to me from Ibn Shihab that Abu Salamah b. ‘Abd al-Rahman told him that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said 'There is no contagion.' He also narrated that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: 'Do not bring the sick near the healthy.' Abu Salamah said: Abu Hurayrah used to narrate both from the Messenger of God, ﷺ.
entries.matn_en: Then Abu Hurayrah later stopped saying 'there is no contagion' and insisted that a keeper of diseased camels should not bring them among healthy camels. Al-Harith b. Abi Dhubab, who was the cousin of Abu Hurayrah, said: I used to hear you, O Abu Hurayrah, narrating along with this hadith another hadith. He said: I had stopped it. You used to say: The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: 'There is no contagion.' Abu Hurayrah refused to acknowledge that and said: 'Do not bring the sick near the healthy.' Al-Harith did not see anything wrong with that until Abu Hurayrah became angry. Abu Hurayrah then spoke in Abyssinian and said to al-Harith: 'Do you know what I said?' He said: 'No.' Abu Hurayrah said: 'I refuse.' Abu Salamah said: By my life, Abu Hurayrah used to narrate to us that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: 'There is no contagion.' I do not know whether Abu Hurayrah forgot or one of the two sayings abrogated the other.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 721
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكٌ، قَالَ: بَلَغَنِي عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْسَجَةَ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا عَدْوَى، وَلَا هَامَ، وَلَا صَفَرَ ، وَلَا يَحِلُّ الْمُمْرِضُ عَلَى الْمُصِحِّ وَلْيَحِلَّ الْمُصِحُّ حَيْثُ شَاءَ» فَقِيلَ لِلنَّبِيِّ ، صلى الله عليه وسلم: مَا ذَلِكَ؟ قَالَ: «إِنَّهُ أَذًى»
entries.isnad_en: Malik reported to me: It reached me from Ibn ‘Awsajah al-Hamdani that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: There is no contagion, no haunting, no Safar. The sick should not be brought near the healthy, but the healthy may go wherever they wish.' It was said to the Prophet, ﷺ: 'What is that?' He said: 'It is harmful.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 722
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، يَقُولُ: «
entries.matn_ar: كُلُّ عَبْدٍ طَائِرُهُ فِي عُنُقِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahi‘ah reported to me from Abi al-Zubayr, from Jabir b. ‘Abd Allah, who said: I heard the Messenger of God, ﷺ, say: '
entries.matn_en: Every person’s omen is on his neck.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 722
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ جَابِرٌ: وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا عَدْوَى؟ فَمَنْ أَعْدَى الْأَوَّلَ؟» ، قَالَ جَابِرٌ: قَدْ كُنَّا نَكْرَهُ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ الْمَرِيضُ عَلَى الصَّحِيحِ وَلَيْسَ بِهِ إِلَّا قَوْلُ النَّاسِ
entries.matn_en: Jabir said: The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: ‘There is no contagion. Who infected the first one?’ Jabir said: ‘We used to dislike a sick person entering upon a healthy person, but that was only something people said.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 723
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا صَفَرَ» ، قَالُوا: مَا هُوَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: «دَوَابٌّ تَكُونُ فِي الْبَطْنِ» ، قَالَ: «ولَا هَامَةَ» ، قَالُوا: فمَا هِيَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟، قَالَ: «طَيْرٌ مِنَ الطَّيْرِ» ، قَالَ: «وَلَا غُولَ» ، قَالُوا: وَمَا هِيَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟، قَالَ: «هِيَ السِّعْلَاةُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yazid b. ‘Iyad reported to me from Zayd b. Aslam that it reached him that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: There is no Safar.' They asked: 'What is it, O Messenger of God?' He said: 'Creatures that are in the belly.' He said: 'And no haunting.' They asked: 'What is it, O Messenger of God?' He said: 'A bird from the birds.' He said: 'And no ghoul.' They asked: 'What is it, O Messenger of God?' He said: 'It is the Si‘lah.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 723
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ابْنَ كَعْبٍ الْقُرَظِيَّ، يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا طِيَرَةَ، وَلَا عَدْوَى، وَلَا هَامَةَ، وَلَا غُولَ» ، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ بَعِيرٌ أَجْرَبُ وَرَدَ عَلَى إِبِلٍ صِحَاحٍ فَجَرِبَتْ مِنْ آخِرِهَا، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَنْ أَجْرَبَ الْأَوَّلَ؟» ، قَالَ الرَّجُلُ: اللَّهُ أَجْرَبَهُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام: «وَاللَّهُ أَجْرَبَ هَذِهِ عَاهَةٌ وَقَدَرٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Layth b. Sa'd reported to me from 'Umar b. 'Abd Allah, who heard Ibn Ka'b al-Qurazi say: The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said:
entries.matn_en: ‘There are no omens, no contagion, no hamah (omen bird), and no ghouls.’ A man said, ‘O Messenger of God, a mangy camel came among healthy camels and they all became mangy.’ The Messenger of God asked, ‘Who made the first one mangy?’ The man replied, ‘God made it mangy.’ The Messenger of God said, ‘God made this one mangy; this is an affliction and a decree.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 725
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، سُئِلَ عَنِ الْغِيلَانِ، فَقَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: هُمْ سَحَرَةُ الْجِنِّ»
entries.isnad_en: Jarir b. Hazim reported to me that ‘Abd Allah b. ‘Ubayd b. ‘Umayr told him that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, was asked about ghouls, and he said '
entries.matn_en: They are the sorcerers of the jinn.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 725
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ، عَنْ عُمَيْرٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا عَدْوَى، وَلَا هَامَ، وَلَا غُولَ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Abi Dhi'b reported to me from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Mihran, from 'Umayr,
entries.matn_en: the client of Ibn 'Abbas, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: ‘There is no contagion, no hamah (omen bird), and no ghoul.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 726
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي رِجَالٌ أَهْلُ رِضًى وَقَنَاعَةٍ مِنْ أَبْنَاءِ الصَّحَابَةِ، وَأَوْلِيَةِ النَّاسِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا عَدْوَى، وَلَا هَامَةَ، وَصَفَرَ ، وَاتَّقُوا الْمَجْذُومَ كَمَا يُتَّقَى الْأَسَدُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi al-Zinad reported to me from his father, who said: Men known for integrity and contentment, among the sons of the Companions and the foremost people, told me that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said:
entries.matn_en: ‘There is no contagion, no hamah, and no Safar. Keep away from a person afflicted with leprosy as one keeps away from a lion.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 727
entries.isnad_ar: قال وأخبرني محمد بن عبد الله بن عمرو بن عثمان، عن أمه فاطمة ابنة حسين، عن عبد الله بن عباس، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه ، قال: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا تُدِيمُوا إِلَيْهِمُ النَّظَرَ» . يَعْنِي: الْمَجْذُومِينَ
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. ‘Abd Allah b. ‘Amr b. ‘Uthman reported to me from his mother Fatimah bint Husayn, from ‘Abd Allah b. ‘Abbas, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: Do not stare at them,' meaning the lepers.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 728
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي خَارِجَةُ بْنُ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا كَانَ بِهِ هَذَا الْوَجَعُ: الْجُذَامُ، وَكَانَ يَدْخُلُ عَلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، قَالَ: فَإِذَا أُتِيَ بِالطَّعَامِ إِلَى عُمَرَ وَعِنْدَهُ ذَلِكَ الرَّجُلُ، قَالَ: «يَا فُلَانُ كُلْ مِمَّا يَلِيكَ، فَايْمُ اللَّهِ لَوْ كَانَ غَيْرُكَ بِهِ مَا بِكَ أَوْ بِهِ الَّذِي بِكَ مَا قَعَدَ مِنِّي عَلَى أَدْنَى مِنْ قَيْسِ رُمْحٍ» قَالَ حَرْمَلَةُ: هُوَ مُعَيْقِبٌ خَازِنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ عَلَى بَيْتِ الْمَالِ
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. 'Abd Allah reported to me from his father, who said: Kharijah b. Zayd b. Thabit told me
entries.matn_en: that a man afflicted with leprosy used to visit 'Umar b. al-Khattab. When food was brought while the man was with him, 'Umar would say, ‘So-and-so, eat from what is in front of you. By God, if someone else were afflicted with what you have—or had the illness you have—he would not sit within a spear’s length of me.’ Harmalah said: He was Mu'ayqib, 'Umar b. al-Khattab’s treasurer in charge of the public funds.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 729
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُ مَالِكَ بْنَ أَنَسٍ، يَقُولُ: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، أَخْبَرَهُ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: بَيْنَمَا عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ يَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ نَظَرَ إِلَى امْرَأَةٍ مَجْذُومَةٍ، فَقَالَ لَهَا عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ: «لَا تُؤْذِي النَّاسَ» فَجَلَسَتْ فِي بَيْتِهَا، فَلَمَّا تُوُفِّيَ عُمَرُ جَاءَهَا النَّاسُ، فَقَالُوا لَهَا: إِنَّ الَّذِي نَهَاكِ عَنِ الْخُرُوجِ قَدْ مَاتَ فَاخْرُجِي، قَالَتْ: وَاللَّهِ لَا أُطِيعُهُ حَيًّا وَأَعْصِيهِ مَيِّتًا
entries.matn_en: I heard Malik b. Anas say: 'Abd Allah b. Abi Bakr told me that Ibn Abi Mulaykah informed him: While 'Umar b. al-Khattab was circumambulating the Ka'bah, he saw a woman afflicted with leprosy and said to her, ‘Do not harm the people.’ She remained at home. After 'Umar died, people came to her and said, ‘The one who forbade you to go out has died, so go out.’ She replied, ‘By God, I would not obey him while he was alive only to disobey him after his death!’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 730
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي مَعْرُوفُ بْنُ سُوَيْدٍ الْجُذَامِيُّ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ رَبَاحٍ اللَّخْمِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لَا عَدْوَى، وَلَا طِيَرَةَ ، وَالْعَيْنُ حَقٌّ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma‘ruf b. Suwayd al-Judhami reported to me from ‘Ali b. Rabah al-Lakhmi who said: I heard Abu Hurayrah say that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: There is no contagion, no omens, and the evil eye is real.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 730
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ عُلَيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا عَدْوَى، وَلَا طِيَرَةَ، وَلَا هَامَ، وَلَا جِدَّ، وَالْعَيْنُ حَقٌّ»
entries.isnad_en: Musa b. 'Ulayy reported to me from his father that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said:
entries.matn_en: ‘There is no contagion, no ill omen, no hamah (omen bird), no jadd [unclear term in the supplied Arabic], and the evil eye is real.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 731
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي وَاقِدُ بْنُ سَلَامَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ الرَّقَاشِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا عَدْوَى، وَلَا هَامَ، وَأَصْدَقُ الطَّيْرِ الْفَأْلُ ، وَالْعَيْنُ حَقٌّ»
entries.isnad_en: Waqid b. Salamah reported to me from Yazid al-Raqashi, from Anas b. Malik, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: There is no contagion, no haunting, and the most truthful omen is a good omen. The evil eye is real.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 731
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، وَيُوسُفُ بْنُ طَهْمَانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَاهُ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: اغْتَسَلَ أَبِي سَهْلُ بْنُ حُنَيْفٍ بِالْخَرَّارِ فَنَزَعَ جُبَّةً كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِ ، وَعَامِرُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ يَنْظُرُ ، وَكَانَ سَهْلٌ رَجُلًا أَبْيَضَ حَسَنَ الْجِلْدِ ، فَقَالَ لَهُ عَامِرُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ: مَا رَأَيْتُ كَالْيَوْمِ قَطُّ، وَلَا جِلْدَ عَذْرَاءَ، فَوُعِكَ سَهْلٌ مَكَانَهُ وَاشْتَدَّ وَجَعُهُ، فَأُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، فَأُخْبِرَ أَنَّ سَهْلًا وَجِعَ ، وَأَنَّهُ غَيْرُ رَائِحٍ مَعَكَ، فَأَتَاهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، فَأَخْبَرَهُ بِالَّذِي كَانَ مِنْ شَأْنِ عَامِرٍ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام: «عَلَامَ يَقْتُلُ أَحَدُكُمْ أَخَاهُ أَلَا بَرَّكْتَ، إِنَّ الْعَيْنَ حَقٌّ، تَوَضَّأْ لَهُ» ، فَتَوَضَّأَ فَرَاحَ سَهْلُ بْنُ حُنَيْفٍ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ، صلى الله عليه وسلم ، لَيْسَ بِهِ بَأْسٌ وَأَحَدُهُمَا يَزِيدُ عَلَى صَاحِبِهِ، وَقَالَ يُوسُفُ بْنُ طَهْمَانَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ: إِنَّ سَهْلًا قَامَ يَغْتَسِلُ يَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ حِينَ هَزَمَ اللَّهُ الْعَدُوَّ، وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ: سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ كَيْفَ غَسَلَ عَامِرٌ لِسَهْلٍ حِينَ أَصَابَهُ بِالْعَيْنِ؟، فَقَالَ: غَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ وَيَدَيْهِ وَمِرْفَقَيْهِ وَرُكْبَتَيْهِ وَأَطْرَافَ رِجْلَيْهِ وَدَاخِلَةَ إِزَارِهِ ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ صَبَّ عَلَى سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ فَرَاحَ لَيْسَ بِهِ بَأْسٌ
entries.isnad_en: Malik b. Anas and Yusuf b. Tahman reported to me from Muhammad b. Abi Umamah b. Sahl b. Hunayf that he heard his father say:
entries.matn_en: My father, Sahl b. Hunayf, bathed at al-Kharrar and removed a cloak he was wearing while ‘Amir b. Rabi‘ah was watching. Sahl was a fair-skinned man with beautiful skin. ‘Amir b. Rabi‘ah said to him: 'I have never seen the like of what I see today, not even the skin of a virgin.' Sahl fell ill on the spot, and his pain intensified. The Messenger of God, ﷺ, was informed that Sahl was ill and could not go with him. The Messenger of God, ﷺ, came to him and was told what had happened with ‘Amir. The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: 'Why would one of you kill his brother? Why did you not say: May God bless you? The evil eye is real. Perform ablution for him.' ‘Amir performed ablution for him, and Sahl b. Hunayf went with the Messenger of God, ﷺ, in the evening, feeling no harm. One narrator adds more than the other. Yusuf b. Tahman said in the hadith: Sahl was bathing on the day of Hunayn when God defeated the enemy. Malik said: I asked Ibn Shihab how ‘Amir washed for Sahl when he was afflicted by the evil eye. He said: He washed his face, hands, elbows, knees, the tips of his feet, and the inside of his lower garment. Then he poured the water over Sahl b. Hunayf, and he went feeling no harm.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 733
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، وَمَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، وَابْنُ سَمْعَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَامِرَ بْنَ رَبِيعَةَ مَرَّ عَلَى سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ وَهُوَ يَغْتَسِلُ فِي الْخَرَّارِ، فَقَالَ: وَاللَّهِ مَا رَأَيْتُ كَالْيَوْمِ وَلَا جِلْدَ مُخَبَّأَةٍ، فَلُبِطَ سَهْلٌ، فَأُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، فَقِيلَ لَهُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَلْ لَكَ فِي سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ؟، وَاللَّهِ مَا يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «هَلْ تَتَّهِمُونَ لَهُ أَحَدًا؟» ، قَالُوا: نَعَمْ، مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ عَامِرُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ وَهُوَ يَغْتَسِلُ، فَقَالَ: " وَاللَّهِ مَا رَأَيْتُ كَالْيَوْمِ قَطُّ وَلَا جِلْدَ مُخَبَّأَةٍ، قَالَ: فَدَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، عَامِرًا فَتَغَيَّظَ عَلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ: «عَلَامَ يَقْتُلُ أَحَدُكُمْ أَخَاهُ، أَلَا بَرَّكْتَ ، اغْتَسِلْ لَهُ» ، فَغَسَلَ لَهُ عَامِرُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ وَجْهَهُ وَيَدَيْهِ وَمِرْفَقَيْهِ وَرُكْبَتَيْهِ وَأَطْرَافَ رِجْلَيْهِ وَدَاخِلَةَ إِزَارِهِ فِي قَدَحٍ، ثُمَّ صَبَّ عَلَيْهِ، فَرَاحَ سَهْلٌ عَشِيَّةً مَعَ النَّاسِ لَيْسَ بِهِ بَأْسٌ
entries.isnad_en: Yunus b. Yazid, Malik b. Anas, and Ibn Sam'an reported to me from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Umamah b. Sahl b. Hunayf, who told him
entries.matn_en: that 'Amir b. Rabi'ah passed by Sahl b. Hunayf while he was bathing at al-Kharrar and said, ‘By God, I have never seen anything like today—not even the skin of a secluded woman.’ Sahl collapsed. The Messenger of God was called, and they said to him, ‘O Messenger of God, will you attend to Sahl b. Hunayf? By God, he cannot raise his head.’ The Messenger of God asked, ‘Do you suspect anyone?’ They said, ‘Yes. 'Amir b. Rabi'ah passed by him while he was bathing and said, “By God, I have never seen anything like today—not even the skin of a secluded woman.”’ The Messenger of God summoned 'Amir and reproached him, saying, ‘Why would one of you kill his brother? Why did you not invoke a blessing? Wash for him.’ 'Amir b. Rabi'ah washed his face, hands, elbows, knees, the tips of his feet, and the inside of his lower garment in a vessel, then poured the water over him. That evening Sahl went out with the people, unharmed.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 734
