entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ ثَوْبَانَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، قَالَ فِي الْعَيْنِ: «
entries.matn_ar: تَغْلِي مِنْهَا الْقُدُورُ، وَتُمْلَأُ مِنْهَا الْقُبُورُ»
entries.isnad_en: Sa‘id ibn Abi Ayyub reported to me from al-Hasan b. Thawban that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said about the evil eye: '
entries.matn_en: Because of it, pots boil over and graves are filled.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 735
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ حَمْزَةَ، وَسَالِمِ ابْنَيْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ: "
entries.matn_ar: لَا عَدْوَى، وَلَا طِيَرَةَ، إِنَّمَا الشُّؤْمُ فِي ثَلَاثَةٍ: الْمَرْأَةُ وَالْفَرَسُ وَالدَّارُ، وَأَحَدُهُمَا يَزِيدُ عَلَى صَاحِبِهِ "
entries.isnad_en: Yunus b. Yazid reported to me from Ibn Shihab, from Hamzah and Salim, the sons of ‘Abd Allah b. ‘Umar, from ‘Abd Allah b. ‘Umar, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: There is no contagion, no omens. Misfortune is only in three things: women, horses, and houses.' One narrator adds more than the other.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 737
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُ مَالِكَ بْنَ أَنَسٍ، يَقُولُ: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: الْعَدْوَى، وَالطِّيَرَةُ إِنْ كَانَ شَيْءٌ فَفِي الْفَرَسِ وَالْمَسْكَنِ وَالْمَرْأَةِ»
entries.matn_en: I heard Malik b. Anas say: Abu Hazim reported to me from Sahl b. Sa'd al-Sa'idi that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: ‘Contagion and omens—if there were anything of that kind, it would be in a horse, a dwelling, or a woman.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 737
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، سَمِعَ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ، يُحَدِّثُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي بَعْضُ أَهْلِ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ ، صلى الله عليه وسلم ، أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَزِيدُ: «
entries.matn_ar: الشُّؤْمُ السَّيْفُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yazid b. ‘Iyad reported to me that he heard Ibn Shihab narrate that some of the household of Umm Salamah, the wife of the Prophet, ﷺ, used to add: '
entries.matn_en: Misfortune is the sword.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 738
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ، صلى الله عليه وسلم ، فَقَالَتْ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ دَارٌ سَكَنَّاهَا وَالْعَدَدُ كَثِيرٌ وَالْمَالُ وَافِرٌ، فَقَلَّ الْعَدَدُ وَذَهَبَ الْمَالُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: «دَعُوهَا ذَمِيمَةً»
entries.isnad_en: Malik b. Anas reported to me from Yahya b. Sa'id, who said:
entries.matn_en: A woman came to the Messenger of God, ﷺ, and said, ‘O Messenger of God, we lived in a house with many people and abundant wealth, but our numbers dwindled and our wealth disappeared.’ The Messenger of God said, ‘Leave it as an ill-omened house.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 738
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ سَمْعَانَ،. . . . . . رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ، عليه السلام هَذَا
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Sam'an reported to me … [through omitted transmitter(s)] … from the Messenger of God, this report.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 739
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو. . . . نَوْفَلِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَدَّادِ بْنِ الْهَادِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ امْرَأَةً مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ أَتَتْ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ، صلى الله عليه وسلم ، فَقَالَتْ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، اشْتَرَيْنَا دَارًا فَتَرَحَّلْنَاهَا وَعَدَدُنَا كَثِيرٌ فَقَلَلْنَا، وَأَمْوَالُنَا كَثِيرَةٌ فَأَعْدَمْنَا، وَذَاتُ بَيْنِنَا حَسَنٌ فَتَقَاطَعْنَا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام: «أَفَلَا تَرَكْتُمُوهَا ذَمِيمَةً» ، فَقَالَتْ: فَكَيْفَ نَصْنَعُ بِهَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟، قَالَ: «بِيعُوهَا أَوْ تَهِبُوهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Abu [name omitted] Nawfal reported to me from 'Abd Allah b. Shaddad b. al-Had, that
entries.matn_en: a woman from the Ansar came to the Messenger of God and said, “Messenger of God, we bought a house and moved into it. We were many, but our number dwindled; we had much wealth, but became impoverished; and we were on good terms, but then became estranged.” The Messenger of God said, “Why did you not leave it as an ill-omened place?” She asked, “What should we do with it, Messenger of God?” He replied, “Sell it or give it away.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 739
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ حَبِيبٍ مَوْلَى عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، «
entries.matn_ar: شَكَوْا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ، عليه السلام عَامَ خَيْبَرَ وَمَا أَصَابَهُمْ لَوِ انْتَقَلْتُمْ مِنْهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahi'ah reported to me from Muhammad b. 'Abd al-Rahman, from Habib, the freedman of 'Urwah b. al-Zubayr, from 'Urwah b. al-Zubayr, who said '
entries.matn_en: The people complained to the Messenger of God, ﷺ, during the year of Khaybar about what had befallen them, saying: If only we could move away from here.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 740
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ سَمْعَانَ، أَنَّ رَبِيعَةَ بْنَ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ خَيْبَرَ
entries.matn_ar: نَزَلَ قَرِيبًا مِنْ مِرْطَةَ، فَكَانَ طَرِيقُهُ إِلَى حِصْنِ بَنِي الْقَرَانِ فِي جَوْفِ مِرْطَةَ، فَقِيلَ لَهُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهَا وَبِيَّةٌ، «فَأَخَذَ طَرِيقًا غَيْرَهَا ، هِيَ أَبْعَدُ مِنْهَا، فَكَانَ مَسْلَكُهَا ذَلِكَ الْأَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً حَتَّى فَتْحَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ ، وَلَمْ يَسْلُكْ بَطْنَ مِرْطَةَ كَرَاهِيَةً لِمَا ذُكِرَ عَنْهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Sam'an reported to me that Rabi'ah b. Abi 'Abd al-Rahman informed him that he had heard that during the year of Khaybar, the Messenger of God, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: camped near Mirtah. His path to the fortress of Bani al-Qaran was through the interior of Mirtah. It was said to him: 'O Messenger of God, it is a plague-ridden place.' So he took another path, which was longer, and that was his route for forty nights until God granted him victory. He did not traverse the interior of Mirtah out of aversion to what was said about it.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 741
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُ مَالِكًا، يَقُولُ: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ لِلْقَحَّةِ طَلْحَةَ: «مَنْ يَحْلُبُ هَذِهِ» ، فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ، فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَا اسْمُكَ؟» قَالَ: مُرَّةُ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ، عليه السلام: «اجْلِسْ» ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «مَنْ يَحْلُبُ هَذِهِ؟» ، فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ، فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَا اسْمُكَ؟» قَالَ: حَرْبٌ، فَقَالَ له النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «اجْلِسْ» ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «مَنْ يَحْلُبُ هَذِهِ؟» ، فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ، فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ عليه السلام: «مَا اسْمُكَ؟» قَالَ: يَعِيشُ، فَقَالَ: «احْلُبْ» فَحَلَبَ "
entries.matn_en: I heard Malik say: Yahya b. Sa'id reported to me that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said about Talhah’s milch-camel, ‘Who will milk this?’ A man stood up, and the Prophet asked him, ‘What is your name?’ He replied, ‘Murrah (Bitterness).’ The Prophet said, ‘Sit down.’ He then asked, ‘Who will milk this?’ Another man stood up. The Prophet asked his name, and he replied, ‘Harb (War).’ The Prophet said, ‘Sit down.’ He asked once more, ‘Who will milk this?’ A third man stood up. The Prophet asked his name, and he replied, ‘Ya'ish (He will live).’ The Prophet said, ‘Milk it.’ So he milked it.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 741
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ هُبَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ عُلَيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ، صلى الله عليه وسلم ، مِثْلَهُ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahi'ah reported to me from 'Abd Allah b. Hubayrah, who reported from Musa b. 'Ulayy, from his father, from the Messenger of God, ﷺ, similarly. Ibn Lahi'ah reported from al-Harith b. Yazid, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Jubayr, from the Messenger of God, ﷺ, similarly.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 742
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ سَمْعَانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ التَّيْمِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: مَنْ يَحْلُبُ لَنَا؟» ، فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي سُلَيْمٍ، فَقَالَ: أَنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فَقَالَ: «مَنِ هَذَا الْمُتَكَلِّمُ؟» فَقَالَ: أَنَا الْمُسَاوِرُ، قَالَ: «اجْلِسْ» ، ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، «مَنْ يَحْلُبُ لَنَا؟» ، فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ آخَرُ مِنْ بَنِي سُلَيْمٍ، فَقَالَ: أَنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فَقَالَ: «مَنْ الْمُتَكَلِّمُ؟» فَقَالَ: أَنَا خِدَاشٌ، فَضَحِكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، وَقَالَ: «اجْلِسْ» ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَتَكَلَّمُ أَمْ أَصْمُتْ؟، فَقَالَ: «بَلِ اصْمُتْ، وَأُخْبِرُكَ بِمَا أَرَدْتَ» ، فَقَالَ: فأَخْبِرْنِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ. قَالَ: «ظَنَنْتَ يَا عُمَرُ أَنَّهَا طِيَرَةٌ» ، قَالَ: «لَا طِيَرَ إِلَّا طِيَرُهُ، وَلَا خَيْرَ إِلَّا خَيْرُهُ، وَلَكِنِّي أُحِبُّ الْفَأْلَ الْحَسَنَ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Sam'an reported to me from Muhammad b. Ibrahim b. al-Harith al-Taymi that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: Who will milk for us?' A man from Bani Sulaym stood up and said: 'I will, O Messenger of God.' The Prophet asked: 'Who is this speaker?' He replied: 'I am al-Musawir.' The Prophet said: 'Sit down.' Then the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: 'Who will milk for us?' Another man from Bani Sulaym stood up and said: 'I will, O Messenger of God.' The Prophet asked: 'Who is the speaker?' He replied: 'I am Khidash.' The Messenger of God, ﷺ, laughed and said: 'Sit down.' Then 'Umar b. al-Khattab said: 'O Messenger of God, should I speak or remain silent?' The Prophet said: 'Rather, remain silent, and I will inform you of what you intended.' He said: 'Then inform me, O Messenger of God.' The Prophet said: 'You thought, O 'Umar, that it was an evil omen.' He said: 'There is no omen except God’s omen, and no good except His good, but I prefer a good omen.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 743
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ عَيَّاشِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْحُصَيْنِ ، عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ، صَاحِبِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: مَنْ رَدَّتْهُ الطِّيَرَةُ فَقَدْ قَارَفَ الشِّرْكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahi'ah reported to me from 'Ayyash b. 'Abbas, from Abi al-Husayn, from Fadalah b. 'Ubayd al-Ansari, a companion of the Prophet, ﷺ, who said '
entries.matn_en: Whoever is deterred by an evil omen has committed an act of polytheism.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 744
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِيهِ اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ عَيَّاشِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيِّ، عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، مِثْلَهُ .
entries.isnad_en: Al-Layth b. Sa'd reported to me from 'Ayyash b. 'Abbas, from Abi 'Abd al-Rahman al-Hubuli, from Fadalah b. 'Ubayd, similarly.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 745
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ هُبَيْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْمَعَافِرِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، بِنَحْوِ ذَلِكَ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahi'ah reported to me from 'Ubayd God b. Hubayrah, from Abi 'Abd al-Rahman al-Ma'afiri, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr b. al-'As, similarly.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 745
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، أَنَّ الْجُلَاحَ، حَدَّثَهُ، أَنَّ أَوْسًا حَدَّثَهُ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ،
entries.matn_ar: الْتَقَى هُوَ وَكَعْبٌ، بِالْكِتَابَيْنِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ: يَا كَعْبُ ، عِلْمُ النُّجُومِ؟ قَالَ لَهُ كَعْبٌ: لَا خَيْرَ فِيهِ، قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: لِمَ؟ قَالَ: تَرَى فِيهِ مَا تَكْرَهُ ، يُرِيدُ الطِّيَرَةَ، قَالَ كَعْبٌ: وَإِنْ مَضَى، وَقَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُ لَا طَيْرَ إِلَّا طَيْرُكَ، وَلَا خَيْرَ إِلَّا خَيْرُكَ، وَلَا رَبَّ غَيْرُكَ» ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ سَكَتَ، فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِكَ، قَالَ كَعْبٌ: جَاءَ بِهَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ، وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ إِنَّهَا لِرَأْسُ التَّوَكُّلِ وَكَنْزُ الْعَبْدِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ، وَلَا يَقُولُهَا عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ يَمْضِي إِلَّا لَمْ يَضُرَّهُ شَيْءٌ، قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: أَفَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ لَمْ يَمْضِ فَقَعَدَ؟ قَالَ: طَعِمَ الْإِشْرَاكَ
entries.isnad_en: 'Amr b. al-Harith reported to me that al-Julah informed him that Aws informed him that 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr b. al-'As
entries.matn_en: met Ka'b with two books. He said to him: 'O Ka'b, what about the knowledge of the stars?' Ka'b replied: 'There is no good in it.' 'Abd Allah asked: 'Why?' Ka'b said: 'You see in it what you dislike,' meaning omens. Ka'b said: 'Even if it passes?' And he said: 'O God, there is no omen except Your omen, no good except Your good, and no lord besides You.' Then he fell silent. 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr said: 'There is no power nor strength except with You.' Ka'b said: ''Abd Allah has spoken the truth. By the One in Whose hand is my soul, it is the essence of reliance and the treasure of the servant in Paradise. Whoever says it at that time and then proceeds, nothing will harm him.' 'Abd Allah said: 'What if he does not proceed but stays?' Ka'b replied: 'He has tasted polytheism.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 746
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ نَافِعَ بْنَ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلَ كَعْبُ الْأَحْبَارِ، عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرٍو، فَقَالَ: هَلْ تَطَيَّرُ؟، فَقَالَ: «نَعَمْ» ، قَالَ: فَكَيْفَ تَقُولُ إِذَا تَطَيَّرْتَ؟ ، قَالَ: أَقُولُ: «اللَّهُمَّ لَا طَيْرَ إِلَّا طَيْرُكَ، وَلَا خَيْرَ إِلَّا خَيْرُكَ، وَلَا رَبَّ غَيْرُكَ، وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِكَ» فَقَالَ كَعْبٌ: أَنْتَ أَفْقَهُ الْعَرَبِ وَإِنَّهَا لَكَذَلِكَ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ
entries.isnad_en: Usamah b. Zayd reported to me: I heard Nafi' b. Jubayr b. Mut'im say:
entries.matn_en: Ka'b al-Ahbar asked 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr: 'Do you take omens?' He replied: 'Yes.' Ka'b asked: 'What do you say when you take an omen?' He said 'I say: O God, there is no omen except Your omen, no good except Your good, no lord besides You, and no power except with You.' Ka'b said: 'You are the most knowledgeable of the Arabs, and it is indeed as such in the Torah.'

sections.title_en: On Amulets, Spells, and the Evil Eye

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 747
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ سَمْعَانَ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ أَخْبَرَهُ، عَنْ أَصْحَابِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ «
entries.matn_ar: نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عَنِ التَّمَائِمِ، وَالتِّوَلِ» ، فَقِيلَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ: قَدْ عَرَفْنَا التَّمَائِمَ، فَمَا التِّوَلُ؟ فَقَالَ: مَا يَتَحَبَّبُ بِهِ بَعْضُ النِّسَاءِ إِلَى أَزْوَاجِهِنَّ كَالْكَهَانَةِ وَأَشْبَاهِهَا
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Sam'an reported to me that 'Abd Allah b. Abi Najih informed him from the companions of 'Abd Allah b. Mas'ud, from Ibn Mas'ud, who said 'The Messenger of God, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: forbade amulets and charms.' It was said to 'Abd Allah b. Mas'ud: 'We know what amulets are, but what are charms?' He replied: 'What some women use to endear themselves to their husbands, like soothsaying and the like.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 748
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي حَيْوَةُ بْنُ شُرَيْحٍ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ مِشْرَحِ بْنِ هَاعَانَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ الْجُهَنِيَّ، يَقُولُ: " سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ، يَقُولُ: «
entries.matn_ar: مَنْ عَلَّقَ تَمِيمَةً فَلَا أَتَمَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ، وَمَنْ عَلَّقَ وَدَعَةً فَلَا وَدَعَ اللَّهُ لَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Haywah b. Shurayh reported to me from Khalid b. 'Ubayd, from Mishrah b. Ha'an, who said:
entries.matn_en: I heard 'Uqbah b. 'Amir al-Juhani say: I heard the Messenger of God, ﷺ, say: ‘Whoever hangs an amulet, may God not complete his aim; whoever hangs a cowrie shell, may God not let him be at peace.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 749
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي قَبِيلٍ الْمَعَافِرِيِّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي غِفَارٍ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: دَخَلَتْ أُمِّي بِي عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَيَّ تَمِيمَةٌ، فَقَطَعَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahi'ah reported to me from Abi Qabil al-Ma'afiri, who reported from a man of Bani Ghifar, who said '
entries.matn_en: My mother took me to the Messenger of God, ﷺ, while I was wearing an amulet, and the Messenger of God cut it off.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 750
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، أَنْ يَحْيَى بْنَ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَهُ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: بَلَغَنَا أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ دَخَلَ عَلَى بَعْضِ أَهْلِهِ وَعَلَيْهِ خَرَزَةٌ مُعَلَّقَةٌ، فَقَطَعَهَا، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «إِنَّ أَهْلَ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ لَأَغْنِيَاءُ عَنِ الشِّرْكِ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Layth b. Sa'd reported to me that Yahya b. Sa'id told him:
entries.matn_en: It reached us that 'Abd Allah b. Mas'ud entered upon one of his family members and saw a bead hanging on him. He cut it off and said, ‘The family of Ibn Mas'ud has no need of polytheism.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 751
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ نَشِيطٍ، وَاللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا الْخَيْرِ، يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ، يَقُولُ فِي التَّمَائِمِ: «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّهَا أَيْنَمَا وُضِعَتْ مِنَ الْإِنْسَانِ فَإِنَّ مَوْضِعَهَا شِرْكٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibrahim b. Nashit and al-Layth reported to me from Yazid b. Abi Habib that he heard Abi al-Khayr say: I heard 'Uqbah b. 'Amir say regarding amulets: '
entries.matn_en: Wherever it is placed on a person, that place becomes an act of polytheism.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 752
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ زَحْرٍ، عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ سَوَادَةَ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ صُدًا،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ: أَتَيْنَا النَّبِيَّ ، صلى الله عليه وسلم ، اثْنَا عَشَرَ رَجُلًا فَبَايَعْنَا وَتَرَكَ مِنَّا رَجُلًا لَمْ يُبَايِعْهُ، فَقُلْنَا: بَايِعْهُ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: «لَنْ أُبَايِعَهُ حَتَّى يَنْزِعَ الَّذِي عَلَيْهِ؛ إِنَّهُ مَنْ كَانَ مِنَّا عَلَيْهِ مِثْلَ الَّذِي عَلَيْهِ كَانَ مُشْرِكًا، مَا كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِ» قَالَ: فَنَظَرْنَا فَإِذَا فِي عَضُدِهِ سَيْرٌ فِيهِ شَيْءٌ مِنْ لِحَا شَجَرَةٍ، أَوْ شَيْءٌ مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ
entries.isnad_en: Yahya b. Ayyub reported to me from Ibn Zahr, from Bakr b. Sawadah, from a man of Suda', who said
entries.matn_en: We came to the Prophet, ﷺ, twelve men and pledged allegiance, but he left one man without taking his pledge. We said: 'Pledge allegiance to him, O Prophet of God.' He said: 'I will not take his pledge until he removes what he is wearing, for whoever among us wears such a thing is a polytheist as long as he wears it.' We looked and saw that on his upper arm was a strap containing something from the bark of a tree or a piece of a tree.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 752
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ هُبَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ كَانَ يَقُولُ: «
entries.matn_ar: تَعْلِيقُ التَّمَائِمِ شُعْبَةٌ مِنْ شُعَبِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahi'ah reported to me from 'Abd Allah b. Hubayrah that 'Ali b. Abi Talib used to say: '
entries.matn_en: Hanging amulets is a branch of the practices of the Age of Ignorance.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 753
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، أَنَّ بُكَيْرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَهُ، أَنَّ أُمَّهُ، حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّهَا
entries.matn_ar: أَرْسَلَتْ إِلَى عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ ، صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ، بِأَخِيهِ مَخْرَمَةَ وَكَانَ يُدَاوَى مِنْ قُرْحَةٍ تَكُونُ بِالصِّبْيَانِ، فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ عَائِشَةُ وَفَرَغَتْ مِنْهُ رَأَتْ فِي رِجْلَيْهِ خُلْخَالَيْ حَدِيدٍ، فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ: «أَظَنَنْتُمْ أَنَّ هَذَيْنِ الْخُلْخَالَيْنِ يَدْفَعَانِ عَنْهُ شَيْئًا كَتَبَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ، لَوْ رَأَيْتُهُمَا مَا تَدَاوَى عِنْدِي أَوْ مَا مَسَّ عِنْدِي، لَعَمْرِي لَخُلْخَالَينِ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ أَطْهَرُ مِنْ هَذَيْنِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Amr b. al-Harith reported to me that Bukayr b. 'Abd Allah informed him that his mother told him that
entries.matn_en: she sent her brother Makhramah to 'A'ishah, the wife of the Prophet, ﷺ. He was being treated for an ulcer that affects children. When 'A'ishah saw him and finished with him, she noticed two iron anklets on his legs. 'A'ishah said 'Do you think these two anklets will ward off anything that God has decreed for him? If I had seen them, he would not have been treated near me, or even touched near me. By my life, two silver anklets are purer than these.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 754
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَكَتَبَ إِلَيَّ حَمْزَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ يَقُولُ: حَدَّثَنِي عَلْقَمَةُ بْنُ أَبِي عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تُؤْتَى بِالصِّبْيَانِ إِذَا وُلِدُوا لِكَيْ تَدْعُوَ اللَّهَ لَهُمْ بِالْبَرَكَةِ، فَأُتِيَتْ بِصَبِيٍّ ، فَذَهَبَتْ تَأْخُذُهُ، وَإِذَا تَحْتَ وِسَادَتِهِ شَيْءٌ ، فَرَمَتْ. . . . . . وَقَالَتْ: «إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، صلى الله عليه وسلم ، كَانَ يَعِيبُ الطِّيَرَةَ وَيَنْهَى عَنْهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Hamzah b. 'Abd al-Wahid wrote to me, saying: 'Alqamah b. Abi 'Alqamah reported to me from his mother, from 'A'ishah,
entries.matn_en: that she used to be brought children when they were born so that she could invoke God’s blessing upon them. A child was brought to her, and as she was about to take him, she found something under his pillow and threw it away. She said 'The Messenger of God, ﷺ, disapproved of omens and forbade them.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 755
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَبْدَةَ بِنْتِ أَبِي حُمَيْدَةَ، قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: دَخَلْتُ بِأَخِي بُكَيْرٍ عَلَى أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَائِشَةَ، لِتُبَارِكَ عَلَيْهِ، وَدَخَلَتِ امْرَأَةٌ عَلَيْهَا بِصَبِيٍّ لَهَا قَدْ خَطَّتْ بَيْنَ عَيْنَيْهِ، أَوْ فِي جَبْهَتِهِ خَطًّا أَسْوَدَ، فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ: «لَا أُبَارِكُ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى يُمْحَى هَذَا الْخَطُّ»
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. 'Amr reported to me from Ibn Jurayj, from 'Abdah bint Abi Humaydah, who said
entries.matn_en: I entered with my brother Bukayr upon Umm al-Mu'minin 'A'ishah to seek her blessing for him. A woman entered with her child, who had a black mark drawn between his eyes or on his forehead. 'A'ishah said: 'I will not bless him until this mark is erased.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 756
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَكَتَبَ إِلَيَّ مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، يَقُولُ فِي الزِّمْلَجِ الْحَدِيدِ لِلْمَرْأَةِ الْحَامِلِ، فَقَالَ: بَلَغَنِي «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ كَانَتْ تَكْرَهُ ذَلِكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik b. Anas wrote to me
entries.matn_en: concerning the iron zimalaj worn by a pregnant woman. He said: ‘It reached me that 'A'ishah, the wife of the Prophet, disliked it.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 756
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي عِيسَى الْخُرَاسَانِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ،
entries.matn_ar: مَرَّ بِرَجُلٍ وَفِي يَدِهِ حَلَقَةٌ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ أَوْ خَاتَمٌ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ، فَقَالَ: «هَذِهِ؟» ، فَقَالَ الرَّجُلُ: مِنَ الْوَاهِنَةِ، فَقَالَ: «وَلَا تَزِيدُكَ إِلَّا وَهْنًا»
entries.isnad_en: Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub reported to me from Abi 'Isa al-Khurasani that the Messenger of God, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: passed by a man who had an iron ring or an iron signet ring on his hand. He asked: 'What is this?' The man replied: 'For weakness.' The Prophet said 'It will only increase your weakness.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 757
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي غَيْرُهُ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، بِنَحْوِ ذَلِكَ،
entries.matn_ar: وَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: " لَوْ مِتَّ وَأَنْتَ تَرَى أَنَّهَا تَنْفَعُكَ مَا رَأَيْتَ وَجْهَ مُحَمَّدٍ
entries.isnad_en: Another person reported to me from al-Hasan, from the Messenger of God, ﷺ, similarly,
entries.matn_en: and the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said to him: 'If you die while believing it benefits you, you will not see the face of Muhammad.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 757
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ الْحَسَنَ، يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام: «
entries.matn_ar: مَنْ تَعَلَّقَ شَيْئًا وُكِلَ إِلَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Jarir b. Hazim reported to me
entries.matn_en: that he heard al-Hasan say: The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: ‘Whoever hangs something as an amulet is left to depend on it.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 759
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، وَعَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ الْأَشَجِّ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَتْ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَيْسَ بِتَمِيمَةٍ مَا عُلِّقَ بَعْدَ أَنْ يَقَعَ الْبَلَاءُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahi'ah and 'Amr b. al-Harith reported to me from Bukayr b. al-Ashajj, from al-Qasim b. Muhammad, that 'A'ishah, the wife of the Prophet, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: An amulet is not what is hung after the affliction has occurred.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 759
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: رَأَيْتُ خَرَزَةً كَانَتْ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ الزُّبَيْدِيِّ صَاحِبِ النَّبِيِّ ، عليه السلام ، مِنَ اللَّقْوَةِ يُجْعَلُ فِي الشَّمْسِ، ثُمَّ يُمْسَحُ بِهَا وَجْهُ صَاحِبِ اللَّقْوَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahi'ah reported to me from Yazid b. Abi Habib that he said '
entries.matn_en: I saw a bead that belonged to 'Abd Allah b. al-Harith al-Zubaydi, a companion of the Prophet, ﷺ, used for facial paralysis. It was placed in the sun, then wiped on the face of the person with facial paralysis.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 760
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عُقْبَةُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، يَكْرَهُ الشَّرَابَ يَمْنَعُ الْحَبَلَ، وَمَا يَمْنَعُ الْحَبَلُ مِنَ الشَّرَابِ، فَإِنَّهُ يُخَافُ أَنْ يَقْتُلَ مَا فِي الرَّحِمِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Uqbah b. Nafi' reported to me
entries.matn_en: that Yahya b. Sa'id used to dislike a drink used to prevent conception, and anything taken as a drink to prevent pregnancy, for he feared it might kill what was in the womb.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 760
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَبَلَغَنِي عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ: أَنَّهُ قَالَ: "
entries.matn_ar: مَنْ أَلْبَسَ امْرَأَةً خَرَزَةً كَيْمَا تَحْبَلُ أَوْ كَيْمَا لَا تَحْبَلُ، قَالَ: هَذَا مِنْ رَأْيِ السُّوءِ الْمَسْخُوطِ لِمَنْ عَمِلَ بِهِ "
entries.matn_en: It reached me from Rabi'ah b. Abi 'Abd al-Rahman that he said: ‘Whoever makes a woman wear a bead so that she may conceive, or so that she may not conceive, is following an evil view, condemned in whoever acts upon it.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 761
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عُقْبَةُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا بَأْسَ أَنْ يُعَالَجَ لَبَنُ الشَّاةِ السَّوْدَاءِ، أَوِ الْبُقُورِ السَّوْدَاءِ، أَوْ لَبَنُ الْمَرْأَةِ فِي أَوَّلِ بَطْنٍ» لَا يَرَى بِذَلِكَ كُلِّهِ بَأْسًا
entries.isnad_en: 'Uqbah b. Nafi' reported to me from Rabi'ah, who said:
entries.matn_en: ‘There is no harm in treatment with the milk of a black sheep, black cows, or a woman who has just had her first child.’ He saw no harm in any of these.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 761
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ عَطَاءَ بْنَ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، عَنِ النُّشْرَةِ ،
entries.matn_ar: وَكَرِهَ ذَلِكَ إِلَّا صَبًّا، قَالَ: يَعْقِدُونَ بِهَا، قَالَ: وَلَا أَدْرِي مَا يَصْنَعُونَ، قَالَ: فَأَيُّمَا شَيْءٍ تَصْنَعُهُ فَلَا بَأْسَ بِهِ
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. 'Amr reported to me from Ibn Jurayj, who said:
entries.matn_en: I asked 'Ata' b. Abi Rabah about nushrah, a treatment used to undo magic. He disapproved of it except by pouring. He said, ‘They tie knots with it. I do not know what they do.’ He added, ‘Whatever you do, there is no harm in it.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 762
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ يَحْيَى بْنَ سَعِيدٍ، يَقُولُ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَيْسَ بِالنُّشْرَةِ الَّتِي يُجْمَعُ فِيهَا مِنَ السِّحْرِ أَوِ الطِّيبِ وَيَغْتَسِلُ بِهَا الْإِنْسَانُ بَأْسٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yahya b. Ayyub reported to me
entries.matn_en: that he heard Yahya b. Sa'id say: ‘There is no harm in nushrah made by gathering [ingredients] from magic or perfume and washing with it.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 763
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي هِشَامُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، أَنَّ نَاسًا قَالُوا لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: إِنَّا كُنَّا نَأْتِي الْكَهَنَةَ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا خَيْرَ فِي الْكَهَنَةِ فَلَا تَأْتُوهُمْ» ، فَقَالُوا: أَفَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِينَ يَضْرِبُونَ بِالْحَصَا، فَقَالَ: «لَا تَأْتُوهُمْ» ، قَالُوا: أَفَرَأَيْتَ الْخَطَّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فَقَالَ: «إِنَّ نَبِيًّا مِنَ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ عُلِّمَ الْخَطَّ فَمَنْ أَصَابَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ الْخَطِّ فَقَدْ أَصَابَ وَإِلَّا فَلَا»
entries.isnad_en: Hisham b. Sa'd reported to me from Zayd b. Aslam
entries.matn_en: that some people said to the Messenger of God, ﷺ: ‘In the pre-Islamic period, we used to visit soothsayers.’ He replied, ‘There is no good in soothsayers, so do not visit them.’ They asked, ‘What about those who cast pebbles?’ He said, ‘Do not visit them.’ They asked, ‘What about drawing lines, O Messenger of God?’ He said, ‘One of the prophets was taught this art of line-drawing. Whoever draws a line like his has got it right; otherwise, he has not.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 764
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: مَنْ أَتَى عَرَّافًا يَسْأَلُهُ لَمْ تُقْبَلْ مِنْهُ صَلَاةٌ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً»
entries.isnad_en: I heard 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar narrate from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said '
entries.matn_en: Whoever visits a fortune-teller and asks him, his prayer will not be accepted for forty nights.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 765
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: مَنْ ذَهَبَ إِلَى كَاهِنٍ فَصَدَّقَهُ بِمَا يَقُولُ غَضِبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahi'ah reported to me from al-Harith b. Yazid, from Kathir b. 'Amr, from Nafi', from Abi Hurayrah, who said '
entries.matn_en: Whoever goes to a soothsayer and believes what he says, God will be angry with him for forty nights.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 766
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ وَدَاعَةَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ دَخَلَ عَلَى فَضَالَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، صَاحِبِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، فَقَرَّبَ إِلَيْهِ طَعَامًا، فَقَالَ فَضَالَةُ: «تَدْرِي مَا هَذَا؟ ، إِنَّ فُلَانَةَ أُمَّ وَلَدٍ لَهُ كَانَتْ ذَهَبَتْ إِلَى كَاهِنٍ تَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ شَيْءٍ ، فَأَمَرْتُهَا أَنْ تَصُومَ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا كَفَّارَةً لِذَلِكَ، فَالْيَوْمُ تَمَامُ ذَلِكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahi'ah reported to me from al-Harith b. Yazid, from Wada'ah, who said:
entries.matn_en: I entered upon Fadalah b. 'Ubayd, a Companion of the Prophet, ﷺ. He brought me food and asked, ‘Do you know what this is? A certain enslaved woman who had borne him a child went to a soothsayer to ask about something. I ordered her to fast for forty days as expiation. Today completes that period.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 766
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ عُلَيِّ، عَنْ حَبَّانَ بْنِ أَبِي جَبَلَةَ، قَالَ: لَا أَدْرِي رَفَعَهُ أَمْ لَا: إِنَّهُ "
entries.matn_ar: مَنْ أَتَى عَرَّافًا أَوْ كَاهِنًا، ثُمَّ صَدَّقَهُ بِمَا يَقُولُ: كَانَ كَمَنْ كَفَرَ بِمَا نَزَلَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ عليه السلام "
entries.isnad_en: Musa b. 'Ulayy reported to me from Habban b. Abi Jablah, who said I do not know if he attributed it to the Prophet or not: '
entries.matn_en: Whoever visits a fortune-teller or a soothsayer and believes what he says is like one who disbelieves in what was revealed to Muhammad, ﷺ.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 767
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا إِسْحَاقَ الْهَمْدَانِيَّ، يَقُولُ: عَنْ هُبَيْرَةَ بْنِ يَرِيمَ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ،
entries.matn_ar: مِثْلَهُ، وَقَالَ: أَوْ سَاحِرًا
entries.isnad_en: Jarir b. Hazim reported to me that he heard Abi Ishaq al-Hamdani say from Hubayrah b. Yarim, from Ibn Mas'ud,
entries.matn_en: similarly, and he said: 'Or a sorcerer.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 767
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ. . . . . . يَرَهُ أَنَّ كَثِيرَ بْنَ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ الْعَلَوِيَّ أَخْبَرَهُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: كَيْفَ تَرَى الرُّقَى ، وَالْأُخَذَةَ، وَالْكَهَانَةَ، وَنَظَرًا فِي النُّجُومِ؟ . . . . طَرَفٌ مِنَ السِّحْرِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahi'ah reported to me from 'Ubayd... that Kathir b. Abi Sulayman al-'Alawi informed him from 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr, who said '
entries.matn_en: What do you think of incantations, charms, soothsaying, and astrology?... It is a branch of magic.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 768
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ زِيَادِ بْنِ أَنْعَمَ، عَنِ الْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْوَعْلَانِيِّ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «
entries.matn_ar: مَنْ سَحَرَ أَوْ سُحِرَ لَهُ حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ الرَّفِيقَ الْأَعْلَى ، وَفِي الْجَنَّةِ سَعَةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Ziyad b. An'am reported to me from al-Miswar b. 'Abd Allah al-Wa'lani, who said: The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said:
entries.matn_en: ‘Whoever practices magic or has magic practiced for him, God has forbidden him the Highest Companion; yet Paradise is vast.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 769
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: قَوْمٌ يَنْظُرُونَ فِي النُّجُومِ وَيَكْتُبُونَ أَبَاجَادَ أُولَئِكَ لَا خَلَاقَ لَهُمْ»
entries.isnad_en: Yahya b. Ayyub reported to me from 'Abd Allah b. Tawus, from his father, from Ibn 'Abbas, who said '
entries.matn_en: A people who look at the stars and write abjad (alphabetical divination) have no share in the Hereafter.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 770
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، يَقُولُ: «إِنَّ الْمَلَائِكَةَ تَنْزِلُ فِي الْعَنَانِ ، وَهُوَ السَّحَابُ، فَتَذْكُرُ الْأَمْرَ قُضِيَ فِي السَّمَاءِ فَيَسْتَرِقُ الشَّيْطَانُ السَّمْعَ، فَيَسْتمَعُهُ، فَتُوحِيهِ إِلَى الْكُهَّانِ فَيَكْذِبُونَ مَعَهَا مِائَةَ كِذْبَةٍ مِنْ عِنْدِ أَنْفُسِهِمْ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahi'ah reported to me from Muhammad b. 'Abd al-Rahman, from 'Urwah b. al-Zubayr, from 'A'ishah, the wife of the Prophet, ﷺ, who heard the Messenger of God say:
entries.matn_en: ‘The angels descend in the clouds and mention the matter decreed in heaven. The devils eavesdrop and hear it, then convey it to the soothsayers, who add a hundred lies of their own to it.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 771
entries.isnad_ar: وَأَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلَ نَاسٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام عَنِ الْكُهَّانِ، فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: «لَيْسُوا بِشَيْءٍ» ، قَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّهُمْ يُحَدِّثُونَ أَحْيَانًا بِالشَّيْءِ يَكُونُ حَقًّا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «تِلْكَ الْكَلِمَةُ مِنَ الْحَقِّ، يَحْفَظُهَا الْجِنُّ، فَيُقِرُّهَا فِي أُذُنِ وَلِيِّهِ قَرَّ الزُّجَاجَةِ، فَيَخْلِطُونَ فِيهَا أَكْثَرَ مِنْ مِائَةِ كِذْبَةٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. 'Amr reported to me from Ibn Jurayj, from Ibn Shihab, from Yahya b. 'Urwah, from his father, from 'A'ishah, who said
entries.matn_en: Some people asked the Messenger of God, ﷺ, about soothsayers. The Messenger of God said to them: 'They are nothing.' They said: 'O Messenger of God, sometimes they tell something that is true.' The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: 'That is a word of truth that the jinn preserve and whisper into the ear of their ally like the clinking of glass. They mix in it more than a hundred lies.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 772
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي رِجَالٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ أَنَّهُمْ بَيْنَمَا هُمْ جُلُوسٌ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ،
entries.matn_ar: رُمِيَ بِنَجْمٍ فَاسْتَنَارَ، فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَا كُنْتُمْ تَقُولُونَ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ إِذَا رُمِيَ بِمِثْلِ هَذَا؟» ، قَالُوا: اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ، كُنَّا نَقُولُ: وُلِدَ اللَّيْلَةَ عَظِيمٌ وَمَاتَ عَظِيمٌ، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: " فَإِنَّهَا لَا يُرْمَى لِمَوْتِ أَحَدٍ وَلَا لَحَيَاةِ أَحَدٍ، وَلَكِنْ رُبَّمَا إِذَا قَضَى أَمْرًا سَبَّحَ حَمَلَةُ الْعَرْشِ، ثُمَّ يُسَبِّحُ أَهْلُ السَّمَاءِ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ التَّسْبِيحُ أَهْلَ السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا، ثُمَّ قَالَ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَ حَمَلَةَ الْعَرْشِ: مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ؟ فَيُخْبِرُونَهُمْ بِتَسْبِيحِ أَهْلِ السَّمَوَاتِ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ الْخَبَرُ هَذِهِ السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا ، فَيَخْطَفُ الْجِنُّ السَّمْعَ ، فَيَذْهَبُونَ بِهِ إِلَى أَوْلِيَائِهِمْ ، فَمَا جَاءُوا بِهِ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ فَهُوَ حَقٌّ، وَلَكِنَّهُمْ يَرْقُونَ فِيهِ وَيَزِيدُونَ، قَالَ اللَّهُ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ: {حَتَّى إِذَا فُزِّعَ عَنْ قُلُوبِهِمْ قَالُوا مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ قَالُوا الْحَقَّ} [سبأ: 23] "
entries.isnad_en: Yunus b. Yazid reported to me from Ibn Shihab, who said 'Ali b. Husayn informed me from Ibn 'Abbas, who said: Some men from the companions of the Messenger of God, ﷺ, from the Ansar, informed me that while they were sitting with the Messenger of God, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: a shooting star blazed. The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said to them: 'What did you used to say in the Age of Ignorance when something like this was shot?' They said: 'God and His Messenger know best. We used to say: A great man was born tonight, or a great man died.' The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: 'It is not shot for the death of anyone or the life of anyone. Rather, when God decrees a matter, the bearers of the Throne glorify Him, then the inhabitants of the heavens glorify Him until the glorification reaches the inhabitants of the lowest heaven. Then those near the bearers of the Throne say: What did your Lord say? They inform them of the glorification of the inhabitants of the heavens until the news reaches this lowest heaven. The jinn then snatch the hearing and convey it to their allies. What they bring forth as it is, is true, but they embellish it and add to it. God, the Exalted in praise, says: {Until, when fear is banished from their hearts, they say: What did your Lord say? They say: The truth.} [Saba: 23]' Harmalah said: Bishr reported to me that al-Awza'i reported from al-Zuhri similarly.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 773
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ حَرْمَلَةُ: حَدَّثَنِي بِشْرٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ،
entries.matn_ar: مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Harmalah said: Bishr reported to me; he said: al-Awza'i reported to us from al-Zuhri,
entries.matn_en: “similarly.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 774
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ لَبِيبَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، إِلَّا أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: ثُمَّ تَسْتَرِقُهُ الشَّيَاطِينُ بِالسَّمْعِ فَيَأْتُونَ بِهِ الْكَهَنَةَ، فَيُزِيدُونَ وَيَنْقُصُونَ، فَتُخْطِئُ الْكَهَنَةُ وَتُصِيبُ، ثُمَّ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عز وجل مَنَعَ السَّمَاءَ بِهَذِهِ النُّجُومِ الَّتِي يَقْعُدُونَ بِهَا فَانْقَطَعَتِ الْكَهَانَةُ فَلَا كَهَانَةَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yazid b. 'Iyad reported to me from 'Amr b. Abi Ja'far, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Labibah, from 'Ali b. Husayn, from the Messenger of God, ﷺ, except that he said '
entries.matn_en: Then the devils eavesdrop on it and bring it to the soothsayers, adding and subtracting. The soothsayers err and hit the mark. Then God, the Mighty and Exalted, protected the sky with these stars that they sit by, and soothsaying was cut off, and there is no soothsaying.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 774
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَبَلَغَنِي عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَا يَحِلُّ لِمُسْلِمٍ أَنْ يَسْأَلَ كَاهِنًا، وَلَا يَمْشِيَ إِلَيْهِ، وَلَا يُعْطِيَهُ عَلَيْهِ، وَلَا يَسْمَعَ مِنْ قَوْلِهِ، وَلَيْسَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ أَمْرِ الْإِسْلَامِ ، إِنَّمَا كَانَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ أَمْرِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، فَمَنْ أَخَذَ بِذَلِكَ فَقَدْ تَرَكَ أَمْرَ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَأَخَذَ بِأَمْرِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ»
entries.matn_en: It reached me from Yahya b. Sa'id that he said: ‘It is not lawful for a Muslim to ask a soothsayer, go to him, pay him for it, or listen to what he says. This is not part of Islam; it belongs to the pre-Islamic period. Whoever does this has abandoned Islam’s way and taken up the way of the pre-Islamic period.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 775
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَبَلَغَنِي، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: فِي الْعَبْدِ يَأْبَقُ فَيَقْعُدُ بِغَيْرِ سِحْرٍ حَتَّى تُعَمَّى عَلَيْهِ الطُّرُقُ، وَيُمْنَعُ مِنَ الْخَلَاءِ وَالْبَوْلِ ، فَيَشْتَدُّ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِ، فَيَرْجِعُ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ، قَالَ يَحْيَى: «رَأَيْتُ خَيْرًا مِمَّنْ أَدْرَكْنَا يَكْرَهُ ذَلِكَ كَرَاهِيَةً شَدِيدَةً وَيَنْهَى عَنْهَا»
entries.isnad_en: It reached me from Yahya b. Sa'id that he said
entries.matn_en: regarding a slave who runs away and stays without magic until the paths become obscure to him and he is prevented from relieving himself and urinating, and this becomes severe for him, so he returns to his family: 'I have seen the best of those we have met strongly dislike that and forbid it.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 775
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ هُرْمُزَ، مَوْلَى عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ:. . . عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو فَإِذَا هُوَ يَرَى التُّيُوسَ تَنْزُوا عَلَى. . . . . مَا هَاهُنَا، لَمْ أَكُنْ أَعْلَمُ السِّبَاعَ هَاهُنَا كَبِيرَةً، قِيلَ: نَعَمْ، وَلَكِنَّهَا عَقَدَتْ، فَهِيَ تُخَالِطُ الْبَهَائِمَ وَلَا تُهَيِّجُهَا، فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو: شُعَبٌ صَغِيرَةٌ. . . . .
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahi'ah reported to me from Yazid b. Abi Habib, from Hurmuz, the freedman of 'Amr b. al-'As,
entries.matn_en: that … 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr saw the male goats mounting … “What is here? I did not know the wild animals here were so large.” They said, “Yes, but they have been [the Arabic verb is unclear; literally, ‘tied/contracted’], so they mix with the livestock without provoking them.” 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr said, “Small branches …”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 777
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ ابْنُ وَهْبٍ: أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، وَعَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، وَابْنُ سَمْعَانَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَهُمْ أَنَّ أَبَا خُزَامَةَ أَحَدَ بَنِي الْحَارِثِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ هَزِيمٍ حَدَّثَهُ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، قَالَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، أَرَأَيْتَ
entries.matn_ar: دَوَاءً نَتَدَاوَى بِهِ ، وَرُقًى نَسْتَرْقِيهَا ، وَتُقًى نَتَّقِيهَا، هَلْ تَرُدُّ ذَلِكَ مِنْ قَدَرِ اللَّهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ؟، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّهُ مِنْ قَدَرِ اللَّهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said Yunus b. Yazid, 'Amr b. al-Harith, and Ibn Sam'an reported to me that Ibn Shihab informed them that Abu Khuzamah, one of Bani al-Harith b. Sa'd b. Huzaym, reported to him that his father reported to him that he said to the Messenger of God, ﷺ: 'O Messenger of God, what do you think of
entries.matn_en: medicine we use, incantations we recite, and precautions we take? Do they avert anything from God’s decree?' The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: 'They are from God’s decree.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 778
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ: بَلَغَنَا عَنِ الرِّجَالِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا يَقُولُونَ: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الرُّقَى حِينَ قَدِمَ الْمَدِينَةَ، وَكَانَتِ الرُّقَى فِي ذَلِكَ الزَّمَانِ فِيهَا كَثِيرٌ مِنْ كَلَامِ الشِّرْكِ، فَانْتَهَى النَّاسُ عَنْهَا حِينَ نَهَاهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، فَيَنْهَاهُمْ كَذَلِكَ إِذَا لُدِغَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ، عليه السلام ، بِنَشْبَةِ حَرْبَةٍ، أَوْ بِضَرْبٍ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام: «هَلْ مِنْ رَاقٍ» ، قَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَدْ كَانَ آلُ حَزْمٍ يَرْقُونَ بِرُقْيَةٍ مِنَ الْحَيَّةِ، فَلَمَّا نَهَيْتَ عَنِ الرُّقَى تَرَكُوهَا، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «ادْعُوا لِي عُمَارَةَ بْنَ حَزْمٍ» ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلَدٌ، وَقَدْ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا، فَدُعِيَ لَهُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام: «اعْرِضْ عَلَيَّ رُقْيَتَكَ» ، فَعَرَضَهَا عَلَيْهِ فَلَمْ يَرَ بِهَا بَأْسًا، فَأَذِنَ أَنْ يَرْقِيَهَا
entries.isnad_en: Yunus b. Yazid reported to me from Ibn Shihab, who said:
entries.matn_en: It reached us from men of knowledge that they used to say the Messenger of God, ﷺ, forbade ruqyas when he arrived in Medina, since the ruqyas then contained much polytheistic speech. So people stopped using them. Later, when one of the Prophet’s Companions was pierced by a spear or struck, the Messenger of God asked, ‘Is there anyone who can recite a ruqya?’ They said, ‘O Messenger of God, the family of Hazm used to recite a ruqya for snakebite, but when you forbade ruqyas, they stopped.’ He said, ‘Call 'Umarah b. Hazm for me.’ He had no children and had fought at Badr. When he was brought, the Messenger of God said, ‘Show me your ruqya.’ He showed it to him, and he saw no harm in it and permitted him to recite it.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 779
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَمْرَو بْنَ حَزْمٍ، دُعِيَ لِامْرَأَةٍ بِالْمَدِينَةِ لَدَغَتْهَا حَيَّةٌ لَيَرْقِيَهَا، فَأَبَى، فَأُخْبِرَ بِذَلِكَ النَّبِيُّ ، عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ، فَدَعَاهُ، فَقَالَ عَمْرٌو: إِنَّكَ تَزْجُرُ عَنِ الرُّقَى، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام: «اقْرَأْهَا عَلَيَّ» ، فَقَرَأَهَا عَلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ: «لَا بَأْسَ بِهَا، إِنَّمَا هِيَ مَوَاثِيقُ، فَارْقِ بِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahi'ah reported to me from Abi al-Zubayr, from Jabir,
entries.matn_en: that 'Amr b. Hazm was called to a woman in Medina who had been bitten by a snake to recite an incantation for her, but he refused. The Prophet, ﷺ, was informed of this, so he called him and said 'You forbid incantations?' 'Amr said: 'You discourage incantations.' The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: 'Recite it to me.' He recited it to him, and the Prophet said: 'There is no harm in it. They are covenants, so recite it.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 781
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدِ بْنُ عَمْرَو بْنِ حَزْمٍ الْأَنْصَارِي، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: عَرَضَ عَمْرُو بْنُ حَزْمٍ رُقْيَتَهُمْ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، فَأَذِنَ لَهُمْ أَنْ يَرْقُوا بِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Usamah b. Zayd b. 'Amr b. Hazm al-Ansari reported to me: '
entries.matn_en: 'Amr b. Hazm presented their incantation to the Messenger of God, ﷺ, and he permitted them to recite it.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 781
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، وَابْنُ سَمْعَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ، فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرْقِي مِنَ الْعَقْرَبِ، فَقَالَ: «مَنِ اسْتَطَاعَ أَنْ يَنْفَعَ أَخَاهُ فَلْيَفْعَلْ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Lahi'ah and Ibn Sam'an reported to me from Abi al-Zubayr, from Jabir, who said
entries.matn_en: A man from the Ansar came and said: 'O Messenger of God, I recite an incantation for scorpion stings.' The Prophet said: 'Whoever is able to benefit his brother, let him do so.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 782
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، وَمَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، وَيُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، أَنَّ نَافِعًا، أَخْبَرَهُمْ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ «
entries.matn_ar: اكْتَوَى مِنَ اللَّقْوَةِ، وَرُقِيَ مِنَ الْعَقْرَبِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Umar b. Muhammad, 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, Malik b. Anas, and Yunus b. Yazid reported to me that Nafi' informed them that 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar '
entries.matn_en: was cauterized for facial paralysis and recited an incantation for a scorpion sting.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 783
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي غَيْرُهُمْ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، «
entries.matn_ar: اسْتَرْقَى مِنَ الْعَقْرَبِ بِرُقْيَةٍ فَارِسِيَّةٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Others reported to me from Nafi' that Ibn 'Umar '
entries.matn_en: recited an incantation for a scorpion sting in Persian.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 784
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، يَرْقِي إِذَا رَقَى فَيَقُولُ: «امْسَحِ الْبَاسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، بِيَدِكَ الشِّفَاءُ، لَا كَاشِفَ لَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ» ، قَالَ هِشَامٌ: قَالَ عُرْوَةُ: قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ: فَتَعَلَّمْتُ هَذِهِ الرُّقْيَةَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، فَكُنْتُ أَرْقِيهِ بِهَا
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi al-Zinad reported to me from Hisham b. 'Urwah, from 'Urwah, from 'A'ishah, who said
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God, ﷺ, used to recite this incantation when he recited: 'Remove the harm, Lord of mankind. In Your hand is healing; there is no remover of it except You.' Hisham said: 'Urwah said: 'A'ishah said: I learned this incantation from the Messenger of God, ﷺ, and used to recite it for him.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 785
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سَلْمَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ. .، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ ثَوْبَانَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا. . . . . . رَسُول اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، يَقُولُ: «بِسْمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، مَلِكَ النَّاسِ إِلَهَ النَّاسِ. . . . الشَّافِي، مِنْ عِنْدِكَ الشِّفَاءُ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Salman reported to me from Ibn..., from 'Umar b. al-Hakam b. Thawban,
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, when... the Messenger of God, ﷺ, used to say: 'In the name of God, O God, Lord of mankind, King of mankind, God of mankind... the Healer. From You is healing, Lord of the worlds.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 786
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ ابْنُ الْهَادِ: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَيْضًا، كَانَتْ تَقُولُ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ،
entries.matn_ar: إِذَا اشْتَكَى رَقَاهُ جِبْرِيلُ، قَالَ: «بِسْمِ اللَّهِ يُبْرِيكَ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ يَشْفِيكَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ ذِي عَيْنٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn al-Had reported to me: Muhammad b. Ibrahim reported to me from Abi Salamah, from 'A'ishah, who also used to say: The Messenger of God, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: when he was ill, Jibril would recite for him: 'In the name of God, may He cure you, from every illness may He heal you, from the evil of an envier when he envies, and from the evil of every eye.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 787
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام ، كَانَ يَقُولُ: «بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ وَاللَّهُ يَشْفِيكَ مِنْ كُلِّ. . . . يَشْفِيكَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Awf reported to me
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, used to say: 'In the name of God, I recite for you, and God heals you from every... may He heal you.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 788
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام اشْتَكَى، فَأَتَاهُ أَصْحَابُهُ يَعُودُونَهُ، فَقَالَ: «إِنَّ جِبْرِيلَ. . . فِيهَا» ، فَقَالُوا: وَمَا هِيَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ: «بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ، وَاللَّهُ يَشْفِيكَ مِنْ كُلِّ. . . . . يَشْفِيكَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Amr b. al-Harith reported to me from Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God fell ill, and his companions came to visit him. He said, “Jibril … in it.” They asked, “What is it, Messenger of God?” He said, “In the name of God, I perform ruqyah over you; God heals you from every … [may He] heal you.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 788
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ. . . . الْأَكْبَرِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُولُ: «أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Amr b. al-Harith reported to me from 'Abd... al-Akbar
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, used to say: 'I seek refuge in the perfect words of God from every devil and harmful creature, and from every evil eye.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 789
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ: بَلَغَنَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام قَالَ للِشِّفَاءِ ابْنَةِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، وَهِيَ جَدَّةُ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ: «
entries.matn_ar: أَلَا تُعَلِّمِينَ هَذِهِ ، يُرِيدُ حَفْصَةَ زَوْجَتَهُ، رُقْيَةَ النَّمْلَةِ كَمَا عَلَّمْتِهَا الْكِتَابَةَ؟» قَالَ:
entries.isnad_en: Yunus b. Yazid reported to me from Ibn Shihab, who said:
entries.matn_en: It reached us that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said to al-Shifa' bint 'Abd Allah, the grandmother of Abu Bakr b. Sulayman b. Abi Hathmah: ‘Will you not teach this woman’—meaning his wife Hafsah—‘the ruqya for al-namlah, a skin ailment, as you taught her writing?’ He said:

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 791
entries.isnad_ar: وَأَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَاءَهُ. . . عَنْ ثَلَاثَةِ أَشْيَاءَ لَا يَعْلَمُهَا إِلَّا نَبِيٌّ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ جَعَلُوا يَتَجَرَّعُونَ لَهُ، يَقُولُونَ لَهُ:. . . أَنْفُهُ. . .، حَسَنٌ عُنُقُهُ، يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُصِيبُوهُ بِالْعَيْنِ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَى نَبِيِّهِ {قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ} [الناس: 1]
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. Sa'id reported to me from Abu Ma'shar, from Safwan b. Sulaym, that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God came to him … concerning three things known only to a prophet. They then began whispering to him, saying to him … his nose … his neck is handsome. They wanted to afflict him with the evil eye, so God revealed to His Prophet: “Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind” [Qur’an 114:1].

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 792
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ صَالِحِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَوْفِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ الْأَشْجَعِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنَّا نَرْقِي فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، فَقُلْنَا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، كَيْفَ تَرَى فِي ذَلِكَ؟ فَقَالَ: «اعْرِضُوا عَلَيَّ رُقَاكُمْ، لَا بَأْسَ بِالرُّقَى مَا لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهِ شِرْكٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Mu'awiyah b. Salih reported to me from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Jubayr, from 'Awf b. Malik al-Ashja'i, who said
entries.matn_en: We used to recite incantations in the Age of Ignorance, so we said: 'O Messenger of God, what do you think of that?' He said: 'Present your incantations to me. There is no harm in incantations as long as there is no polytheism in them.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 792
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، وَابْنُ سَمْعَانَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ " كَانَ إِذَا اشْتَكَى يَقْرَأُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالْمُعَوِّذَاتِ وَيَنْفُثُ، قَالَتْ: فَلَمَّا اشْتَدَّ وَجَعُهُ كُنْتُ أَقْرَأُ عَلَيْهِ، وَأَمْسَحُ عَلَيْهِ بِيَدِهِ رَجَاءَ بَرَكَتِهَا "
entries.isnad_en: Yunus b. Yazid and Ibn Sam'an reported to me that Ibn Shihab informed them from 'Urwah b. al-Zubayr, from 'A'ishah,
entries.matn_en: the Prophet’s wife, that the Messenger of God, when ill, would recite the Mu'awwidhat (protective suras) over himself and blow. She said: ‘When his pain became severe, I would recite over him and wipe him with his hand, seeking its blessing.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 794
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي مَخْرَمَةُ بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ. . . . .، صَالِحٌ مَوْلَى آلِ. . . . يُحَدِّثُ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ نَفَرًا مِنَ الْأَعْرَابِ، وَفِيهِمْ رَجُلٌ وَجِعٌ، فَقَالَ لَهُمُ الْأَعْرَابُ: هَلْ مِنْكُمْ مَنْ يُدَاوِي، فَنَفَثَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِآيَاتِ الْقُرْآنِ وَبِالْمُعَوِّذَاتِ مِنَ الْغَنَمِ، فَذَهَبُوا إِلَى النَّبِيِّ عليه السلام فَأَخْبَرُوهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عليه السلام «أَنَّهُنَّ الرَّاقُ، وَأَنَّهُنَّ رُقْيَةٌ» قَالَ:
entries.isnad_en: Makhramah b. Bukayr … Salih, the freedman of the family of …, reported to me
entries.matn_en: that a group of Bedouins, among whom was a sick man, asked: ‘Is there anyone among you who can treat him?’ One of them recited Qur’anic verses and the Mu'awwidhat over him in return for sheep. They went to the Prophet, ﷺ, and told him. The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: ‘They are the reciters, and it is a ruqya.’

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Al-Jāmiʿ fī al-Ḥadīth of Ibn Wahb · Vol. 1, p. 795
entries.isnad_ar: وَأَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ سَمْعَانَ،. . . ابْنِ. . . عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: نَحْو هَذِهِ، إِلَّا أَنَّهُ قَالَ: رَقَا. . . .
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Sam'an reported to us … from Ibn …, from the Messenger of God,
entries.matn_en: a report like this one, except that he said: “He performed ruqyah …”
